Developments have largely evolved along two separate tracks. Sequence modeling approaches on the one hand and feature interaction methods on the other. In this paper, we introduce Bumblebee, a recommendation architecture that addresses the lack of interaction between the two directions through an interleaved, stackable block design. Each block implements a micro-pipeline of layers combining sequence personalization, attention-based encoding, and feature crossing into a self-contained unit. Every block produces a joint representation of both feature modalities which is consumed by the next block in the sequence. This mechanism encourages early and repeated mixture of modalities and enriches downstream features with additional contextual information. Residual connections between blocks create cross-modal information pathways and yield additional predictive performance without adding additional parameters. Blocks can be specialized by selectively dropping components, enabling flexible trade-offs between quality and throughput. We evaluate our approach on large-scale industrial data and show consistent improvements over comparable baseline models across several classification and regression tasks. Furthermore, we conduct ablation studies to confirm that the interleaved composition itself is the primary driver of these improvements. Our results suggest that interleaving heterogeneous functional units, rather than composing deep stacks, is a promising paradigm for future-generation recommendation architectures.

</details>


### [151] [Improving Rare Medication Recommendation with Counterfactual Data Augmentation and Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24829)
*Shinhwan Kang,Soo Yong Lee,Jaewon Kim,Kijung Shin,Buru Chang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文提出GenRxR框架，利用大语言模型(LLM)的医学知识和临床推理能力，通过反事实数据增强和指令微调，专门解决AI药物推荐系统中罕见处方药物(rare-meds)预测性能低下的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI药物推荐系统在罕见处方药物(rare-meds)上预测性能显著较低，原因有二：(1) 罕见药数据固有的稀缺性(电子健康记录EHR数据集中药物呈长尾分布)；(2) 对共推荐药物之间关系考虑不足。罕见药(如孤儿药)对治疗罕见或严重疾病至关重要，预测失败会危及患者安全。

Method: GenRxR框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 反事实数据生成(LLM_CF)：使用GPT-4o为未处方某药物的患者构建"假设性"场景，基于相对风险选择关联的诊断、程序和药物，让LLM推断合理的临床变化生成合成数据；(2) 指令微调(LLM_IT)：使用LLaMA 3.1 8B通过LoRA在医学记录摘要任务上进行微调，以对齐LLM的临床推理能力与推荐任务；(3) 药物推荐模型(LLM_REC)：基于指令微调后的LLM顺序推荐药物，将先前推荐的药物作为上下文，使用文本表示和ID表示联合输入，并按训练集中出现频率升序排列真实药物以优先处理罕见药。

Result: 在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV两个数据集上的实验表明，GenRxR在大多数评估指标上优于14个基线方法(包括5个LLM基线和9个SOTA药物推荐系统)。在罕见药组(Group 1)上，Macro Jaccard相对最强基线提升30.17%(MIMIC-III)、22.84%(MIMIC-IV)，Macro F1提升30.88%、25.20%；DDI比率(8.29和7.71)接近真实值(8.26和7.89)，表明安全性未受损。消融实验证实反事实数据和指令微调均有效。可信度评估显示，人类专家准确率仅0.45，多个LLM评估器准确率0.50-0.61，表明生成的对抗事实数据与原始数据难以区分。

Conclusion: GenRxR通过反事实数据增强、指令微调和LLM集成，有效缓解了罕见药数据稀缺问题，并建模共推荐药物关系，在不损害常用药性能的前提下将罕见药预测性能最高提升30.9%。未来工作应扩大临床验证规模、增加多位临床医生评估，并加入除DDI比率外的药物-疾病冲突等安全检查。

Abstract: AI-based medication recommendation systems have attracted substantial attention due to their potential to enhance patient safety and therapeutic outcomes. Despite the clinical importance of accurately recommending rarely prescribed medications (rare-meds), we observe that most existing methods show significantly lower predictive performance for rare-meds. We attribute this issue to two intrinsic limitations: (a) the inherent scarcity of data for rare-meds and (b) limited consideration of co-recommended medications. To address these limitations, we propose GenRxR, a novel framework based on large language models (LLMs). GenRxR leverages the medical knowledge and clinical reasoning capability of LLMs to generate counterfactual medical data, mitigating the data scarcity issue for rare-meds. It also integrates an LLM into the medication recommendation process to model relationships among co-recommended medications. To further enhance the clinical reasoning, we introduce an instruction tuning step that aligns the LLM's capability with the recommendation task, enabling better handling of clinical context, including rare-meds cases. In our experiments, we show that GenRxR outperforms 14 (including 5 LLM-based) baselines in most cases. Specifically, it achieves up to 30.9% higher predictive performance for rare-meds than the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [152] [SearchArt: Training Long-Horizon Search Agent with Scalable Synthetic and Verified Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24850)
*Lang Mei,Xiaohan Yu,Chong Chen,Liyan Liu,Xiangnan Chen,Jinchao Ma,Chao Feng,Li Huang,Siyu Mo,Sichen Kang,Yunkun Xu,Zhihan Yang,Zhujun Xue,Jingren Zhang,Qing He,Yingdi Huang,Hao Jiang,Ziao Ma,Zewei Pan,Minhao Sun,Zhuo Tao,Jinzhao Xiao,Gangtao Xin,Huanyao Zhang,Wenjian Zhang,Jiangshan Zhang,Guojie Zhu,Jiaxin Mao,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SearchArt 是一个用于训练长视野（long-horizon）搜索智能体的可扩展框架，通过"验证驱动的任务合成"与"多阶段后训练流水线"（监督微调 + 强化学习策略优化），仅用 27B 参数的 Qwen3.5 模型就在 BrowseComp-ZH、BrowseComp 与 Deepresearch-bench 等深度搜索/深度研究基准上达到或超越了前沿闭源智能体的水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管 LLM 已使搜索智能体能自主处理复杂任务，但在长视野场景下训练有效智能体仍面临三大挑战：（1）缺乏可扩展的长视野任务数据；（2）难以评估中间推理与工具调用行为的正确性；（3）缺乏对中间步骤的纠错机制。现有方法难以同时兼顾数据规模、轨迹质量与行为可靠性。

Method: SearchArt 框架包含两大核心模块：（1）验证驱动的任务合成——从 Web 文档与自动生成的证据图（evidence graph）中合成多样化的信息检索 QA 对及其搜索轨迹，并通过联合评估 QA 一致性、轨迹质量与检索证据相关性的验证管线确保数据可靠性；（2）多阶段后训练——在经过验证的轨迹上依次进行监督微调（SFT）和基于强化学习的策略优化，使智能体具备自适应搜索规划、迭代证据聚合与长程复杂推理能力。

Result: 仅使用 27B 参数的 Qwen3.5 模型，SearchArt 在三个高难度基准上取得领先成绩：BrowseComp-ZH 得分 74.39、BrowseComp 得分 70.06、Deepresearch-bench 得分 52.55，性能匹配或超越前沿闭源智能体，在 deepsearch 与 deepresearch 两类任务上均表现优异。

Conclusion: SearchArt 证明了通过"可扩展的任务合成 + 严格的轨迹验证 + 多阶段训练（SFT + RL）"这一范式，能够以中等规模开源模型实现与闭源前沿智能体相媲美的长视野搜索与深度研究能力，为训练可靠的智能体提供了一条数据驱动且可扩展的路径。

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled search agents to autonomously tackle complex tasks across extended search and reasoning horizons. However, training effective search agents remains challenging due to the lack of scalable and long-horizon tasks, and the difficulty of evaluating and correcting intermediate reasoning and tool-use behaviors. We introduce SearchArt, a scalable framework for training long-horizon search agents through verification-driven task synthesis and a multi-stage post-training pipeline. SearchArt constructs large-scale datasets for complex search-, research- and user-oriented tasks by synthesizing diverse information-seeking QA pairs and corresponding search trajectories from web documents and automatically generated evidence graphs. To ensure the reliability of the synthesized data, we design a verification pipeline that jointly evaluates QA consistency, trajectory quality, and the relevance of retrieved evidence. The verified trajectories are subsequently used in a multi-stage training process comprising supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning-based policy optimization. Search agents trained with SearchArt exhibit adaptive search planning, iterative evidence aggregation, and complex reasoning over extended interaction horizons. Experimental results demonstrate that, with only (Qwen3.5-) 27B parameters, SearchArt scores 74.39 on BrowseComp-ZH, 70.06 on BrowseComp, and 52.55 on Deepresearch-bench, matching or surpassing frontier closed-source agents on both deepsearch and deepresearch benchmarks.

</details>


### [153] [Ranked by Position: Order Sensitivity as an Exploitable Attack Surface in LLM Listwise Recommenders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24869)
*Ge Zhang,Jingru Cheng,Huiyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了LLM列表式重排序器中候选项目排列顺序构成可被利用的攻击面。攻击者仅通过重新排序候选集合（不改变内容、标签或模型参数），即可将label-0的非正样本目标提升至top-k。论文提出promo@k指标量化该漏洞，发现在MovieLens、Amazon Books、Amazon Fashion三个领域上，50次排列预算下promo@5可达0.57，位置稳定性的Kendall's τ可作为免攻击的审计信号，一致性正则化和架构不变性可有效缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将LLM排序器对候选顺序的敏感视为稳定性问题或评估噪声，通过排列平均或位置鲁棒训练来缓解。本文认为该视角低估了风险：由于候选集合在语义上是无序的，系统性地依赖呈现顺序构成一个可被操控的输入通道而非随机噪声。因此，作者将候选顺序操纵重新定义为对列表式重排序器的对抗性攻击。

Method: 1. 威胁模型：攻击者仅控制候选呈现顺序π，预算受限（R次排列），目标是label-0样本，可保留使目标获得最佳排名的排列。2. 核心指标promo@k：计算平均排名≥k但对抗排名<k的label-0目标占比，量化新制造出的top-k曝光。3. 实验设置：使用LoRA微调，以LambdaRank损失训练，覆盖MovieLens-32M、Amazon Books、Amazon Fashion三个领域，候选集K=25，锚点模型为Llama-3.2-3B，附加Qwen3（0.6B-14B）、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B和ListT5式编码器。4. 防御方案：架构不变性（InvariRank）、排列一致性KL正则化、点对点评分、测试时顺序平均。5. 审计信号：使用普通排列稳定性（Kendall's τ）来预测可利用性。

Result: 主要发现：1. 因果重排序器存在结构化位置偏见（label-0位置曲线范围3.09），位置不变重排序器几乎平坦（0.06）。2. 在MovieLens锚点上，50次排列预算下，promo@5=0.120，排名提升3.34位，27.3%的目标进入top-5。3. Amazon领域更严重：Amazon Books的promo@5高达0.570（Qwen3-8B），Fashion达0.387（Qwen3-4B）。4. 利用性不随模型规模单调下降，领域特征影响更显著。5. 排列稳定性与可利用性呈强负相关（Pearson r=-0.974），可作为审计信号。6. 架构不变性完全消除攻击通道（promo@5=0），一致性正则化大幅降低（0.007-0.067），但有nDCG代价。7. 提示工程（5种风格）无法关闭攻击面，证明该偏见是机制性的而非指令性的。8. 位置操纵的杠杆（1.86位增益）远强于简单内容编辑（0.33位）。

Conclusion: 候选顺序是列表式LLM重排序器可被操纵的攻击面，而非仅仅是稳定性问题。跨模型和领域，仅通过重新排序即可推广label-0目标，且在更大查询预算和更不稳定的重排序器下曝光更严重。排列稳定性提供了实用的审计信号。一致性正则化可缓解大部分曝光，架构不变性则可彻底消除测试的攻击通道，但有领域依赖的排序质量成本。列表式重排序器应将排列鲁棒性视为安全要求而非仅稳定性属性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) used as listwise rerankers in recommendation systems suffer from position bias when serializing candidate sets into prompts. We show this order sensitivity creates an exploitable attack surface: an attacker can promote a label-0 target into the top-$k$ solely by reordering candidates, without changing item content, labels, or model parameters. We introduce $\mathrm{promo}@k$ to quantify this vulnerability, measuring the fraction of label-0 targets that can be elevated into top-$k$ rankings via permutation. Evaluating across three domains (MovieLens, Amazon Books, and Amazon Fashion), $\mathrm{promo}@5$ reaches up to 0.57 at an attack budget of $R$ = 50 orderings. Furthermore, ordinary permutation stability predicts vulnerability without running the attack. While a bidirectional T5 encoder scorer reduces exposure, permutation-consistency regularization and architectural invariance effectively mitigate it. Pointwise scoring avoids the bias issue but degrades ranking quality. These results demonstrate that input candidate order in listwise LLM reranking is a security-relevant attack vector. Code and data are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [154] [ScoreShield: Differentially Private Release of Similarity Scores](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25041)
*Behrooz Razeghi,Parsa Rahimi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: ScoreShield 是一种扰动-后投影（perturb-then-project）机制，用于在差分隐私（DP）约束下发布余弦相似度分数向量和 Gram 矩阵。它通过添加与全局敏感度匹配的 Gaussian 噪声，然后投影到有效余弦对象的可行集上，在隐私保证和效用之间取得了显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多应用（如生物识别、RAG）依赖通过 API 发布的余弦相似度分数进行排序和验证，但这些分数会泄露个体记录信息并面临成员推断攻击。传统差分隐私机制（如对向量元素添加 i.i.d. Gaussian 噪声）在给定隐私约束下产生过度失真（低效用），且随发布分数数量增加扩展性差（n³ 的平方 Frobenius 风险）。需要一种在保持隐私的同时显著提升效用的方法。

Method: 提出 ScoreShield 机制：1) 添加根据所选分数发布方案的全局敏感度校准的 Gaussian 噪声；2) 将结果投影到有效余弦对象的可行集上。提供精确 Frobenius 度量投影在风险分析中的效用保证，并证明实际平均交替投影求解器在大规模 Gram 释放中的可行性收敛性。理论分析涵盖记录级替换邻接关系下的完全成对余弦 Gram 释放。

Result: 对于记录级替换邻接下的完全成对余弦 Gram 释放，精确投影界将平方 Frobenius 风险的 n 依赖性从朴素 Gaussian 基线的 Θ(n³) 改进为固定隐私参数下的 O(n²)，并在低秩 Gram 情况下提供更精确的局部界。在 RAG、人脸识别、语义检索、图像相似性和推荐系统任务上的实验验证。

Conclusion: ScoreShield 在差分隐私余弦相似度发布问题上显著提升了效用-隐私权衡，将平方 Frobenius 风险从 Θ(n³) 降至 O(n²)，同时保持 (ε,δ)-DP 保证，并在多个实际任务中表现出有效性，是一种实用的隐私保护相似度发布解决方案。

Abstract: A growing number of applications, such as biometrics and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), rely on cosine similarity scores computed between vector embeddings of text, images, or audio. These systems return similarity scores through their APIs for ranking and verification. However, such releases can leak information about individual records and enable membership inference attacks. While differential privacy (DP) provides a principled metric for quantifying attack risks, naïve application of DP mechanisms---such as adding i.i.d. Gaussian noise to vector entries---leads to excessive distortion (i.e., low utility) at a given privacy constraint that scales poorly with the number of released scores. We propose \textsc{ScoreShield}, a perturb-then-project mechanism that adds Gaussian noise calibrated to global sensitivity of the chosen score release regime and then projects the result onto the feasibility set of valid cosine objects. \textsc{ScoreShield} satisfies $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-DP for releasing similarity score vectors and Gram matrices. We provide utility guarantees for the exact Frobenius metric projection used in the risk analysis, and prove convergence to feasibility for the practical averaged alternating-projection solver used for large-scale Gram releases. For full pairwise cosine Gram release under record-level replacement adjacency, the exact-projection bound improves the $n$-dependence of squared Frobenius risk from $\Theta(n^3)$ for the naïve Gaussian baseline to $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ for fixed privacy parameters, with sharper local bounds at low-rank Grams. We evaluate the mechanism across RAG, face recognition, semantic retrieval, image similarity, and recommender-system tasks.

</details>


### [155] [Memory Layer: Train the In-Model Cache for Recommendation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25110)
*Liangyuan Na,Gufan Yin,Yixin Bao,Xianjie Chen,Justin Lin,Ziheng huang,Xinyuan Zhang,Wen Zhang,Hao Lin,Xiaoheng Mao,Shuo Tang,Min Yu,Lei Chen,Chao yang,Ziliang Zhao,Mengjiao Zhou,Zheng Qi,Dmitry Barablin,Chuo-Yun Yang,Kaustubh Vartak,Tingting Zhang,Arun Kumar Singh*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 Memory Layer（记忆层），将推荐系统早期排序阶段中仅服务于推理的物品嵌入缓存转变为训练-推理协同设计的可写可读组件，通过 Writeback 机制在训练中写入、在推理中读取，消除了训练-服务表征差异。该方案已部署在 Instagram Reels，预测覆盖率从 96% 提升到 100%，嵌入时效性从 O(5分钟) 提升到 O(20秒)，训练-服务 NE 差距最多缩小 86%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业级推荐系统的早期排序阶段（ESR）采用双塔架构，物品塔的嵌入在离线预计算并缓存在模型内以满足毫秒级延迟。但该缓存仅存在于推理阶段、训练循环之外，导致三种结构性训练-服务不一致：(1) 物品塔新鲜度不足（服务使用数小时前的锚点检查点）；(2) 特征源差异（训练数据 scribe 与 Hive 反填表不同源）；(3) 缓存未命中行为（训练中永远不会遇到 cache miss）。这些问题造成训练 NE 与服务 NE 之间 5–12% 的差距，并依赖三条独立的更新路径（模型参数流式、全量批量评估、增量物品流式），带来运维脆弱性。

Method: Memory Layer 是一个集成到模型架构中的键值嵌入表：以物品 ID 为键、以物品塔输出为值，采用 MPZCH（多探针零冲突哈希）+ LRU 驱逐实现稀疏嵌入表。核心机制包括：
(1) Writeback：通过自定义 autograd.Function 复用 TBE 的 EXACT_SGD（η=1），将梯度构造为 (cached − target)，实现精确赋值，无需自定义 CUDA 内核；
(2) Always-on 嵌入：对作者 ID、主题 ID 等泛化性特征始终在线计算，使缓存未命中物品也能获得预测，缓存命中时融合两者；
(3) 多表训练：通过双 dataloader 同时读取训练数据和候选池数据，将未标记的候选物品嵌入写入记忆层以保证覆盖率；
(4) 原始嵌入流式（RES）：与 TBE 预取 I/O 共址，从 GPU HBM 捕获更新后的行，每 15 秒批量推送至推理端，P99 端到端时延约 21 秒；
(5) 特征缓存：在 MPZCH 内核层以 2D 运行时元数据存储 int64 物品侧特征，与嵌入共享索引、原子写入与流式传输。
整体设计将三条独立更新路径合并为一条以记忆层为中心的自包含流水线。

Result: 在 Instagram Reels ESR 部署的双塔实例上取得显著效果：
• 预测覆盖率：96% → 100%（新 0.5% 命中由 always-on 嵌入补充）
• 缓存命中率：15 分钟内新内容从 10–20% 提升至接近 100%
• 嵌入时效性：O(5分钟) → O(20秒)，P99 TTS 约 21 秒
• 训练-服务 NE 差距：pselect 任务从 12.11% 降至 1.64%（−86%），reshare 任务从 5.24% 降至 3.42%（−35%）
• 冷启动召回：1 小时内视频观看数 +6–7%，5 分钟内内容提升超 2×
• 参与度：reshare 与时长均 +5–6%
• 冷启动顶层指标：breakout 率 +5–6%，P25 CTI −40–45%
• 效率：训练-发布计算成本降低 30%，服务吞吐量提升 2.42×
• 可靠性：消除了全量快照覆盖导致的周期性新鲜度退化问题

Conclusion: Memory Layer 将只读服务缓存转变为训练-推理共训练的组件，从架构根源上消除了表征不一致，实现训练与服务间的"单一事实来源"，always-on 嵌入保证 100% 覆盖。生产部署验证了质量、可靠性与效率的同时改善。该设计原则具有可扩展性：可推广到跨阶段统一排序、通用特征缓存，以及大语言/视觉语言基础模型集成（通过记忆层实现基础模型端到端协同训练而服务侧零推理成本）。论文的核心理念是：训练与服务路径的协同设计所能带来的提升远超单独优化任一路径所能达到的效果。

Abstract: Early ranking stages in recommendation systems precompute item embeddings and cache them in-model for scoring within strict latency constraints. Because this cache exists only at serving time, outside the training loop, training and serving use different item representations, a structural discrepancy that limits quality and adds operational fragility. We show that co-designing the training and serving paths removes this representation discrepancy at its source. We introduce the memory layer, an in-model key-value embedding cache co-trained with the model: the item tower writes embeddings during training and the model reads them at serving, one source of truth for item representations by construction. Always-on embeddings cover items not yet cached, so every item receives a prediction, and the design consolidates three separate trainer-to-predictor update paths into a single self-contained pipeline. Deployed in production on Instagram Reels, the memory layer raises prediction coverage from 96% to 100%, improves embedding freshness from $O(5\text{ min})$ to $O(20\text{ s})$, and narrows the training-serving Normalized Entropy (NE) gap by up to 86%, yielding over $2\times$ recall for the freshest content and a 5-6% cold start engagement lift. Because embeddings are produced during training, the system needs no separate bulk-evaluation or publish-time recomputation, cutting training-and-publish computational cost by 30% at neutral serving computational cost.

</details>


### [156] [Sharpness-aware Model Merging with Salience Recovery for LLM-based Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25366)
*Huwei Ji,Jiajie Su,Yuyuan Li,Xiaohua Feng,Chaochao Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 SharpRec 框架,针对基于 LLM 的跨域序列推荐(CDSR)中模型合并(Model Merging)范式面临的两个关键瓶颈:跨域知识冲突(B1)和多域融合性能饱和(B2),分别引入锐度感知几何对齐(SGA)模块和偏好显著性激活(PSA)模块,以打破合并模型在多源域融合时的性能上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的 CDSR 方法存在两类瓶颈:(1)合并异构域(如 Sport-Toy)时,各域 LoRA 适配器收敛到不同且几何不兼容的"sharp minima",导致参数向量在高维空间中纠缠碰撞,产生负迁移,且单纯调优线性合并权重 λ 无法解决该问题;(2)随着源域数量增加,线性加权聚合充当均值滤波器,使参数分布逐渐高斯化,侵蚀高幅值显著性参数,造成高阶用户偏好信号被平滑抹除,性能在 3-4 个源域后趋于饱和。因此核心问题归结为合并过程中的参数级未对齐(parameter-level misalignment)与统计同质化(statistical homogenization)。

Method: SharpRec 包含两个协同模块:1)锐度感知几何对齐(SGA):在域内微调阶段,将域损失重铸为 min-max 锐度感知目标 min_θ max_{|ε|≤ρ} L(θ+ε),通过自适应扰动 ε̂=ρ·θ_k²·∇L/|∇L| 将各域适配器引导至平坦极小值(flat minima),使异构域落入几何连通的低损盆地;理论证明合并干扰误差 |δ| 受 Hessian 谱范数 σ(θ) 与域间距离 ‖θ_A-θ_B‖² 的乘积上界约束,因此最小化锐度即可保证融合鲁棒性。2)偏好显著性激活(PSA):合并后对参数施加非线性重参数化,先注入高斯噪声 θ̃=θ_merge-G 偏离均值中心,再施加 T(θ̃)=sign(θ̃)·|θ̃|^γ·(1+αe^{-β|θ̃|}),0<γ<1,诱导重尾分布以恢复被线性聚合压平的显著性参数;理论证明 PSA 提升了模型函数空间覆盖率 C(F) 积分,放大长尾用户兴趣的表征能力。

Result: 在双域与多域 CDSR 场景下进行大量实验,SharpRec 一致优于 SOTA 基线(包括 X-Cross、WeaveRec 等模型合并方法);消融实验验证了 SGA 与 PSA 各自的有效性与协同性;参数分布可视化显示 SGA 缓解了几何纠缠,PSA 成功将合并后的高斯分布恢复为重尾分布,从而分别破解了负迁移和性能饱和两个核心瓶颈。

Conclusion: SharpRec 为 LLM-based CDSR 提供了一种融合锐度感知优化与分布恢复的新范式,实现了稳健且可扩展的跨域知识迁移。其理论贡献在于:将合并干扰上界形式化为锐度与域差异的乘积,并以函数空间覆盖率为指标证明 PSA 能突破线性融合的均值瓶颈。该框架在多源域场景下显著提升目标域性能,验证了"几何对齐 + 分布重塑"双模块设计在突破合并性能上限方面的有效性。

Abstract: LLM-based Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation (CDSR) leverages LLMs to enhance target performance via deep semantic reasoning, alleviating the dependency on overlapping users. Among LLM-based paradigms, model merging is particularly promising for multi-domain scenarios due to its superior scalability and flexibility in integrating diverse knowledge sources. However, our empirical investigations reveal two critical bottlenecks: (1) cross-domain knowledge conflict; and (2) performance saturation in multi-domain fusion. Our analysis attributes these phenomena to parameter-level misalignment and statistical homogenization during the merging process. To address these bottlenecks, we propose SharpRec, Sharpness-aware Model Merging with Salience Recovery for LLM-based CDSR, a framework designed to lift the performance upper bound of merged models. SharpRec incorporates two synergistic modules: Sharpness-aware Geometric Alignment to establish a stable geometric foundation for interference-free fusion; and Preference Salience Activation to effectively recover the distinctive features essential for bolstering target domain performance. Extensive experiments in both dual-domain and multi-domain scenarios demonstrate that SharpRec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [157] [Aethel: A Reproducible Graph-Retrieval Framework for Multi-Hop Financial Diligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24826)
*Krish Sapru*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Aethel是一个用于多跳金融尽职调查的可复现图检索框架，结合了二部个性化PageRank图检索、核心ference感知的BCT层和编排式专家代理架构。在封闭候选池中提升命中率覆盖，但在开放语料库规模下BM25仍是基线优势，揭示了图RAG的尺度依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二级私募股权交易需要在碎片化、非结构化的金融披露中快速综合信息，而关键指标与其实体锚点分散在词汇重叠有限的独立文档中。现有密集型RAG在单跳查询有效，但在度量与锚定实体跨文档分离时失效，导致下游LLM产生幻觉。需要一种能通过关系路径传播相关性、支持多跳推理的可解释检索框架。

Method: 1. 二部实体-段落图表示：将语料建模为段落节点和实体节点的二部图，边表示共现关系。2. 个性化PageRank (PPR)：基于查询实体构建个性化向量，通过幂迭代求解稳态概率分布，阻尼因子α=0.15，迭代上限20次。3. Bipartite Coreference Teleportation (BCT)层：通过别名匹配和子串重叠扩展个性化向量中的实体提及，以提升命中率。4. 图过滤专家群架构：编排器将多面查询分解为子任务，分发给流动性专家、估值审计师、尽职调查审计师、市场研究专家等专家节点，最后由合成器整合。

Result: 封闭池评估（200个MuSiQue和2WikiMultiHopQA样本）：Aethel在2WikiMultiHopQA上HR@5达100.0%，在MuSiQue上HR@5达88.5%，均优于纯图检索（PPR），但以HR@1精度为代价。开放语料库评估（4,123块金融披露，40个手工标注查询）：BM25最强，HR@5为0.700；Aethel-NER3多跳HR@5为0.600（优于密集检索的0.450），但未超越BM25。混合RRF融合MRR为0.479 vs BM25的0.468，但配对bootstrap显示差异不显著（95% CI [-0.163, +0.192]）。尺度敏感性分析显示密集检索随语料规模扩大崩溃0.390，而图检索对密集检索的优势从500块开始显现并扩大至0.150。

Conclusion: 图RAG的多跳优势具有尺度依赖性。在小候选池（10-20段落）中清晰可见，但无法在开放语料库规模上超越强大的BM25词法基线。最显著的尺度效应是密集检索自身的崩溃——小规模时最强，生产规模时最弱。实体索引质量对图检索性能至关重要。核心实证发现是图检索的增益取决于语料规模和实体索引质量，在关键词密集的金融文本上开放语料库规模下BM25仍是主导基线。未来工作包括尺度感知播种和更大规模的PE尽职调查基准测试。

Abstract: Secondary private equity transactions require rapid synthesis of fragmented, unstructured financial disclosures, where critical metrics and their entity anchors are distributed across disjoint documents with limited lexical overlap. We present Aethel, a reproducible framework that combines bipartite Personalized PageRank graph retrieval with a coreference-aware Bipartite Coreference Teleportation layer and an orchestrated specialist-agent architecture. Aethel models corpora as entity-passage graphs and propagates relevance through explicit relational paths to support multi-hop financial diligence. We evaluate the retrieval layer on 200-question samples from the MuSiQue and 2WikiMultiHopQA validation sets, comparing sparse lexical, dense bi-encoder, vanilla graph, and coreference-aware graph retrieval. Aethel achieves HR@5 of 100.0% on 2WikiMultiHopQA and 88.5% on MuSiQue, improving coverage over vanilla graph retrieval while trading off top-rank precision. We also evaluate retrieval over a 4,123-chunk corpus of financial disclosures and find that graph retrieval outperforms dense retrieval on multi-hop recall but does not surpass a strong BM25 baseline at open-corpus scale. The results show that graph-based retrieval offers interpretable multi-hop evidence paths and degrades more gracefully than dense retrieval as corpus size grows, while also demonstrating that its advantage depends strongly on corpus scale and entity-index quality. Code and evaluation artifacts are released for reproducibility.

</details>


### [158] [Retrieval, not hallucinations, will be the limiting factor for LLM-based clinical AI tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24793)
*Kirk Roberts,Steven Bedrick,Kurt Miller,William R. Hersh,Hongfang Liu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文主张,基于LLM的临床AI工具的主要瓶颈不是人们普遍关注的幻觉(hallucinations)等精确性(precision)错误,而是检索阶段的召回率(recall)错误——即未能从患者电子健康记录(EHR)中检索到关键信息。由于召回错误缺乏像"引用来源"那样的通用缓解策略,且难以评估,可能成为"沉默的杀手",严重危害临床决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前关于LLM临床AI工具的讨论几乎完全聚焦于幻觉等精确性错误(Type I),而忽视了召回错误(Type II,即遗漏关键患者信息)。作者通过定性访谈发现,8位临床医生均自发提及幻觉担忧,但无一主动考虑召回错误;经提示后才意识到其严重性。精确性错误可通过引用来源进行人工核查,但召回错误缺乏类似的缓解手段,可能"无声地"危及患者安全。

Method: 这是一篇视角性(perspective)文章,采用类比信息检索中的Type I/II错误框架,将LLM错误分为精确性错误(输出未由患者数据支撑的断言,即幻觉/虚构)和召回错误(遗漏患者数据中已存在的重要信息)。文章:1)分析了四种典型临床AI任务(诊断推荐、问题导向摘要、问答、笔记生成)中两类错误的具体表现;2)对比了LLM与核心信息检索技术的进展速度;3)综述了检索评估方法(TREC pooling、nugget评估、LLM-as-a-judge)及其在召回评估上的固有困难。

Result: 1)LLM自Transformer(2017)以来进步迅猛,而核心检索引擎(BM25或基于LLM的稠密检索)进步相对缓慢,且稠密检索常需与BM25插值才能保持稳健性(TREC-COVID初期由1960年代系统胜出即为佐证);2)检索评估的"pooling"方法存在系统多样性偏差,新系统可能因返回pool之外的相关文档而处于劣势;3)生成任务评估(BLEU/ROUGE)只能评估精确性,无法评估召回;nugget评估虽可同时评估两者,但依赖人工标注;4)LLM-as-a-judge存在循环依赖问题——能可靠评判的系统理论上也能生成答案。

Conclusion: 召回错误将成为LLM临床AI工具的主要限制因素,因为:1)其缺乏类似精确性错误的通用缓解策略;2)EHR数据量持续增长(尤其在互操作性推动下),检索难度随之上升;3)评估召回本身极为困难。文章呼吁加强对召回错误的研究与评估,在临床AI工具部署时应采用混合评估方法(人工+LLM辅助),以避免召回错误"无声地"导致患者伤害。

Abstract: Discussions around large language model (LLM) errors in clinical artificial intelligence (AI) generally center around precision errors like hallucinations. This perspective, targeting both clinicians and AI researchers, seeks to shift that discussion to recall errors, particularly in retrieval of patient-level data needed for many clinical AI tools. The perspective outlines types of errors and mitigation strategies, describes research directions in LLMs and retrieval, and provides an overview of retrieval evaluation.

</details>


### [159] [Influence of Prompt Engineering on Small Language Models for Guarded Query Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24801)
*Richard Šléher,William Brach,Kristián Košťál,Lukas Galke Poech*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文研究紧凑型开放权重小型语言模型(SLMs)在"守卫式查询路由"(Guarded Query Routing, GQR)任务中的表现,探索仅通过提示工程优化能否使其同时完成域内查询分发与域外查询拒绝两项任务,而无需修改模型权重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 守卫式路由器部署在LLM请求的关键路径上,其延迟直接影响每次系统调用;同时其误判代价高昂——不安全查询可能泄漏到下游专家,而合法查询可能被误拒。传统设计将分类器与安全护栏分开,导致两次决策可能不一致且开销翻倍。因此,探索紧凑开放权重SLMs能否通过单一前向传播联合完成分发与拒绝决策,在保持低延迟的同时达到接近前沿模型的路由质量,具有重要的实际部署价值。

Method: 1. 在GQR-Bench上对来自10个模型家族的22个开放权重模型(270M至70B参数)进行基准测试,使用调和平均GQR-Score评估;2. 选取7个具有代表性的模型(0.8B–9B),对比四种提示策略:标准提示、DSPy基线签名(无样本)、DSPy的BootstrapFewShotWithRandomSearch(Few-Shot)以及GEPA进化式提示优化;3. 所有实验在双RTX 4090单机上运行,使用vLLM和贪心解码,单次请求测量延迟。

Result: 1. 中等规模SLMs可接近前沿模型路由质量:Gemma 3 27B(96.01)、Llama 3.3 70B(95.65)、Gemma 3 12B(95.57)仅相差0.44分;2. 弱模型失败模式明确——OOD拒绝率高但ID分类低,如Llama 3.2 3B(OOD 99.97%但ID仅18.11%)、Granite 4 Tiny(OOD 99.75%但ID仅37.29%);3. Few-Shot优化将Qwen3.5 9B提升至95.74(距最佳未优化模型仅0.3分),Mistral 7B从81.79升至90.87,Granite 4 Tiny在DSPy基线下从54.29跃升至83.05;4. 提升主要来自ID路由恢复而非OOD改进;5. GEPA在所有7个模型中均未取得最佳分数,提示在分类任务上指令优化空间较为脆弱;6. 提示优化使延迟增加2-6倍(从0.02-0.05秒升至0.05-0.28秒)。

Conclusion: 提示优化是守卫式查询路由的有效第一步:中型SLMs经Few-Shot优化后可达前沿模型水平,且延迟更低。但弱模型(尤其低于1B参数)仍可能需要权重级适配(如LoRA/QLoRA)或模式感知训练;对于已校准良好的模型,过度提示反而可能损害性能。研究还指出单一GQR-Score掩盖了多种失败模式(缺乏领域知识、格式遵循失败、原则性拒绝),未来需在更细粒度标签与层级弃权结构下展开评估,并结合轻量级适配方法以更稳定地绑定紧凑模型到允许的标签集。

Abstract: We study the problem of guarded query routing, where we assume that a user query first meets a router that either determines the ideal endpoint for in-distribution queries or rejects out-of-distribution queries that are potentially unsafe or out of the system's scope. We investigate whether compact open-weight Small Language Models (SLMs) can jointly handle both tasks under latency constraints. We evaluate 22 models on GQR-Bench and score them with the harmonic mean of in-distribution and out-of-distribution accuracy. We find that mid-scale SLMs come close to frontier model routing quality at much lower latency. Still, many compact models fail because they do not reliably follow the required output format. However, our results show that prompt optimization techniques enable SLMs to handle such cases gracefully, without changing the models' weights. Moreover, few-shot prompt optimization raises Mistral 7B from 81.79 to 90.87 GQR-Score and lifts Qwen3.5 9B to 95.74, the best optimized score in our study and within 0.3 points of the strongest unoptimized larger model: Gemma 3 27B at 96.01. The bare DSPy signature, without in-context exemplars, is the most effective strategy for Granite 4 Tiny, raising its score from 54.29 to 83.05. These results show that prompt optimization is a useful first step for guarded query routing, while weaker models may still need weight-level adaptation or schema-aware training

</details>


### [160] [SourceMinds at CheckThat! 2026: NLI-Grounded Citation Auditing in a Multi-Agent Pipeline for Full Fact-Checking Article Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24802)
*Farhan Sharukh Hasan,Anirban Saha Anik,Eric Liu,Xiaoying Song,Mohotarema Rashid,Lingzi Hong*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了 SourceMinds 系统，用于 CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab Task 3（从声明、真伪标签和证据文档生成完整的事实核查文章）。系统采用多智能体流水线：密集检索 + 交叉编码器重排序 + 来源平衡选择构建证据集，Fact Planner 生成结构化 JSON 计划，Article Writer 生成带内联引用的 250–450 词文章，门控 Self-Critique 仅在引用稀疏时触发修订，NLI Citation Auditor 通过三遍规则操作（移除无效引用、补充缺失引用、剪枝冗余引用）验证引用质量。在 1,158 条测试集上获得平均分 0.329（基线 0.272），证据覆盖率和引用指标显著优于基线，但全局蕴含分数（0.245）低于基线（0.298），表明句子级引用正确并不等同于证据到结论的全局论证对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自动事实核查系统主要聚焦于声明检测、证据检索、真伪预测和解释生成等子任务，缺乏将整个事实核查过程整合为完整文章、清晰呈现证据并为读者论证最终裁决的端到端能力。Task 3 要求生成有证据支撑、带引用的事实核查长文，这是一个证据基础写作问题而非简单提示问题，需要专门的流水线设计来处理证据选择、结构化规划、引用管理和事后验证。

Method: 1. **问题形式化**：f(C,M,V,E)→A，将文章生成视为证据条件下的长文生成；将给定裁决 V 视为强先验而非不可质疑的标签，提示中要求在证据冲突时如实报告。2. **证据检索智能体**：稳健加载（JSON/JSONL/原始文本级联回退）→ 滑动窗口分块（2 句窗口，步长 1）→ Sentence-BERT (all-mpnet-base-v2) 密集检索 top-60 → bge-reranker-v2-m3 交叉编码器重排 → 来源平衡选择（每源最多 2 块，共 10 块）。3. **Fact Planner 智能体**（Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, T=0.0）：基于证据生成 JSON 结构计划（claim interpretation、verdict、main reason、supporting points、evidence quotes、URLs、caveats）；JSON 解析失败时使用严格重试提示重试一次。4. **Article Writer 智能体**（T=0.2, top-p=0.9, 重复惩罚 1.05）：基于计划生成 250–450 词新闻风格文章，每句必须带 (source: URL) 内联引用，多源用分号分隔。5. **Self-Critique 智能体**（门控，T=0.15）：仅在引用数 <3、唯一来源数 <2 或存在未引用的事实句时触发；逐句检查引用支撑性并修订，否则 A₁=A₀；长度或引用被破坏的修订将被丢弃回退到原草稿。6. **NLI Citation Auditor 智能体**（roberta-large-mnli，蕴含阈值 0.5，非提示式）：三遍规则——(a) 移除不在前提集中的 URL；(b) 对未引用事实句做嵌入相似度 top-3 候选 + NLI 蕴含验证以补充引用；(c) 在剩余引用仍蕴含该句且被丢弃源边际贡献 ≤0.05 时剪枝冗余引用；每遍后重新过滤无效引用。

Result: 在 CLEF 2026 Task 3 官方测试集（1,158 条声明，平均 7.8 篇前提文章）上的官方指标：平均分 **0.329**（基线 0.272）。具体指标对比基线：**Entailment 0.245**（基线 0.298，唯一低于基线）、**Citation Precision 0.337**（基线 0.223）、**Citation Recall 0.339**（基线 0.240）、**Evidence Coverage 0.394**（基线 0.329）。证据覆盖率最高说明检索与来源平衡选择有效；引用精确率与召回率均显著高于基线，表明 NLI 审计器的严格"每个引用都必要"准则与提示中要求每句带引用共同生效；蕴含分数偏低说明句子级局部正确引用并不能复现参考文章从证据到裁决的全局论证链条。

Conclusion: 将事实核查文章生成分解为检索、结构化规划、写作、门控修订和 NLI 引用审计的模块化流水线是有效的，相比基线在引用质量与证据覆盖方面获得明显提升，且无需任务特定微调、便于部署。然而，全局蕴含分数的下降揭示出引用存在≠证据真正支撑生成内容——句子级局部接地不蕴含文章级论证对齐。未来工作应(1) 在生成前显式构建从证据到裁决的论证链而非事后逐句验证接地；(2) 为生成与批评使用不同模型族以提升自修订独立性；(3) 引入更强的判定模型或验证器集成；(4) 探索轻量微调与偏好优化以同时改善四项指标。

Abstract: This paper presents our system for Task 3 of the CLEF 2026 CheckThat! Lab, which focuses on generating full fact-checking articles from claims, veracity labels, and evidence documents. We propose a multi-agent pipeline that combines evidence retrieval, structured fact planning, article generation, gated self-critique, and NLI-based citation auditing. The system retrieves claim-relevant evidence using dense retrieval, reranking, and source-balanced selection, then generates a citation-supported article from a structured plan. A gated self-critique stage revises weakly grounded drafts, while the NLI citation auditor repairs missing citations and removes unsupported or redundant ones. The approach highlights the importance of combining evidence selection, structured generation, and post-generation citation validation for source-grounded fact-checking article generation.

</details>


### [161] [SciClaimSeekers at CheckThat! 2026: Retrieving Scientific Sources for Social Media Claims with LLM Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24803)
*Mohotarema Rashid,Nansu Baniya,Anirban Saha Anik,Xiaoying Song,Lingzi Hong*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文提出了SciClaimSeekers系统，一个用于科学来源检索的三阶段retrieve-then-rerank框架。该系统结合BM25稀疏检索与多语言E5密集检索，通过RRF（k=60）融合候选集，再利用Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct进行零样本逐点重排序，在CLEF-2026 CheckThat! Task 1评测中以64.39% MRR@5排名第11/37。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学类声明在社交媒体上传播速度远超人工核查速度，且帖子很少附带原始学术来源。社交媒体语言非正式、与科学文献存在语言和结构上的不匹配，给自动化溯源带来了巨大挑战。因此亟需有效的检索与重排序框架，将社交媒体帖子准确链接回原始科学论文。

Method: 系统采用三阶段架构：1）第一阶段并行运行BM25稀疏检索与multilingual-e5-large-instruct密集检索，各返回top-100候选；2）第二阶段使用Reciprocal Rank Fusion（k=60）融合两个排序列表，输出top-50候选；3）第三阶段使用Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct作为零样本逐点交叉编码器重排序，对每篇候选独立打分（0–10分），按分数排序取top-5作为最终预测。论文表示仅用标题与抽象拼接索引，忽略元数据。硬件为两块A40 GPU（46GB），使用vLLM推理。

Result: 在英文开发集（3,905条）和测试集（6,076条）上，SciClaimSeekers取得MRR@5分别为64.36%和64.39%（Hit@1约58%，Hit@5约73.5%）。关键消融结果：BM25基线50.21%→E5密集52.65%→BM25+E5 RRF融合54.19%→加入Qwen2.5-14B重排序后达64.39%，总体比BM25提升约13.67点，其中LLM重排序贡献约+10点（约3/4的提升来自LLM reranker）。BGE-reranker-v2-m3交叉编码器在开发集仅带来+0.93点提升，但在测试集反而下降1.55点，提示过拟合。BM25+Qwen重排序组合也达到60.73%，表明LLM重排序增益大部分独立于第一阶段检索器。最终系统在37支参赛队中排名第11。

Conclusion: 论文验证了两点发现：1）LLM重排序是主要增益来源，Qwen2.5-14B贡献约+10 MRR@5，无论第一阶段是BM25还是混合检索；2）混合检索与重排序具有叠加效应，RRF融合的一阶段小幅度提升在LLM重排序后被放大。系统全流程开源、模块化，可运行于单节点双GPU，适配隐私敏感或离线部署场景。局限性方面，仅评测了英文分片、忽略元数据特征，且LLM重排序耗时较长（约11小时/6,076条查询），未来将探索RAG增强、列表式推理及模型蒸馏等方向。

Abstract: Scientific claims often spread on social media faster than they can be verified, while posts rarely link to the original scholarly sources. To tackle this problem this paper presents system called SciClaimSeekers, a retrieval and reranking framework by combining BM25 and zero-shot multilingual E5 retrieval with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60), followed by Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct pointwise reranking. The pipeline reaches 64.36% MRR@5 on the English development set a 13.67-point jump over BM25 and 10.17 points over the unranked hybrid and 64.39% on the official test set, in the CLEF-2026 CheckThat! Task 1 evaluation. Our experiment suggests that large pre-trained models, when combined into a careful pipeline, can be competitive with fine-tuned approaches on this task.

</details>


### [162] [CHaystack: Benchmarking Chinese Document Retrieval and VQA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24760)
*Hanxi Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了CHaystack，一个面向大规模中文文档检索与视觉问答（DocumentVQA）的新基准，涵盖学术论文、广告、网页和实拍文档四类文档，并设计了一个基于VLM相关性过滤器的RAG系统CDocRAG。实验表明，Qwen系列模型在文本密集型文档上表现优异，而其他模型在视觉密集型广告上更具竞争力，但整体上中文大规模文档VQA仍有较大提升空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着RAG从纯文本扩展到多模态场景，DocumentVQA已从单文档问答演化为大规模文档集合上的检索-生成流水线。然而，现有的中文DocumentVQA基准（如DuReader、MosaicDoc）在文档多样性和检索规模评估方面存在明显局限：DuReader主要聚焦网页，MosaicDoc主要聚焦报刊杂志且未评估大规模检索能力。因此，亟需一个涵盖多样文档类型并支持大规模检索评估的中文基准。

Method: 1）基准构建：采用锚点驱动的构建流水线，针对文本丰富型文档（学术论文、网页）使用PaddleOCR+DeepSeek-V3提取文本锚点，针对视觉丰富型文档（广告、实拍文档）使用Qwen3-VL提取视觉锚点，然后基于锚点生成查询-答案对，并经过LLM自动过滤和人工审核（剔除答案泄露、隐私泄露、过度泛化、模糊指代等问题样本）。2）系统设计：提出CDocRAG系统，采用"检索—VLM相关性过滤—生成"三阶段架构，先由多模态检索器召回较宽候选集，再用VLM作为相关性过滤器对候选图像进行二元相关性判断，最后将过滤后的候选送入生成器产生答案。3）评估方法：在17,488张文档图像候选池上评估4,543个样本，采用Recall@K进行检索评估，采用精确匹配（EM）和字符级F1进行生成评估。

Result: 检索方面：Qwen3-VL取得最佳性能，全集Recall@1达71.91，远超最佳非Qwen模型（Chinese-CLIP仅14.40）；在网页和论文等文本密集型类别上优势尤为明显。Chinese-CLIP和AltCLIP在广告类别表现相对较好，但在论文和网页类别急剧退化；SigLIP和CLIP整体表现极差（全集Recall@1均低于2%）。生成方面：Qwen2.5-VL以35.44 EM和61.62 F1领先，InternVL2.5次之（20.89 EM/42.64 F1），LLaVA-OneVision表现最差（0.92 EM/19.68 F1）；即使提供金标图像，论文类别仍是最大挑战。消融实验显示，VLM相关性过滤器可将Recall@1从71.82提升至78.32，在广告和论文类别提升最显著。

Conclusion: CHaystack作为一个涵盖四类文档的中文大规模DocumentVQA基准，为中文多模态文档理解提供了更真实、更具挑战性的评估平台。CDocRAG通过VLM相关性过滤有效提升了检索精度。当前开源模型在中文密集文档检索和细粒度答案生成方面仍面临显著挑战，特别是在中文长文本编码能力上存在明显短板，中文大规模DocumentVQA领域仍有较大研究空间。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has made substantial progress in extending the memory of large language models (LLMs), and recent advances have further pushed RAG from pure text settings toward multimodal scenarios. In the document understanding domain, document visual question answering (DocumentVQA) has evolved from question answering over a single document to retrieval-and-generation pipelines over large-scale document collections. However, a benchmark specifically designed for Chinese large-scale document retrieval and question answering is still lacking. To bridge this gap, we introduce CHaystack, a new Chinese DocumentVQA benchmark that covers four document categories, namely academic papers, advertisements, web pages, and real-world photographed documents, enabling a more comprehensive evaluation of DocumentVQA systems. In addition, we present CDocRAG, a Chinese DocumentVQA system that uses a VLM-based relevance filter to verify retrieved document images before answer generation. We evaluate representative open-source embedding and generation models on CHaystack. The results reveal a clear contrast in category-wise strengths: Qwen-family models perform best on text-rich documents such as webpages and papers, whereas other models only achieve competitive results on visually rich categories such as advertisements and degrade sharply on text-dense documents. For retrieval, Qwen3-VL reaches 71.91 Recall@1 while the best non-Qwen model achieves only 14.40. These results indicate that the core challenge of CHaystack lies in Chinese textual encoding, and that Chinese large-scale DocumentVQA still leaves substantial room for improvement. Our code and dateset is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [163] [Prediction Is Not Memory: Dual-Timescale Gated Profile Writing for Persistent User Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24798)
*Ziyide Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文将推荐系统中"预测交互"与"是否写入持久用户画像"这两个常被耦合的决策解耦,提出选择性画像写入控制(SPW-Gate),在MicroLens-100K上将全量写入造成的远期画像伤害从22.45%降至约14.5%,同时保留约77%的写入覆盖率,且证明下一物品预测置信度并不能替代写入风险估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代推荐系统将持久用户画像作为可复用记忆,但现有更新管线隐含"凡观测到的交互都应更新用户表示"的假设。然而短期响应、探索行为、曝光偏差等瞬时信号若被写入持久画像,会污染后续检索、排序和用户理解。预测与持久化是两类不同决策,需要一个管道级的决策边界。

Method: 1) 将交互后是否写入持久画像形式化为选择性写入控制问题;2) 提出时序近/远离线协议——近未来用于弱监督写入风险标签,远未来仅用于评估;3) 定义远期伤害率(far hurt rate)与对齐度等指标;4) 设计SPW-Gate控制器,使用对数历史长度、候选-长期相似度、候选-短期相似度、长短期相似度及漂移间隙等决策时特征,实例化为SPW-Gate-LR(逻辑回归)与SPW-Gate-MLP(双层MLP),通过验证集选择风险阈值与降权系数λ;5) 基线包括无更新/全写入退化参照、恒定权重、滑动窗口、时间衰减、匹配覆盖率的随机策略,以及基于GRU/SASRec/BERT4Rec排序置信度的预测代理。

Result: 在near1_far1主协议下:全量写入远期伤害22.45%;SPW-Gate-LR降至14.71%、SPW-Gate-MLP降至14.54%,覆盖率约77-78%,远期对齐度几乎不变(0.7530-0.7531 vs 0.7537);固定覆盖率(70/80/90%)控制下学习门控持续优于随机与启发式门控;写入风险AUC方面,直接风险门控约0.62,而Markov、流行度、GRU/SASRec/BERT4Rec排序logit均接近随机(0.50-0.52);1000次用户聚类自举显示伤害下降约0.077-0.079,95%CI不跨零;全目录检索兼容性检查(R@10、NDCG@10)与全写入基本持平。

Conclusion: 证据支持一个受限但可信的研究主张:在MicroLens离线近/远代理下,轻量级选择性写入门控能在保留实质覆盖率的同时降低远期画像伤害,且该收益并非仅源于写入更少;预测置信度与持久写入有效性是相关但不等价的信号。核心设计原则是:持久用户记忆应拥有独立的写入边界。该结论尚不构成生产级排序改进或通用长期偏好理论,需跨域数据集与多步持久化等未来工作验证。

Abstract: Persistent user profiles increasingly serve as reusable memory in recommender systems, but common update pipelines conflate two decisions: predicting an interaction and deciding whether it should persist in the profile. After an interaction is observed, many systems treat it as evidence for updating durable user state. This assumption can be harmful when the event reflects transient context, exploration, exposure, or short-term satisfaction rather than stable preference formation. We formulate this boundary as selective profile-write control: after an observed interaction, a system should decide whether, and how strongly, to write it into the persistent profile. We introduce a chronological near/far offline protocol in which near-future evidence provides weak write-risk supervision and far-future evidence is reserved for evaluation. We instantiate the controller as SPW-Gate, a lightweight write-risk gate using long-term, short-term, and candidate-profile drift features. On MicroLens-100K, write-all updating hurts far-future profile alignment in 22.45% of test cases under the main protocol. SPW-Gate reduces far hurt to about 14.5% while preserving about 77% write coverage. Matched-coverage controls and prediction-confidence baselines show that the gain is not merely a by-product of writing less, and that next-item confidence is not a sufficient proxy for persistent write validity.

</details>


### [164] [A Position Paper on Recommender Systems in the Era of Autonomous Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24822)
*Aixin Sun*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该立场论文指出,随着自主代理(如ChatGPT Agent Mode、Claude Cowork)的快速部署,推荐系统的消费者将从单纯的人类用户转变为人与授权代理混合的形态。作者将代理视为独立的、用户对齐的客户端助手(而非平台内置组件),系统性地刻画了人类、代理、平台三方互动的新型生态系统,并从任务定义、评估范式、跨平台聚合、偏好引导四个方向提出了未来研究机遇。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统推荐系统几十年来一直以人类用户为唯一终端进行优化。然而,个人AI助手的兴起(如ChatGPT Agent Mode、Claude Cowork等)使用户可以将复杂的交易型任务(如在线购买)委托给自主代理,推荐系统的消费者生态正在发生根本性范式转变。现有人类中心化RecSys研究在数据集、评估方法、目标建模等方面存在系统性盲点,无法直接迁移到这一新型混合环境中,因此亟需重新审视推荐系统的核心角色、目标函数与优化策略。

Method: 1) **任务形式化重构**:将推荐任务从⟨u, t, 历史交互, 候选条件⟩→R扩展为引入代理、显式目标g_t与请求实体e∈{u, a_u}的混合任务定义,新增代理端的跨平台聚合函数f_{a_u}。2) **三分体动力学分类**:将生态划分为Human-to-Platform(传统优化,利用认知偏差与视觉层级)、Agent-to-Platform(协议驱动,平台试图反向推断用户全局状态,代理需验证约束满足)、Human-to-Agent(代理需主动澄清并准确映射人类潜藏效用)三类交互前沿。3) **批判性回顾**:归纳当前RecSys研究的四大盲点——缺乏系统思维、依赖静态过时数据集、数据集与任务错配、评估有效性危机。4) **研究方向提炼**:提出四个核心转型方向——从偏好建模到任务执行、从离线预测到协议级交互评估、从单平台检索到跨平台经纪、从任务委托到偏好引导。

Result: 论文是一篇立场性论文,未报告具体实证结果。其主要"成果"为:(1)建立了包含显式目标g_t与代理实体的交易型推荐任务形式化框架(定义2.2);(2)提出了刻画人类-代理-平台三方关系的动力学分类体系;(3)总结了人类中心RecSys研究在算法、静态数据、任务错配、评估一致性四个层面的历史性缺陷;(4)明确指出内容型推荐仍主要由人类直接消费,而交易型推荐是代理介入的主要场景。论文同时强调跨平台聚合带来的隐私与数据治理新风险,并将其识别为重要的开放议题(虽超出本文讨论范围)。

Conclusion: 自主代理的兴起使推荐系统必须同时服务人类用户与软件中介,这不仅是用户界面的变化,更是推荐景观向人类偏好、代理中介、平台优化三方复合生态的根本性重构。四个研究方向共同指向从隐式行为推断目标向显式、可验证、基于约束的任务执行转型。该领域亟需能真实反映代理中介场景的数据集,在早期阶段仿真可能是唯一可行路径,但仿真必须反映真实的代理行为(包括部分目标指定、任务中途约束修订、对抗性平台响应),而非理想化交互。隐私、用户同意与跨平台数据治理问题在转型中亦需被认真对待与重新审视。

Abstract: For decades, recommender systems have been optimized to serve human users. However, the rapid deployment of autonomous agents introduces a paradigm shift: recommendation consumers are predicted to be increasingly a mixture of humans and authorized agents acting on their behalf. This position paper reviews insights from prior human-centric RecSys research and outlines the transition to this hybrid environment. In our discussion, we treat agents as independent, user-aligned assistants that act as end-users of recommender systems, rather than platform-built components. We characterize the resulting tripartite interactions among humans, agents, and platforms, highlighting the dynamics that can arise across these relationships. This shift presents new opportunities for RecSys research, while introducing unique challenges for evaluation, alignment, and system design.

</details>


### [165] [Retrieval-based and Fine-tuned LLM Approaches for Industrial Asset Health Monitoring and Decision Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24824)
*Seshu Kumar Damarla,Xiuli Zhu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: This paper compares retrieval-only methods (TF-IDF, BM25, semantic search, hybrid search) and an open-source LLM (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with zero-shot, few-shot, and QLoRA fine-tuning) on the FailureSensorIQ benchmark for industrial failure-sensor diagnostic reasoning. Semantic/hybrid search outperform keyword matching, and fine-tuned LLM achieves best performance, though all methods are sensitive to perturbations.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Industrial machinery fault diagnosis relies heavily on expert experience, which is difficult to transfer to automated systems. The paper aims to investigate how well retrieval-based methods and LLMs can perform failure-sensor diagnostic reasoning, addressing the gap in applying NLP techniques to industrial diagnostics.

Method: The study uses the FailureSensorIQ multiple-choice QA benchmark from IBM Research. Two approaches are compared: (1) Retrieval-only: each option is treated as a query and scored against similar correct/incorrect records from training data using TF-IDF, BM25, semantic search, and hybrid search; (2) LLM-based: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct evaluated via zero-shot prompting, few-shot prompting, and QLoRA fine-tuning. Robustness analysis examines sensitivity to option shuffling, label changes, paraphrasing, and added distractors.

Result: Semantic search and hybrid search outperform pure keyword-matching methods (TF-IDF, BM25), demonstrating that meaning-based similarity is more valuable for industrial failure-sensor reasoning. Among LLM methods, QLoRA fine-tuning yields the best performance, significantly improving over zero-shot and few-shot prompting. Error analysis reveals performance degradation as the number of answer options increases. Robustness analysis shows all methods are sensitive to option shuffling, label changes, paraphrasing, and additional distractor options.

Conclusion: Meaning-based retrieval (semantic/hybrid search) is more effective than keyword-based retrieval for industrial failure-sensor reasoning. Fine-tuning open-source LLMs (QLoRA) substantially improves diagnostic reasoning over prompting alone. However, all evaluated methods exhibit notable sensitivity to input perturbations, suggesting that robustness remains a key challenge for deploying such systems in real industrial settings.

Abstract: Industrial plants run many important machines such as pumps, turbines, and compressors. Although engineers can use their experience to identify and diagnose machine problems, transferring this reasoning ability to computer systems remains difficult. This work studies how well a retrieval-only method and an open-source large language model (LLM) perform failure-sensor diagnostic reasoning using the FailureSensorIQ benchmark, a multiple-choice question-answering task introduced by IBM Research. In the retrieval-only approach, each answer option is converted into an option-level query and scored using similar correct and incorrect records from the training data. TF-IDF, BM25, semantic search, and hybrid search are tested and compared. In the LLM-based approach, the Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model is evaluated using zero-shot prompting, few-shot prompting, and QLoRA fine-tuning. The results show that semantic search and hybrid search perform better than pure keyword-matching techniques, indicating that meaning-based similarity is more important for industrial failure-sensor reasoning. Among the LLM-based methods, the fine-tuned model achieves the best performance and substantially improves over zero-shot and few-shot prompting. Error analysis shows that performance decreases as the number of answer options increases. Robustness analysis also shows that all methods are sensitive to option shuffling, changed labels, paraphrasing, and additional distractors.

</details>


### [166] [KuaiLive-M3: A Multi-Modal, Multi-Domain, and Multi-Feedback Dataset for Live Streaming Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24862)
*Ke Guo,Changle Qu,Jiayaqi Cheng,Xiao Zhang,Shijun Wang,Xiaoyu Zhang,Xueliang Wang,Le Zhang,Lantao Hu,Jun Xu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: KuaiLive-M3 是一个面向直播推荐的大规模多模态、多领域、多反馈数据集,由中国人民大学与快手科技合作从快手平台采集,涵盖 21,938 名用户在四周时间内的 3,580 万条直播交互和 1.11 亿条短视频交互,包含约 8,800 万个带时间戳的片段级多模态嵌入和 25,403 份问卷反馈,填补了现有公开直播数据集在跨域行为、时序演化内容与显式用户反馈方面的空白,并支持跨域推荐、直播高光预测和问卷增强推荐三项基准任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开直播推荐数据集存在三大局限:无法提供时序演化的多模态直播内容、忽略用户跨短视频与直播域的交互行为、缺乏捕捉用户感知内容质量和满意度的显式反馈,导致研究难以真实还原工业级直播推荐场景。因此需要构建一个同时支持多模态内容建模、跨域偏好迁移以及显式-隐式反馈对齐的数据集与基准。

Method: 数据构建流程包括:对快手 4 周活跃用户采样;同时采集直播域(7 种行为:曝光、播放、评论、点赞、分享、礼物、关注、举报)和短视频域(4 种行为)的精细化交互;使用工业级多模态大语言模型提取直播片段级(128 维)与房间级(64 维)及短视频级多模态嵌入;针对主播推荐频率发放问卷收集显式偏好;并执行严格的匿名化处理。基于该数据集建立了三项基准任务,使用包括 LightGCN、MGCCDR、GRU、SASRec、SAQRec 等多种代表性基线方法进行实验评估。

Result: 跨域推荐任务中,MGCCDR 表现最佳(R@10=0.0817,N@10=0.1795),专为直播设计的异构关系建模方法显著优于通用 CDR 方法;高光预测任务中 GRU 取得最佳 mAP(0.7776)和 Kendall's τ(Δ=0 时 0.5068),表明循环结构能有效捕捉直播内容动态;问卷增强推荐任务中,SASRec_M 取得最佳 NDCG@10(0.9281)和 MRR(0.9133),证实了问卷反馈对隐式行为信号具有一致增益,但 SAQRec 受限于问卷稀疏性表现不佳,揭示了如何高效利用极稀疏显式反馈的开放难题。

Conclusion: KuaiLive-M3 通过联合提供跨域交互日志、时序多模态嵌入与问卷显式反馈,显著弥合了公开基准与真实直播推荐系统之间的差距,为跨域偏好迁移、时序多模态建模以及隐式-显式反馈对齐提供了可复现研究资源;同时其在停留时长预测、生成式推荐和大语言模型增强推荐等延伸方向也具有重要研究价值。

Abstract: Existing public live streaming datasets suffer from three major limitations: they provide limited access to temporally evolving multimodal live content, overlook users' cross-domain interactions between short videos and live streams, and contain only implicit behavioral signals without explicit feedback that captures users' perceived content quality and satisfaction. These limitations prevent existing benchmarks from faithfully reflecting real-world live streaming scenarios and hinder comprehensive research on live streaming recommendation. To address these limitations, we introduce KuaiLive-M3, a multi-modal, multi-domain, and multi-feedback dataset for live streaming recommendation, collected from Kuaishou, a leading live streaming and short video platform in China. KuaiLive-M3 covers 21,938 users and contains 35 million live streaming interactions and 111 million short video interactions, with fine-grained timestamps and diverse user behaviors. It further provides approximately 88 million timestamped segment-level multi-modal embeddings that capture the temporal evolution of live streaming content, as well as 25,403 questionnaire-based feedback records that bridge implicit user behaviors and explicit user preferences. Based on these unique signals, we establish benchmarks for cross-domain recommendation, live stream highlight prediction, and questionnaire-enhanced recommendation. Extensive experiments with representative baselines demonstrate that KuaiLive-M3 provides a challenging and realistic benchmark for future live streaming recommendation research. The results further highlight the importance of modeling temporally evolving content, transferring user preferences across domains, and bridging the gap between implicit behaviors and explicit user feedback. The dataset and benchmark code are publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [167] [On the Convergent Validity of Offline Evaluation Designs for Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25097)
*Sushobhan Parajuli,Samira Vaez Barenji,Michael D. Ekstrand*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文研究了推荐系统离线评估设计的收敛效度，通过对比稀疏历史交互数据上的传统评估与基于密集真实反馈的评估，使用Kendall's τ衡量两者模型排序的一致性。结果显示：MovieLens上两者弱正相关，KuaiRec上稀疏评估几乎完全反转密集评估的排序，不存在普遍最优的离线评估设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐系统离线评估依赖稀疏、有偏的交互日志，其有效性存疑。评估设计选择（数据过滤阈值、候选集构建、列表长度等）会显著影响模型排序，但哪些配置能可靠反映真实用户偏好尚不明确。论文引入测量理论中的"收敛效度"概念，以密集真实反馈为参考点，系统考察稀疏评估设计的内部有效性。

Method: 在两个数据集上开展实验：（1）MovieLens-32M（含51名活跃用户的密集相关性标注扩展版），使用时间切分；（2）KuaiRec（稀疏"大矩阵"16.3%密度 + 密集"小矩阵"99.6%密度），使用5折交叉验证。共评估45个LensKit推荐模型（含隐式与显式反馈），MovieLens产生97种配置，KuaiRec产生123种配置。变化三种候选集条件（全集Full、U-1000均匀采样、P-1000流行度加权采样）、三种相关性阈值（MovieLens: ≥3.0/≥4.0/分级；KuaiRec: ≥0.85/≥2.0/分级）、三种列表长度k∈{10,20,100}，以及多种密集评估目标。通过Kendall's τ（含自助法95%置信区间）衡量稀疏与密集评估间模型排序的相关性。

Result: MovieLens上稀疏与密集评估呈弱正相关，最佳τ=0.43（全集候选、k=100、r≥3.0对"非常感兴趣"密集目标）；P-1000在短列表密集目标上略优（τ=0.29），但长列表密集目标下退步（τ=0.18）。然而密集评估中最优的BiasedSVD变体在最佳稀疏设计中仅排第22-23名，在最佳相关稀疏设计中排第38-40名，存在显著错排。KuaiRec上所有稀疏评估设计与密集评估呈负相关（τ最低达-0.57），稀疏评估几乎完全反转密集排序，前5密集模型在稀疏设计中排名第17-44位。候选集选择影响最大，其次为相关性阈值，稀疏k影响最小。隐式反馈模型（如fsSLIM变体）在两种评估间表现较一致，显式反馈模型（如BiasedSVD）则差异显著。

Conclusion: 稀疏离线评估的有效性高度依赖于数据集和具体评估目标，不存在普遍最优的离线评估设计。MovieLens上正相关与数据特性（显式评分、池化偏差、k-core过滤）有关；KuaiRec上负相关可能源于隐式信号、缺乏时序、用户数较少等因素。模型间的"差异"可能更多由评估协议而非模型本身能力驱动，不同密集评估目标可能需要不同的稀疏评估设计。该研究强调了离线评估需要更严格的有效性检验，呼吁未来工作探索稀疏与密集评估间的一致性条件。

Abstract: Offline evaluation on historical interaction logs is the most common evaluation methodology for recommender systems. However, such evaluations depend on sparse, incomplete, or biased data, which raises concerns about whether commonly used evaluation setups reliably reflect true user preferences. In this work, we study how offline evaluation design choices affect the validity of recommender system comparisons. We evaluate a set of recommendation models across several evaluation setups that vary key factors such as data filtering thresholds and candidate set construction. To assess the validity of these configurations, we measure the correlation between model rankings obtained from conventional train-test splits on sparse interaction data and rankings from evaluations based on dense ground-truth user feedback. We use this agreement as an indication of their validity with respect to true user preferences. Our results show that the validity of sparse evaluation depends on the dataset and the specific dense evaluation targets, and that there is no uniformly best offline evaluation design.

</details>


### [168] [HiEviDR-Bench: A Benchmark for Hierarchical Evidence Aggregation in Deep Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25151)
*Yubo Sun,Chunyi Peng,Yukun Yan,Zhenghao Liu,Sen Mei,Bangrui Xu,Xuanhe Zhou,Chi Chen,Maosong Sun*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: HiEviDR-Bench 是一个面向"深度研究"任务的可追溯性评测基准，包含 2000 道经过人工验证的多模态题目（涵盖开放域 Wiki 与学术域 arXiv，纯文本与多模态条件，三档难度），通过为每道题构建"证据图"（evidence graph，将证据节点、声明节点、结论节点连接成有向无环图）来显式建模从证据到中间声明再到最终结论的层级聚合过程，并配套了五个互补评估维度（报告质量、证据可追溯性、引用准确性、声明验证、答案正确性）以及"渐进式门控机制"（progressive gating）用于细粒度错误定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度研究评测主要采用"以结果为中心"的范式，仅评估最终答案正确性、报告质量或引用对齐度，将证据检索、跨源链接与聚合过程视为黑盒，无法诊断失败根源（检索失败、推理错误还是引用不准），也缺少对中间声明是否被证据充分支撑的结构化度量；同时多模态场景（表格、图表、图像作为证据）鲜有覆盖，限制了评估深度研究系统"是否真正进行多步可验证推理"的能力。

Method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 任务形式化——将深度研究评估从单步生成正确性判断重构为基于证据图 G=(N,E) 的层级聚合评估，节点集 N 包含证据节点 N_e、声明节点 N_c 和结论节点 n_conclusion，边集 E 编码支持关系；(2) 五维评估框架——Report Score（六个报告质量子维度加权聚合）、Evidence Traceability Score（由证据召回率 s1、证据节点识别准确率 s2、噪声证据回避准确率 s3 加权）、Citation Score、Claim Score、Answer Score（后三者受渐进式门控机制约束，前置阶段失败则后续阶段计为零）；(3) 四阶段数据构建流水线——基于 Wikipedia 与 arXiv 构建多模态语料库（Wikitextchunk≈3046 万、图像≈668 万；arXiv文本≈12.5 万、图像≈4.2 万），以 anchor 为中心通过 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B 检索候选证据，利用 LLM 在结构化 schema 下构建证据图（确保连通 DAG、单一结论根），再生成问答对并经规则过滤、Judge 模型筛选与人工验证（从 30000 实例经层层筛选至最终 2000）。

Result: 在 16 个代表性强多模态大模型（含 Qwen、Gemma、GPT-5 系列、Gemini-3.1-Flash、Grok-4.5、GLM、InternVL、MiMo、MiniCPM 等）同时在 RAG 与 Deep Research 两种范式下的实验表明：(1) Deep Research 整体优于纯 RAG 但优势有限；(2) 所有模型在 Report Score 上较高（约 18-19.5/20），但在 Citation、Claim、Answer 维度上急剧下降，最佳模型 GPT-5.6-sol 与 Grok-4.5 整体得分也仅约 40-46/100；(3) 渐进门控分析显示 Answer 门通过率仅 3.80%-11.50%，瓶颈集中在证据识别与中间声明构建环节；(4) Deep Research 的优势主要体现在噪声证据抑制与证据到报告的连接保留上，而非证据召回覆盖率本身；(5) 多模态场景下增益波动大于纯文本，Wiki 子集上 Deep Research 增益更稳定，arXiv 子集增益较小且不均衡。

Conclusion: HiEviDR-Bench 揭示了当前深度研究系统的核心瓶颈不在表面报告流畅性而在层级证据聚合——尤其在证据识别与中间声明构建阶段；强表面报告质量并不等价于有依据的多步推理。多模态深度研究的关键挑战在于如何有效组织跨模态异构证据，而非单纯扩大检索范围。该基准通过显式证据图与渐进式门控机制为细粒度诊断提供了可复现、可扩展的评测框架。

Abstract: Deep research requires models to retrieve, connect, and synthesize evidence from large-scale heterogeneous sources to answer complex queries and produce analytical reports. Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate final outcomes, such as answer correctness, report quality, or citation alignment, while providing limited visibility into whether evidence is correctly selected, linked, and aggregated into supported claims and conclusions. To address this gap, we introduce HiEviDR-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating Hierarchical Evidence Aggregation in Deep Research. HiEviDR-Bench covers open-domain and academic-domain settings under both text-only and multimodal conditions, and represents each instance with an explicit evidence graph that captures evidence selection, cross-source linking, and aggregation from evidence to intermediate claims and final conclusions. Based on this formulation, we develop a traceability-oriented evaluation framework with five dimensions: report quality, evidence traceability, citation accuracy, claim verification, and answer correctness, together with a progressive gating mechanism for fine-grained error localization. HiEviDR-Bench contains 2,000 human-validated questions with evidence graphs across multiple difficulty levels. Experiments on 16 representative multimodal large language models show that, although many systems achieve strong report quality, their performance drops markedly on citation accuracy, claim construction, and answer correctness. Further analysis shows that the main bottlenecks lie in evidence identification and intermediate claim construction, revealing that strong surface-level report quality does not necessarily imply grounded multi-stage reasoning on our benchmark.

</details>


### [169] [Bekko Embedding: Parameter-Efficient Multilingual Retrieval with Ultra-Compact Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25180)
*Yuichi Tateno*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出Bekko Embedding系列超紧凑多语言检索模型，其中最小的a8m仅约800万活跃参数（AP），却在官方MMTEB多语言检索基准上超越参数量大40倍的BGE-M3。核心方法是无蒸馏的结构化层剪枝（将mmBERT-small从22层压缩到4/13层）+ 两阶段对比学习，完整训练在单GPU上约3天即可完成。a8m同时在CPU/GPU/树莓派/浏览器上均为对比模型中最快，ONNX模型仅124 MiB，支持浏览器内运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. 当前主流多语言嵌入模型参数规模庞大（数亿至数十亿），对CPU/边缘设备/浏览器等低资源场景的推理成本和内存开销过高；2. 在多语言模型中，词汇嵌入矩阵占总参数的大部分但实际只做查找表，不参与Transformer矩阵乘法计算，因此真正的推理计算成本应由"活跃参数（AP）"即非嵌入参数来衡量；3. 在AP≤30M的紧凑带中，多语言模型长期由2020年代的MiniLM架构（如mE5-small）主导，缺乏更新的现代架构方案，且在≤10M AP的极紧凑带几乎空白。

Method: 三原则设计：（1）结构化层剪枝——将mmBERT-small的22层剪枝至4层（a8m，保留[0,1,2,18]）或13层（a25m，保留[0–11,18]），保留早期连续层+一个深层Global层（而非最终层），保持Global-Local注意力节奏，无需教师蒸馏；（2）数据补偿知识缺口——使用约11.5亿对多语言对比语料（涵盖平行bitext、Wikipedia、新闻、两种LLM合成数据：Qwen3.5-35B-A3B高质量合成+自研query-crafter-multilingual快速合成），全部公开；（3）两阶段对比学习——阶段1在大规模弱监督对上进行对比预训练（max 512 tokens，batch 8192），阶段2在硬负例（含8192 token长文档硬负例）上进行微调；损失函数结合按对类型分支方向的遮蔽对比损失（mask false negatives）+ Matryoshka表示学习（MRL）+ 输出向量QAT（int8/ubinary伪量化）；单GPU训练，a8m约3天/天完成；推理侧对ONNX/OpenVINO的词汇嵌入表做行级int8量化以压缩分发体积。

Result: 1. 检索质量：官方MMTEB Multilingual v2上，a8m以7.67M AP取得Retrieval nDCG@10=56.2，超过mE5-small/base/large和BGE-M3（40×AP）；a25m（24.93M AP）取得57.5，与gte-multilingual-base持平；2. 在Multilingual NanoBEIR（14种语言）上一致验证该趋势，且a25m在长输入检索（NanoLongEmbed）上为稠密模型中最强，a25m在长文档检索（NanoMLDR）排第3（仅次于gte-m-base和BGE-M3）；3. 推理速度：在相同硬件和工作负载下，a8m在x86 CPU上是mE5-small的1.6倍，GPU上1.5倍，树莓派5上也最快；4. 部署体积：a8m ONNX仅124 MiB（fp32的1/3），a25m为190 MiB，可在浏览器（Transformers.js + WebGPU/WASM）中运行；5. 量化表现：词汇嵌入int8几乎无损（−0.0001），但全模型int8会显著退化长输入性能。

Conclusion: 本文证明AP（活跃参数）应作为多语言嵌入模型的真正效率轴，并通过无蒸馏结构化剪枝+大规模多语言对比数据+单GPU两阶段训练，在8M/25M AP量级上实现与参数量大1–2个数量级的模型相媲美的检索质量，同时在CPU/边缘/浏览器等低资源环境中具备显著的速度和体积优势。作者公开了模型权重、阶段1完整语料和阶段2独立挖掘的硬负例，以支持多语言紧凑检索的可复现研究；未来方向包括增强低资源语言覆盖、扩展词汇压缩、隔离长输入鲁棒性来源（RoPE配置 vs 长文档数据），以及解耦AP容量与其他训练因素的受控缩放实验。

Abstract: How small can a competitive multilingual retrieval model be? We present Bekko Embedding: its smallest model, bekko-embedding-v1-a8m, has just under 8M Active Parameters (AP) -- the non-embedding parameters that dominate inference compute -- yet on official MMTEB Multilingual v2 Retrieval (nDCG@10) it scores 56.2, above the multilingual-e5 family and BGE-M3 (40x the AP) in our comparison. The higher-quality bekko-embedding-v1-a25m (just under 25M AP) reaches 57.5, on par with gte-multilingual-base, and Multilingual NanoBEIR (14 languages) confirms the trend. Both models handle inputs of up to 8192 tokens, and on long-input retrieval (NanoLongEmbed) a25m is the strongest dense model in our comparison. The recipe is deliberately simple. We prune the 22-layer multilingual encoder mmBERT-small to 4 / 13 layers and train the pruned models in two stages -- large-scale contrastive learning on about 1.1 billion multilingual pairs from our public corpus, followed by hard-negative fine-tuning with 8192-token long-document negatives -- with a masked contrastive loss whose direction depends on pair type, plus the Matryoshka objective. No teacher distillation is used, and all training completes on a single GPU in about 3 days for a8m. Small AP pays off directly in speed: among the compared models measured under identical conditions, a8m is the fastest on both CPU and GPU -- 1.6x multilingual-e5-small on x86 CPU -- and the fastest on a Raspberry Pi 5. The 384-dimensional output (truncatable to 256/128/64) keeps similarity search and indexing cheap, and row-wise int8 quantization of the vocabulary embedding shrinks the a8m ONNX / OpenVINO build to 124 MiB, which runs in the browser via this http URL . To support reproducible research, we release the model weights, the complete stage-1 corpus, and the independently mined stage-2 hard negatives.

</details>


### [170] [Grevo: A Unified Generative Recommendation Framework with Evolutionary Item Indexing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25329)
*Huanjie Wang,Liwei Guan,Zekai Sun,Hongwei Zhang,Honghui Bao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Grevo 是一个统一的生成式推荐框架，核心创新在于将"语义标识符（SID）分配"视为可进化的离散变量，通过单一多任务推荐器（联合行为SID生成BSG和语义SID锚定SSG）吸收传统分词器（tokenizer）的角色，并在训练后用模型自身的后验信号预算化地重分配高风险标识符。无需第二个可学习模型、无需对齐损失、无需交替优化调度，即可在 Amazon Beauty/Sports/Toys 三个真实基准上一致超越现有 SOTA 生成式推荐方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐（GR）将检索重构为对语义标识符（SID）的自回归生成，性能强劲但存在"语义—行为鸿沟"：现有方法分为两类且都存在缺陷：(1) 静态方法（如 TIGER、LC-Rec、LETTER）先用基于内容重建的量化器冻结 SID 再训练推荐器，最能重建内容表征的 SID 未必能从用户行为中预测出来；(2) 端到端耦合方法（如 ETEGRec、BLOGER、PIT）虽通过交替优化与对齐损失关闭反馈环路，但需要第二个可学习模型、精心设计的分阶段调度，且易使离散目标扰动推荐器训练。关键洞察：GR 与语言模型不同——语言模型必须有 tokenizer 把字符串切分，而 GR 中物品 SID 本质是可自由分配的索引，因此 GR 真正需要的是"组织良好的索引"而非"持续在线的分词器"。该观察启发了把分词器降级为一次性初始化器、用推荐器自身后验来进化索引的新范式。

Method: Grevo 由两大组件构成，运行在轮次化生命周期 pre-train → collect → enumerate → evolve → retrain 之中：<br><br>1) 统一多任务模型（Unified Multitask Model）：基于 T5 风格编码器-解码器 Transformer（8 层编码器 + 8 层解码器，隐藏维度 256，4 头注意力），通过两个仅以输入前缀区分的任务共享同一解码器与词嵌入层：<br>   - BSG（Behavioral SID Generation）：编码器输入用户历史 SID 序列 + [U] BOS，自回归生成目标 SID；<br>   - SSG（Semantic SID Grounding）：编码器输入物品语义表征 e_i + [I] BOS，自回归生成该物品自身 SID，充当"物品 → SID"的锚定任务。SSG 主要激活嵌入层附近的浅层，额外开销可忽略。<br><br>2) 进化式物品索引（Evolutionary Item Indexing）：在固定词表、固定长度的索引流形上进行离散坐标下降式更新，每轮至多修改 Budget = ⌊ρ|I|⌋ 个标识符（默认 ρ=0.05，仅编辑最后两层，共枚举至多 64 个候选）。具体三步：<br>   - Collect：用训练好的推荐器为高风险物品收集三类后验分数——r_BSG(i,s)（在物品 i 出现为目标的所有上下文 C_i 上对候选 SID 的平均对数概率）、r_SSG(i,s)（从 e_i 恢复候选 SID 的对数概率）以及跨任务逐层一致性 r_cons(i,s)= (1/K)Σ min(u_k, v_k)；<br>   - Enumerate：在可变层 M 上为每个高风险物品构建 token 池 A_i^k = {当前 token} ∪ {后验混淆邻居 token} ∪ {低负载 token}，仅在 M 上替换生成受限候选集 S_i；<br>   - Evolve：按加权对齐增益 score(i,s') = Δr_BSG + λ_1 Δr_SSG + λ_2 Δr_cons（默认 λ_1=0.25, λ_2=0.15）贪心提交最高分重分配，全局约束保持词表与层数不变。

Result: 在 Amazon 2014 三个基准（Beauty/Sports/Toys）上，Grevo 跨 TIGER、LETTER、LC-Rec 三个生成式骨干均取得最佳 R@5/10 与 N@5/10。代表性数据：在 Beauty 上，TIGER 骨干 R@10 由 0.0648 提升至 +Grevo 的 0.0778（+20.1%），N@10 由 0.0336 提升至 0.0412（+22.6%）；LETTER 骨干 R@10 由 0.0654 提升至 0.0751（+14.8%）；LC-Rec 骨干 R@10 由 0.0653 提升至 0.0777（+19.0%）。Sports 与 Toys 数据集同样全指标领先。关键发现：<br>• +Grevo (no-evo)（仅多任务 BSG+SSG，固定索引）已稳定优于基线，证明统一多任务本身即带来收益；引入进化后再次跃升，证明后验反馈提供了固定索引多任务训练无法恢复的信号。<br>• 索引可迁移性：LC-Rec 直接使用 TIGER+Grevo 进化后的 SID 训练（不调用 LC-Rec 自己的 Grevo 模块）即获提升，证明 SID 质量而非骨干特定 tokenizer 才是关键。<br>• 消融（Beauty, TIGER）：r_SSG-only 退化最严重（R@5 0.0453），r_BSG-only 优于 r_SSG-only 但弱于完整模型（0.0472），去掉混淆邻居 token 后退化最剧（0.0440），证实行为后验为主信号、邻居 token 为最有效局部修复方向。<br>• 保留外码字可解码性（Beauty）：在从未参与候选打分的留出验证/测试历史上做 teacher-forcing，所有进化的 SID 的 NLL 均落在 y=x 下方、目标 token 排名显著向码本顶部集中，说明进化带来的可解码性提升并非对第 0 轮后验信号的过拟合。<br>• 超参数（Beauty）：可变层数 2、ρ=0.05、λ_1=0.25、λ_2=0.15 为最优；测试 R@10/N@10 在前三轮单调上升后收敛，验证小预算、渐进式进化的有效性。

Conclusion: Grevo 证明：(1) 生成式推荐的本质需求是高质量的物品索引而非持续在线的可训练分词器；(2) 把 tokenizer 降级为一次性语义初始化器、用单一多任务推荐器同时承担推荐与物品锚定两角色、再用其后验信号在固定词表/长度流形上做预算化离散进化，可在无需第二个模型、对齐损失或交替调度的情况下稳定提升多种骨干与数据集的推荐质量；(3) 索引质量本身可跨骨干迁移，表明 SID 是生成式推荐的关键可重用资产。未来方向：将进化式索引推广到持续变化的流式目录场景、扩展到更大码本（需更高效的候选策略）、以及用多模态嵌入作为 SSG 更丰富的锚定信号。

Abstract: Generative recommendation has recently emerged as a promising paradigm that reformulates retrieval as autoregressive generation over semantic identifiers (SIDs), achieving strong performance and drawing increasing attention as an alternative to matching. Despite this progress, SIDs are typically frozen by a content-based tokenizer before the recommender is trained, leaving a persistent gap between what best reconstructs an item's content and what a recommender can predict from user behavior. Recent end-to-end methods close this gap by jointly training the tokenizer and the recommender, but coupling the two destabilizes the identifier space and requires a second learnable model, alignment losses, and usually a delicate alternating-optimization schedule. To address this issue, we propose Grevo, a unified Generative recommendation framework with evolutionary item indexing, which treats the SID assignment itself as an evolvable discrete variable that adapts to behavioral feedback rather than as a tokenizer to be trained. Grevo builds on a single multitask recommender that unifies a behavioral SID generation task and a semantic SID grounding task, letting the recommender absorb the tokenizer's role. Through evolutionary item indexing, Grevo then uses the trained recommender itself as a posterior evaluator to reassign a budgeted set of high-risk identifiers under a fixed vocabulary and length. Together, these components turn index construction into a stable, feedback-driven search that requires no second learnable model, no alignment losses, and no alternating-optimization schedule. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that Grevo consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative recommendation methods.

</details>


### [171] [SPARC: Sequence-aware Progressive Attribute Routing and Compression Framework for Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25339)
*Chang Liu,Changfa Wu,Hui Qian,Binbin Cao,Jian Wu,Yuliang Yan,Han Zhu,Bo Zheng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SPARC是一个用于生成式推荐的轻量级前端压缩框架，通过"先交互后压缩"的设计原则，将每个多字段历史交互压缩为单个骨干网络token，同时保留基于SID的项目身份和上下文相关的辅助字段信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于语义ID（SID）的生成式推荐存在两个问题：（1）静态分配的SID无法捕捉动态商品状态（价格、库存、促销）和交互级上下文（行为类型、时间戳）；（2）简单展开所有异构字段会导致输入长度大幅增加（计算成本呈二次方增长），而直接压缩又会过早丢失上下文相关信号——因为字段重要性取决于序列上下文（如重复购买同品牌时品牌更重要，意图转变时价格和行为类型更重要）。

Method: SPARC是一个三阶段渐进式压缩框架：(1) **字段级上下文建模（FCM）**——按字段类型沿用户历史组织表示，使用轻量级序列编码器获得上下文感知的字段表示；(2) **上下文感知属性路由（CAR）**——将SID字段显式保留为身份token，使用softmax归一化的路由权重（基于原始表示、上下文表示和字段嵌入拼接后经MLP投影）将侧字段路由到R个可学习槽位，槽位值通过残差值投影生成；(3) **序列级token整合（STC）**——将中间token展平后用轻量级Transformer进行跨交互建模，通过门控残差更新稳定训练，最后分别对身份token和侧token池化后用可学习权重融合。

Result: 在工业TaoBao数据集（2100万用户、2.7亿商品、260亿交互）和公开Amazon Beauty/Toys数据集上，SPARC均取得最优性能：Beauty上HR@20从RankGR的0.0466提升至0.0794，HR@500从0.2289提升至0.3571；Toys上HR@20从0.0443提升至0.0743；TaoBao上HR^click@20从0.1568提升至0.1669。消融实验表明SPARC优于静态压缩变体（MLP、QFormer、Modulated），证明性能提升源于上下文条件信息保留而非压缩模块表达能力增强。路由分析显示两个侧槽位学习了差异化的字段偏好（一个侧重action_type和decay，另一个侧重seller_name等），且同一商品在不同上下文下路由权重分布显著不同。

Conclusion: SPARC通过在压缩前对异构字段进行上下文建模，在固定token预算下既保留了稳定的SID项目身份，又动态保留了上下文相关的辅助信息，缓解了静态逐项聚合导致的过早信息损失。渐进式设计在不增加生成骨干网络输入长度的前提下融入了字段级和跨交互信号。未来工作将探索自适应token预算分配和更丰富的行为特征空间。

Abstract: Generative recommendation tokenizes items as discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) and autoregressively generates target items from users' historical SID sequences. Although existing SIDs incorporate multimodal and structured information, they are typically statically assigned and independent of the current interaction context. In industrial scenarios, each behavior also contains heterogeneous attributes, such as category, brand, price, behavior type, and timestamp. Fully expanding these features greatly increases the input length, while directly compressing them into a single representation may prematurely discard context-relevant information. We propose \textbf{SPARC}, \uline{\textbf{S}}equence-aware \uline{\textbf{P}}rogressive \uline{\textbf{A}}ttribute \uline{\textbf{R}}outing and \uline{\textbf{C}}ompression Framework for Generative recommendation. SPARC first models the sequential dependencies of each field type to obtain context-aware field representations. It then routes the original, contextual, and identity representations of different fields into multiple slots to preserve complementary information under a fixed capacity. Finally, lightweight cross-item interaction integrates the intermediate tokens and compresses each historical item into a single token. Following the principle of contextualizing before compression, SPARC enriches user-history representations without increasing the input length of the generative backbone. Experiments on industrial Taobao and public Amazon datasets demonstrate that SPARC outperforms strong conventional and generative baselines. Further comparisons with static compression variants show that the improvement of SPARC comes from context-conditioned information retention rather than merely increasing the expressiveness of the compression module.

</details>


### [172] [Reward Guided Decoding for Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25344)
*Ruochen Yang,Yusheng Huang,Youfeng Zheng,Shuang Wen,Liangliang Chen,Pengbo Xu,Xiaoyu Zhang,Shijun Wang,Shuang Yang,Zhaojie Liu,Lantao Hu,Wenwu Ou,Jiawei Sheng,Tingwen Liu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出RGD（Reward Guided Decoding），一种面向工业级价值导向生成式推荐的可控解码框架。该方法将基于KL散度正则化的奖励最大化问题形式化，推导出闭式奖励引导解码分布，将基础生成器视为参考策略，引入奖励模型作为测试时控制器，在每个SID解码步骤注入奖励信号以重塑搜索轨迹，无需重新训练生成器。已在快手平台部署并带来持续的业务提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. 生成式推荐采用SID序列自回归生成，但解码过程主要受生成似然度驱动，与实际业务目标（如点击、礼物、转化等）存在偏差，高价值候选可能因生成概率低而被剪枝。2. 现有方法存在局限：重排序介入过晚；训练时对齐方法（如DPO/GRPO）在业务偏好变化时需昂贵的模型重训练。3. 需要一种原则性强、灵活且高效的推理时奖励引导解码方案。

Method: 1. **理论形式化**：将价值引导解码建模为KL正则化奖励最大化问题 Q* = argmax_Q {E[R(j)] - β·D_KL(Q∥P)}，推导出闭式Boltzmann型分布 Q*(j) ∝ P(j)·exp(R(j)/β)，得到实用评分准则 p*(j) = logP(j) + R(j)/β。2. **奖励模型设计**：轻量级评分头附加于冻结的预训练生成器解码器上，采用瓶颈MLP结构，包含链式因果结构以反映自回归性质，通过log-odds变换将概率映射到实数空间。3. **奖励模型训练**：支持单目标（CTR/LVTR/WTR/GTR）和多目标LTR奖励训练，使用加权BCE损失，与生成器联合训练但梯度分离。4. **推理策略**：设计三种推理模式——pre-merge（最强表达力）、post-merge（高效）、hybrid（生产部署首选），在不同解码层采用不同粒度的奖励注入。

Result: 1. **离线公开数据集**：在Amazon的Sports、Beauty、Toys三个数据集上，RGD在Recall@5/10和NDCG@5/10上均优于TIGER、HSTU、RPG、PROMISE等基线，Recall@10提升最高达11.49%，NDCG@10提升最高达8.30%。2. **工业场景**：在快手直播数据集上，相比OneLive基线，RGD g.LTR使HitRate@604提升1.09%，各业务指标（CTR/LVTR/WTR/GTR）均显著提升；与DPO/GRPO相比，在生成质量与奖励改善之间取得更优权衡。3. **消融与分析**：温度参数β适中时性能最优；概率-奖励空间可视化显示RGD能探索到被似然主导搜索遗漏的高奖励候选；hybrid推理策略在性能与延迟间取得最佳平衡。4. **在线A/B测试**：在快手直播推荐场景部署CTR引导版本，两周测试显示页面级CTR提升+0.392%，直播观看时长提升+0.689%，观看次数提升+0.349%。

Conclusion: RGD通过将价值引导生成为KL正则化奖励最大化问题，提供了一种原则性强、灵活可控的解码时奖励注入框架。其闭式Boltzmann分布为生成似然与业务反馈的融合提供了理论保障，避免了启发式分数插值。该方法支持灵活的多目标切换且无需重训练生成器，特别适合工业级部署中频繁的业务目标调整场景，已在快手平台验证有效性。

Abstract: Generative recommendation formulates recommendation task into an SID sequence autoregressive generation paradigm, but the decoding process is often dominated by generation likelihood. This may conflict with real-world business objectives, where high-value candidates can receive low generation probability and be pruned early during beam search. Existing reranking or training-time alignment methods either intervene too late or require costly model retraining when business preferences change. To this end, we propose \textbf{R}eward \textbf{G}uided \textbf{D}ecoding, named \textbf{RGD}, a controllable decoding framework for industrial value-oriented generative recommendation. We formulate value-guided decoding as a KL-regularized reward maximization problem, deriving a closed-form reward guided decoding distribution that principledly combines generation probability with reward signals. RGD treats the base generator as a reference policy and introduces a reward model as a test-time controller, injecting reward into each decoding step to reshape the search trajectory without retraining the generator. Extensive offline and online experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach for aligning personalization and business value. RGD has been deployed on the Kuaishou platform, bringing consistent improvements in real-world recommendation scenarios.

</details>


### [173] [The Case Against Generation for Retrieval: Discriminative Language Models as Effective Retrievers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25346)
*Zhe Xu,Prachi Agrawal,Kavosh Asadi,Tianyi Chen,Carl Hu,Justin Johnson,Wuwei Lan,Mingfu Liang,Xi Liu,Tik On Lui,Oladipo Ositelu,Sandeep Pandey,Ankit Peshin,Feng Qi,Anil Ramakrishna,Kaushik Rangadurai,Frank Shyu,Luke Simon,Yang Yang,Chiyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文主张在工业级推荐检索场景中，应将大语言模型(LLM)作为判别式表征编码器而非生成式引擎来使用，重振经典双塔(Two-Tower)架构。作者提出了LLM原生的双塔检索框架，结合共享LLM编码器、EOS token池化、跨数据集迁移学习、交叉编码器蒸馏以及用户塔潜在推理等多项创新，在三个公开基准上达到或超越当前最优，并在Meta大规模生产系统中验证了其工业落地价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来LLM在推荐系统中被广泛探索，主要方向是将推荐任务重构为文本生成或语言建模问题（如P5、TIGER、LLMRank、TALLRec等），但此类生成式或交互密集型架构在工业级大规模检索中面临三大瓶颈：(1) 自回归解码导致推理延迟过高；(2) 服务成本昂贵；(3) 生成的离散token到实际item标识符之间存在对齐与落地(grounding)错误，可能产生级联失效。与之相对，双塔架构因支持item embedding离线预计算和近似最近邻(ANN)检索，长期是工业检索的基石。核心研究问题是：在LLM时代，能否将LLM的语义表征能力融入经典双塔架构，同时保留其工业验证的效率与可扩展性？

Method: 论文提出"教师-学生"LLM原生双塔框架，包含两方向的改进：
(1) **交叉编码器(CE)教师增强**：a) 使用yes/no文本化相关性评分头（取"yes"与"no"两个token的logit差作为相关性得分）；b) 引入用户条件化的下一token预测(NTP)辅助损失（让模型以用户上下文为条件预测item文本）；c) 双向编码器转换（但实验发现收益不一致，最终未保留）。总目标为对比损失与NTP损失的加权组合。
(2) **双塔(TT)学生增强**：a) **共享LLM编码器**——用户和item共用同一LLM以对齐到统一语义空间；b) **EOS token池化**——将decoder式LLM末尾EOS token的隐状态作为序列表示；c) **跨数据集迁移学习**——在多个推荐数据集上mid-train后再在目标集fine-tune；d) **CE2TT候选集分数分布蒸馏**——用KL散度对齐教师与学生在同一候选集上的排序分布；e) **Coconut式潜在推理**——仅在用户塔增加一个连续潜在token的推理步骤，使item塔保持可预计算，且两端仍共享参数。
此外，作者还提出非对称服务架构：item embedding通过nearline流水线异步生成并实时索引；用户embedding周期性重算并缓存于分布式KV存储；在线检索通过压缩embedding空间加速kNN。

Result: **公开数据集(Amazon Beauty/Sports/Toys)**：以Qwen3-0.6B为骨干，CE教师在12个数据集-指标组合中取得10个最佳，R@10在Sports和Toys上相对ORT分别提升64.3%和53.5%；双塔学生在三个数据集R@10上均超越ORT（+4.3%、+31.6%、+35.3%）。消融表明CE2TT蒸馏贡献最大（移除后R@10下降8-23%），转移学习与潜在推理提供互补增益。**生产系统**：LLM-Native TT仅用DLRM基线0.5%的训练数据即达到NE(Normalized Entropy)持平；CE模型达到NE持平仅需0.15%数据；尾部item NE提升+5.5%，头部用户NE提升+2.3%。在数据扩展性上，CE在2×/3×数据上的NE增益(+1.59%/+2.19%)优于DLRM(+1.30%/+1.80%)。在模型陈旧性(staleness)测试中，冻结DLRM在d_s+3下降-4.30%，而冻结LLM-Native CE仍维持+2.23%增益。服务优化方面，FSQ压缩、深度剪枝、词表剪枝、FP8量化分别带来+19.7%、+10.6%、+2.0%、+13.6%的QPS提升。Headroom研究表明，潜在推理(+0.41%)、MoE(+0.91%)与4B骨干(+1.90%)均可带来额外增益。

Conclusion: 论文有力论证了：在生成式LLM推荐盛行的时代，将LLM作为判别式语义表征编码器融入双塔架构，配合交叉编码器蒸馏，是工业级大规模推荐检索的实用且高效的路径。核心洞见包括：(1) 双塔架构通过LLM-native改造后，可同时获得LLM的语义深度与ANN检索的工业效率；(2) 交叉编码器通过yes/no头与用户条件化NTP得到显著增强，其知识可通过候选集分布蒸馏无损传递给双塔学生；(3) 限于用户塔的轻量潜在推理可在不破坏item塔可预计算性的前提下提升用户表征表达力；(4) LLM的稳定token词表相较DLRM脆弱的item-ID词表，天然带来数据效率、扩展性和陈旧性鲁棒性的优势。该工作为LLM在工业推荐系统中的集成提供了经过生产验证的可操作蓝图。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful assets for recommender systems. However, deploying them as generative recommenders or zero-shot rankers at web-scale remains bottlenecked by prohibitive computational overhead and grounding challenges. In this paper, we revitalize the classic, highly efficient two-tower retrieval architecture by adapting LLMs as semantic representation backbones rather than generative engines. We introduce an LLM-native two-tower framework engineered for high-throughput, large-scale retrieval. Our architecture introduces several key innovations: a shared LLM encoder for joint user-item modeling, End-Of-Sentence (EOS) token pooling for compact sequence embedding, cross-dataset transfer learning, knowledge distillation from powerful cross-encoder teachers, and latent reasoning within the user tower. Extensive evaluation across three public benchmarks demonstrates that cross-encoder architecture outperforms current state-of-the-art (SoTA) models, while the efficient two-tower student achieves SoTA-comparable retrieval performance. Furthermore, experiments on internal large-scale production systems yield substantial topline retrieval improvements along with high resilience to model staleness and superior data scaling. Our findings demonstrate that when augmented with modern representation learning, the traditional two-tower paradigm remains an exceptionally competitive and practical solution for industrial retrieval systems.

</details>


### [174] [LLM-as-a-Judge for Evaluating System Responses in Conversational Music Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25640)
*Seungheon Doh,Bruno Sguerra,Sergio Oramas,Elena V. Epure,Juhan Nam*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 首个针对对话式音乐推荐系统(CRS)响应评估场景的LLM-as-a-Judge可靠性实证研究，基于20位领域专家的400条评分，发现LLM裁判与人类判断呈中等正相关，且显著优于所有基于参考的基线指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式推荐系统的响应生成质量评估存在两大难题：(1)同一查询和推荐项下不存在唯一标准答案；(2)参考式指标在音乐领域失效——艺术家和曲目名的高词汇重叠扭曲n-gram分数，通用编码器缺乏音乐领域知识。人类评估虽为金标准，但成本高、难以扩展。LLM-as-a-Judge虽被视为有潜力的替代方案，但在CRS场景下其与人类判断的对齐程度仍是开放问题。

Method: 从TalkPlayData-Challenge数据集中采样20个多轮会话，使用4个不同规模的指令调优LLM（Llama-3.2-1B/3B-Instruct、Gemma-4-E2B/E4B-it）生成候选响应。招募20位音乐领域专家，使用五点Likert量表在"个性化质量"和"解释质量"两个维度上对80个(会话,响应)对进行评估，共获得400条评分（Krippendorff's α≈0.45）。测试5个裁判模型（Qwen3-LM-4B、GPT-5.4/nano、GPT-5.4、Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite、Gemini-3.1-Pro），与BLEU、ROUGE-L、BERTScore、Qwen3-Embedding（参考式与无参考式）基线对比。采用10,000次自助法（bootstrap）相关性分析，并进行提示词消融实验与定性偏见案例研究。

Result: （1）LLM裁判与人类判断呈中等正相关且显著优于基线：Gemini-3.1-Pro在个性化维度上Pearson r=0.55最高，GPT-5.4在解释维度上r=0.51最高；最佳参考式基线仅r=0.19。（2）轻量级裁判（GPT-5.4-nano、Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite）仍比最佳基线高出0.21–0.24。（3）提示词消融显示：对话历史对个性化贡献最大（Δr=+0.13），上下文示例对解释质量最关键（Δr=+0.08）。（4）偏见案例：裁判能正确识别语义反转和提示注入，但轻量级模型易被"流畅化改写"过度评分。

Conclusion: LLM-as-a-Judge可作为CRS响应评估的成本有效替代方案，但仍存在局限：即便最佳裁判r也仅约0.51–0.55，低于完全可信自动评估器的水平；评分者间一致性中等（α≈0.45）本身就构成相关性的天花板。研究提炼两条实践指南：（1）模型规模很重要——更大裁判对齐度更高，但轻量模型已优于基线；（2）领域特定的条件信息很关键——多轮对话历史是个性化评估的最重要输入，领域锚定的上下文示例是解释评估的主要杠杆。高风险场景下仍需保留人类参与。

Abstract: Conversational Recommendation Systems (CRS) aim to achieve two primary objectives: recommending relevant items and generating natural language responses. While recommendation accuracy is effectively measured by established ranking metrics, the evaluation of response generation poses a more fundamental challenge. Although human evaluation remains the gold standard, its cost and scalability constraints have motivated the adoption of LLM-as-a-judge as a promising proxy, whose alignment with human judgment in the context of CRS remains an open question. In this paper, we present the first user study to empirically assess the reliability of LLM-as-a-judge for evaluating CRS responses. We sample 20 multi-turn music recommendation sessions and generate candidate system responses using four instruction-tuned LLMs, inducing variance in response quality across model scales. We collect $n{=}400$ ratings from 20 domain-expert annotators, who evaluate each response across two dimensions: Personalization Quality and Explanation Quality. Through bootstrapped correlation analysis, we find that LLM-based judges exhibit moderate positive alignment with human assessments and outperform all reference-based baselines. Furthermore, we analyze how judge performance varies according to model scale and conditioning information, providing practical guidance for deploying LLM-as-a-judge.

</details>


### [175] [Hypothesis-Driven Shelf Generation for Personalised Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25823)
*Aleksandr V. Petrov,Tarun Chillara,Matthew D. Moellman,Lucas de Haas,Yabai Song,Alina Susoykina,Melissa Crawford,Gabriel Negash,Erik Franco,Tasnim Rahman,Binal Jhaveri,Shubham Bansal,Hugues Bouchard,Roberto Mirizzi,Mounia Lalmas,Aloïs Gruson*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向Spotify Home的"假设驱动"(hypothesis-driven)个性化推荐货架生成系统，通过四阶段架构（假设生成、目录履约、货架对齐、离线服务）将货架规划与目录履约解耦，使用自然语言假设作为中间规划表征，结合约束式生成检索(Generative Retrieval)与LLM-as-a-judge离线评估及在线随机曝光评估，验证了该方案能显著扩展个性化推荐供应量，并在多数内容类型上与现有货架具备竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代推荐界面（如Spotify Home）使用横向"货架"(shelf)展示主题化推荐内容。当前生产系统依赖手工设计的固定货架模板，并耦合专属检索逻辑。这种方式虽然对通用推荐意图有效，但无法扩展到个体长尾口味（流派、年代、场景、心情、熟悉度、市场、媒体类型的组合无穷无尽）。作者主张将货架生成重新定义为"生成式规划"问题，由模型生成描述个性化货架概念的自然语言假设，而非从固定模板中选择，以突破模板瓶颈。

Method: 系统采用四阶段显式解耦的离线批量管道：
1. **假设生成（Stage 1）**：基于用户行为画像（最近聆听、长期偏好、市场、播客行为等），由紧凑型开源LLM生成结构化假设 h=(q, c, f, r, t₀, d₀)，包含自然语言描述、目标内容类型、熟悉度、路由约束、临时标题副标题。前沿LLM通过蒸馏压缩到生产规模。
2. **目录履约（Stage 2）**：将履约建模为基于Semantic IDs (SemIDs)的约束式生成检索。LLM词汇表扩展SemIDs，解码通过trie约束保证生成有效目录实体；编辑/新鲜/熟悉/发现类货架使用不同索引。检索条件仅是假设而非用户画像，故意隔离个性化规划。
3. **候选选择与货架对齐（Stage 3）**：LLM联合选择最终k个条目并改写标题副标题，使显示文本忠实反映检索到的目录实体，解决"标题承诺"问题。
4. **离线服务（Stage 4）**：货架作为附加排名候选注入Home排名机制，不增加在线延迟；在线评估使用均匀随机曝光(uniform random exploration)协议。
评估方法：User-to-Hypothesis Judge（5维度，0-2分）+ Hypothesis-to-Shelf Judge（7维度，0-2分）。

Result: (1) **假设质量**：前沿LLM生成器Overall得分1.59±0.01；特定性1.99±0.00，音乐类假设强（专辑1.90/艺术家1.98/播放列表1.86），播客类弱（节目0.66/单集0.51）。蒸馏学生模型与前沿模型在800用户上parity check：78.2% vs 78.3%。
(2) **目录履约质量**：Generative Retrieval在所有7个维度均显著优于BM25、MiniLM和Hybrid基线（Bonferroni校正后p<0.001）。Overall：0.71 vs 0.56/0.39/0.49；最大增益在Completeness、Diversity、Hypothesis Coverage。
(3) **货架对齐效果**：Overall得分从0.71提升至1.27（+78%），Title Promise Fulfilment +99%，Shelf Coherence +56%，Item Relevance/Style Match +52%；所有内容类型均受益，播放列表与艺术家提升最显著。
(4) **在线随机曝光表现**（30秒流播率）：Album池最优（+36%，排1/10），Episode池微弱领先（+2%，排1/7），Artist池略弱（-8%，排2/9），Playlist池-14%（排5/15），Show池-41%（排2/6）；播客货架有显著改进空间。

Conclusion: 本文证明：通过显式货架假设作为中间规划表征，可将个性化货架规划与目录履约解耦，实现可表达且可运营扩展的推荐架构。蒸馏后假设生成仍保持高质量；生成式检索显著优于传统检索基线；候选选择与货架对齐显著改善货架连贯性与标题承诺满足度。在均匀随机曝光下，结果货架在不同内容类型上表现不同，但部分场景具备竞争力，并大幅扩展了个性化推荐的灵活性与多样性。论文主张推荐界面可通过显式货架概念生成而非固定模板库存来实现，从而突破手工货架分类法的扩展瓶颈。未来方向包括：标准生产排名下的评估、规划与履约的更紧密集成、从全预计算服务向近实时货架生成演进。

Abstract: Modern recommendation interfaces organise content into shelves: themed rows such as "More of What You Like" or "New Releases for You." In production systems, these shelves are typically defined through hand-crafted templates coupled with dedicated retrieval logic. While effective for broad recommendation intents, this approach does not scale to the long tail of individual taste. We present a content-hypothesis-driven shelf generation system for Spotify Home that replaces fixed templates with natural-language hypotheses describing what a personalised shelf should contain. The system has four stages hypothesis generation, catalogue fulfilment, shelf alignment, and offline serving. This decomposition decouples shelf planning from catalogue fulfilment, supports independent optimisation of planning and retrieval, and enables both constrained generative retrieval over catalogue entities and distillation of frontier LLM behaviour into compact models. Our production pipeline combines hypothesis generation, generative retrieval, candidate selection and shelf alignment, offline LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and precomputed serving.
