We fully characterise failure: weak shifts ($O(\varepsilon^4)$ collapse), degenerate geometry, and proxy attenuation ($O((1-\alpha)^4)$), giving practitioners quantitative criteria for assessing whether the regime holds. Finite-sample rates are $O_p(n^{-1})$ under the null and $O_p(n^{-1/2})$ under the alternative. Experiments confirm all theoretical predictions on synthetic data (area under the ROC curve [AUROC] $= 1.000$ under conditions satisfying the regime), show consistent rankings across five model families (Kendall $\tau\ge0.529$), and recover six of eight causal features on bike-sharing data (Precision@7 $= 0.75$) without modifying any trained model.

</details>


### [292] [Distilling Temporal Search and Reasoning: Evolving LLMs for Future Prediction via Harness-Assisted Efficient Data Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25554)
*Wanxu Cai,Zhengyu Chen,Huaisheng Zhu,Wei Wang,Jingang Wang,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种"时间截断"工具集成推理(TIR)数据合成框架,用于解决未来事件预测中的时间泄漏问题。该方法通过在智能体搜索的每一轮动态施加时间截止约束,使教师模型能够利用历史事件高效生成低泄漏的预测轨迹,并将这些轨迹蒸馏到学生模型中,从而将外部时序搜索与推理能力内化为参数化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来事件预测具有重要社会价值,但当前SOTA方法依赖外部智能体框架,移除框架后预测能力随之消失。Tool-Integrated Reasoning(TIR)虽能通过多跳检索内化深度搜索能力,但预测任务还需要"时序搜索与推理"——分析历史趋势、捕捉动态变化。核心障碍是数据问题:基于历史事件的查询会导致时间泄漏,使预测退化为简单检索;现有方法(静态观测、拒绝采样、未解析查询)各有局限,要么冻结信息收集过程,要么丢弃大量数据降低合成效率,要么面临强化学习的奖励稀疏和延迟问题。

Method: 1) **时间截断工具(Tim-Truncation Harness)**:为每个历史事件设置截止日期 T_cut = T_end - Δ_T,在每一轮工具调用中,通过API感知查询重写和后期网页过滤双重机制,将搜索环境限制为只返回 T_cut 之前发布的文档;2) **对齐系统提示**:将截止日期信息注入系统提示,使智能体行为与环境约束一致;3) **过程性指标Query Date-Span**:量化搜索查询中时间跨度的广度,衡量时序搜索深度;4) **数据合成**:使用Kimi-K2.5作为教师,在Manifold Markets构建12,378个跨30个领域的历史预测查询,生成有无harness的两组对比语料;5) **混合语料SFT蒸馏**:在Qwen3-8B和32B上进行全参数SFT,混合通用深度搜索轨迹与预测轨迹。

Result: 1) **泄漏与效率**:在200样本子集上,使用harness后有效轨迹比例从7.0%提升至88.5%,几乎完全消除日期级泄漏,大幅降低内容级泄漏;2) **语料统计**:harness干预下,虽然最终答案准确率下降5%-25%(因去除了检索捷径),但工具调用次数显著增加,Query Date-Span中位数从<150天扩展到>300天,说明模型被迫进行更深层的时序搜索与推理;3) **蒸馏效果(ForecastBench)**:Mix-SFT(w/ harness)在Brier Score上相比w/o harness版本,8B模型改善19.48%,32B模型改善22.04%;4) **蒸馏效果(FutureX)**:在困难任务(L3-L4)上,w/ harness版本在8B上提升13.46%/8.82%(4月/5月),32B上提升17.74%/14.08%;5) **学生模型过程性指标**:w/ harness版本继承了最广的Query Date-Span,且工具调用次数不是最高的,说明性能提升来自查询质量而非数量;6) **消融实验**:时间受限环境是主要机制,系统提示起辅助作用;Δ_T=3天为稳定设置。

Conclusion: 本文验证了一种"工具辅助模型演化"范式:通过时间截断harness干预教师的TIR轨迹合成,可显著降低时间泄漏、提高采样效率、并自然引导出更深层的时序搜索与推理行为。将这些高质量轨迹蒸馏到学生模型后,学生获得了真正的预测能力(而非检索捷径),证明了将外部harness的时序搜索与推理模式转化为小模型参数化能力的可行性。未来工作包括扩展模型规模验证泛化性,以及将harness改造为强化学习环境以支持在线策略优化。

Abstract: Future event prediction carries broad social impact yet remains challenging. SOTA approaches augment LLMs with external agent frameworks whose predictive capability vanishes once the harness is removed. While recent Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) internalizes deep search for multi-hop retrieval of facts, forecasting further demands temporal search and reasoning over historical trends and dynamic shifts. The key obstacle is data: historical queries induce temporal leakage that degrades forecasting into retrieval. Prior works either freeze information gathering with static observations, or rely on rejection sampling or unresolved fresh queries that discard vast amounts of data, degrading synthesis efficiency. We propose a time-truncation harness that enforces a temporal cut-off at every turn, enabling TIR-style sampling from historical events, reducing temporal leakage and reliance of rejection sampling or unsolved queries, increasing the sampling efficiency. We further build a large-scale corpus and a process-based metric and show that our harness naturally induces a broader temporal breadth of search and raises the proportion of high-quality data, further increasing the efficiency and reducing the reliance on complex rubrics. Distillation experiments show that students trained on harness-intervened data achieve the best performance, demonstrating harness-assisted model evolving that turns higher quality temporal search and reasoning data into a parametric advancement of the students.

</details>


### [293] [Agent Skills Matter: Inferring Proprietary Skills from Execution Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25560)
*Jianing Geng,Ruiqi He,Zekun Fei,Biao Yi,Ruijie Wang,Zheli Liu,Xia Hu,Xuansheng Wu,Qingkai Zeng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Skill Leakage（技能泄露）威胁：攻击者仅通过良性查询触发智能体执行轨迹，无需参考答案或成功标签，即可黑盒推断出专有的 agent 技能内容。作者提出 SigLeak 框架，通过构建多样化的诊断性查询，对比技能启用与禁用下的配对轨迹，迭代提取"技能签名"并重构技能指令。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 智能体能力增强，agent skills（封装可复用程序、工具使用规约的模块）成为重要的商业资产，通过 marketplace 和 Agent-as-a-Service 平台分发。然而尽管技能文档被隐藏在云端后端，其行为效应仍会体现在用户可见的执行轨迹中，形成"行为侧信道"。这给专有技能的知识产权保护带来严重威胁。现有研究要么依赖侵入式提示直接窃取，要么需要参考标签，与真实的黑盒部署威胁不符。

Method: SigLeak 采用两阶段工作流：(1) Stage 1 初始重建——Generator 仅依据公开任务描述生成 6 个多样性、决策密度高的诊断探针，Skill Synthesizer 对配对的"技能启用/禁用"轨迹进行对比，提取候选签名并初始化重构技能 ŝ₀。(2) Stage 2 差异引导优化——Generator 基于当前重构技能、已有探针摘要和累积签名，针对未充分探索的行为生成新探针，Synthesizer 迭代补充、澄清或修正签名，直至收敛或预算耗尽。关键设计包括：配对执行协议（同一探针在技能启用与禁用条件下执行以控制混淆变量）、skill signature 定义（可观察的、可复用的、与任务无关的行为模式）。评估涵盖 5 个场景（SpreadsheetBench、OfficeQA、SealQA、LiveMath、ALFWorld）、3 个模型家族、3 个智能体框架，使用下游成功率（SR）和 SkillSim（粗粒度 + 基于 SBC 的细粒度语义相似度）作为指标。

Result: 在所有模型-智能体配置中，SigLeak 几乎在所有设置下都达到最佳或并列最佳 SR，相比无技能基线平均提升 6.88 个百分点（直接生成 3.25，朴素轨迹摘要 3.74，添加了 SkillGuard5 提示防御的 BBS 完全失效）。在 SkillSim 上 SigLeak 取得最高的粗粒度分数和细粒度 F1/recall。域内消融显示 SigLeak 能区分同一任务域内具有不同流程的技能（对角占优）。两阶段消融显示 Stage 2 主要增益集中在前两轮。ALFWorld 是例外，因其技能签名直接在轨迹中可观察，朴素摘要接近 SigLeak。

Conclusion: 专有技能即使文档被隐藏并配有提示防御，其程序性知识仍可通过良性执行轨迹泄露。SigLeak 验证了这一行为侧信道的实际威胁，表明诊断性探针 + 对比式轨迹分析能有效解耦技能效应与基础行为。论文呼吁开发能在保留执行可见性（用于人类监督）的同时缓解行为推断的防御机制。

Abstract: Agent skills package reusable procedures that improve downstream performance. Their lightweight, portable form enables marketplace monetization and private deployment behind cloud-hosted agent interfaces, giving providers incentives to keep high-value skills proprietary. Yet hiding the artifacts does not conceal their behavioral effects, which remain observable in execution trajectories and form a behavioral side channel. We define this exposure as Skill Leakage: reconstructing proprietary skills from trajectories elicited by benign queries, without reference answers or success labels. We introduce SigLeak, a black-box framework that exploits recurring skill signatures in agent behavior. It constructs diverse, decision-rich diagnostic tasks, contrasts matched skill-enabled and skill-disabled trajectories, and iteratively refines a reconstructed skill from the isolated patterns. Across five scenarios, three model families, and three agent frameworks, SigLeak outperforms or matches three baselines in nearly every setting. It raises the success rate by 6.88 percentage points over the skill-disabled reference on average and achieves the highest overall SkillSim, our metric for coarse- and fine-grained semantic similarity. These results show that benign execution trajectories can expose proprietary procedural knowledge. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [294] [Matrix-Free Photoacoustic Image Reconstruction via Sensor-Token Self-Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25576)
*Mary John,Shibili Said,Imad Barhumi,Sherzod Turaev,Mohamed Yahia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的"传感器注意力网络"（SAN），将每个传感器的完整时间序列视为一个token，直接从原始光声传感器测量数据映射到重建图像，无需在推理时调用系统矩阵（H矩阵）。该方法在46个测试样本上以最高SSIM（0.522）、最高PSNR（22.09 dB）和最低NMSE（0.233）显著优于ISTA、SBTV和LISTA基线，同时将推理延迟降低至少一个数量级，支持实时临床光声断层成像重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光声断层成像（PAT）从稀疏视角的传感器测量重建初始压力分布是一个不适定的逆问题。经典的迭代压缩感知求解器（ISTA、SBTV）和展开式深度网络（LISTA）在推理时都依赖系统矩阵（H矩阵）的反复矩阵-向量乘法，对于临床相关的网格分辨率而言计算成本过高，难以实现实时重建。因此需要一种能够在推理时完全绕过H矩阵的直接数据驱动重建方法。

Method: 1. **解析k空间H矩阵构建**：基于伪谱k空间方法推导H = K·W_fwd的分解形式，将图像映射到所有传感器的测量数据。引入两种正则化策略——k空间Hann窗抑制Gibbs混叠、高斯时间阻尼（τ=0.9T）抑制晚期非物理振荡；2. **传感器注意力网络（SAN）架构**：每个传感器的160点时间序列通过共享线性投影映射为d_model=128维token，叠加正弦位置编码后输入2层Transformer编码器块（每块包含4头多头自注意力子层和位置前馈网络），最后通过3层全连接空间解码器（含ReLU和sigmoid激活）输出64×64归一化重建图像；3. **训练策略**：采用血管加权MSE损失（血管像素权重8，背景权重1），Adam优化器（lr=3e-4，每80个epoch减半），共训练300个epoch，488个增强样本，约1800万可训练参数。

Result: H矩阵与k-Wave参考的均方传感器Pearson相关系数达到r̄=0.919±0.049（71个传感器全部超过r=0.80），两种正则化协同使能量归一化NMSE降低49%；奇异值谱k99从3744压缩至1139（3.3倍）。在46样本独立测试集上，SAN取得SSIM=0.522±0.225、PSNR=22.09±7.42 dB、NMSE=0.233±0.172，三个指标均为四方法最佳。配对t检验和Wilcoxon符号秩检验显示SAN对LISTA在PSNR、NMSE和Pearson相关上以p<10^-8显著优于，对ISTA和SBTV在所有保真度指标上均显著优于；SSIM上SAN与LISTA统计不可区分（p=0.55）。推理时间方面，SAN仅需单次前向传播（约1-5 ms），相比需要数百次矩阵乘积的迭代基线减少至少一个数量级。

Conclusion: 工作证明基于Transformer的传感器即token架构可在完全绕过H矩阵的情况下产出高质量PAT重建，统计上显著优于经典迭代方法和最强学习基线LISTA，同时将推理延迟降低至少一个数量级，满足实时临床PAT重建需求。主要局限在于训练语料库规模有限（191个幻影体经数据增强至488个样本）、解析H矩阵基于均匀无损耗介质假设、以及仅在单一网格间距和传感器配置下评估；未来工作包括扩展多样化血管拓扑数据、引入物理信息损失项、扩展至三维PAT与异质声学介质，以及将传感器即token范式推广到热声断层和超声CT等相关成像模态。

Abstract: Photoacoustic tomography (PAT) combines the optical absorption contrast of biological tissue with the spatial resolution of ultrasound, yet recovering the initial pressure distribution from sparse-view sensor measurements remains an ill-posed inverse problem. Iterative compressive-sensing solvers and unrolled deep networks both retain a dependence on the system matrix at inference, which leaves real-time clinical reconstruction computationally expensive. This paper proposes the Sensor Attention Network (SAN), a Transformer-based architecture that treats the full time series of each sensor as a token and maps raw measurements directly to the reconstructed image without invoking the system matrix at inference. For training and benchmarking, an analytical k-space H-matrix is constructed and validated against the k-Wave pseudo-spectral solver under matched geometry, achieving a mean per-sensor Pearson correlation of 0.919 +/- 0.049, with k-space apodization and Gaussian temporal damping acting synergistically to reduce the energy-normalized mismatch by 49%. Trained with a vessel-weighted loss on 488 augmented samples and evaluated on 46 held-out samples against ISTA, split-Bregman total variation (SBTV), and learned ISTA (LISTA), SAN attains the highest mean SSIM (0.522) and PSNR (22.09 dB) and the lowest NMSE (0.233). Paired t-tests and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests confirm the superiority of SAN over LISTA on PSNR, NMSE, and Pearson correlation at p < 1e-8, and over ISTA and SBTV on all fidelity metrics. By bypassing the H-matrix at inference, SAN reduces reconstruction time by at least an order of magnitude, supporting real-time PAT reconstruction.

</details>


### [295] [How Small Can You Go? A Controlled Study of LoRA Rank, Target Modules, and Quantization Trade-offs for Text-to-SQL on a 60M-Parameter Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25583)
*Mahendra Singh Rathor,Anagheem Azzam*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对60M参数的T5-small模型在WikiSQL文本到SQL任务上，系统研究了LoRA秩、目标模块选择和量化精度（FP16/INT8/NF4）三个效率维度的单变量消融实验。核心发现：LoRA r=16作用于{q,v}模块是Pareto最优配置（59.6%精确匹配，仅训练0.97%参数、1.60GB显存），而QLoRA NF4以0.60GB显存实现53.2%精度，适合内存受限场景；秩超过16后精度饱和，模块扩展收益递减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PEFT和量化的研究主要在十亿参数级大模型上进行，设计空间探索成本高昂。小模型（如T5-small, 60M参数）虽在实际部署中广泛使用，但其在秩选择、目标模块、量化精度之间的权衡缺乏系统性、可复现的消融研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，明确各"效率旋钮"在严格资源约束下对精度和系统成本的真实代价。

Method: 采用受控单变量消融设计：基座为T5-small编码器-解码器（60M参数），任务为WikiSQL单表text-toSQL（训练5000条/验证500条）。变动三组变量：(1) LoRA秩 r∈{2,4,8,16,32}；(2) 适配模块集 {q,v}、{q,k,v,o}、{q,v}+FFN；(3) 数值精度 FP16、INT8（LLM.int8()）、NF4 4-bit（QLoRA），QLoRA在r=8、{q,v}上叠加。统一超参（AdamW，lr=5e-4，batch=8，3 epoch，beam=4），三组随机种子（42/123/456）报告均值与方差。联合记录精确匹配、执行准确率（仅25条可执行子集）、可训练参数数、峰值显存、单查询延迟、吞吐，并将适配建模为受约束优化（精度对参数/显存/延迟预算的Pareto前沿分析）。硬件为单卡NVIDIA T4 (16GB)。

Result: 关键结果（种子42）：全量微调71.2% EM / 84.0% Exec，2.31GB显存；LoRA r=16 {q,v} 达59.6% EM / 80.0% Exec，参数589,824（0.97%），1.60GB（降低31%）；r=32仅微涨至60.4%，无显著增益。模块层面：r=8时扩展至{q,k,v,o}提升5.8点但参数+71%；加FFN精度不增反微降。量化层面：QLoRA INT8与NF4分别52.8%/53.2% EM，显存均0.60GB（较FP16降低62%），但INT8推理延迟较高（921ms/query）因T4反量化开销；NF4推理614ms、34 tok/s，是量化首选。三种子下秩排序稳定，低秩方差较大（r=2 std=0.063），量化配置方差极小（INT8 std=0.006），体现正则化效应。LoRA r=16 {q,v}在精度-参数、精度-显存两个Pareto图上均占优。

Conclusion: 在T5-small/WikiSQL设定下，推荐配方为LoRA r=16作用于{q,v}模块（FP16），以0.97%参数、1.60GB显存恢复全量微调83.7%精度；强内存约束场景则选QLoRA NF4（0.60GB、53.2% EM）。秩在16处出现明显饱和，模块扩展效率低于提升秩；LoRA适配器在此规模下显存开销可忽略，主要瓶颈在冻结基座权重与优化器状态。结论受限于单模型、单基准、单表任务，是否迁移至多表基准（Spider/BIRD）或更大模型仍需进一步验证。所有代码与日志开源以支持可复现性研究。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) and low-bit quantization are now standard tools for adapting language models under tight compute budgets, yet their interaction is most often studied on billion-parameter models where the design space is expensive to explore. We ask a complementary question: on a specific, fully reproducible 60M-parameter encoder-decoder model (T5-small) and a single-table text-to-SQL benchmark (WikiSQL), how much task accuracy does each efficiency knob actually cost? We run a controlled, single-variable study over (i) LoRA rank r in {2, 4, 8, 16, 32}, (ii) the set of adapted modules, and (iii) numerical precision. We report task accuracy alongside system-level metrics including trainable parameters, peak training memory, inference latency, and throughput, and frame adaptation as a constrained trade-off rather than an accuracy-only objective. Our results show that LoRA with r=16 recovers within 11.6 percentage points of full fine-tuning accuracy (59.6% vs. 71.2% exact-match) while training fewer than 1% of parameters and consuming 31% less peak GPU memory. Within this setting, rank beyond r=16 yields no measurable accuracy gain. QLoRA with INT8 and NF4 quantization achieves comparable accuracy (52.8% and 53.2%) at dramatically lower memory cost (0.60 GB each), demonstrating a compelling trade-off for memory-constrained deployments. All code, configurations, and logs are released for full reproducibility.

</details>


### [296] [A Density-Matrix Framework for Electronic-Structure Analysis of Functional-Group and Salt Effects in Lithium-Metal Electrolytes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25597)
*Mingkang Liu,Huize Yu,Yanbin Gao,Nan Yao,Xiang Chen,Lei Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了EMolStudio——一个以密度矩阵为核心的AI平台，用于在库规模下预测和分析锂金属电解质的电子结构。该平台整合了分子官能化、Li⁺第一壳层构建、密度矩阵预测（带幂等性投影）以及电子结构描述符（前线轨道、ESP、Li⁺-供体键级、ELF）的读取。作者将其应用于163,655个官能化分子和22,500个显式Li⁺第一壳层簇，系统揭示了官能团类型（如CO₂Me、CN、F/CF₃、磺酰基）和锂盐种类（LiPF₆、LiFSI、LiDFOB、LiTDI）对前线轨道定位、静电势、Li⁺-供体接触及电子局域化的差异化影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 锂金属电池电解液设计中，分子官能团、Li⁺溶剂化壳层和阴离子参与之间的电子密度重分布决定了界面反应活性和去溶剂化行为。然而，量子化学计算在多维设计空间中计算成本极高，而现有的机器学习电子结构模型又缺乏对多样化溶剂化壳层和电解液相关描述符的覆盖。因此需要一个高通量且化学结构一致的电子结构分析框架，将分子结构直接映射到与电解液性能相关的空间分辨电子读数。

Method: 方法学核心是一个以密度矩阵为统一表示的集成平台EMolStudio，包含四个模块：(1) EMolConf：基于通用原子势（UMA）进行分子官能化和Li⁺第一壳层簇的构建与弛；(2) EMolES：基于DeePTB框架的密度矩阵预测模型，采用键对齐SO(2)消息传递、EACE边自混合模块和静电感知消息传递（EAMP），并通过对称正交化和自然轨道投影施加幂等性约束（得到EMolES-i变体），保证电子数守恒和闭壳层占据；(3) EMolPipe：将密度矩阵转化为前线轨道能级、ESP极值、Li⁺-供体键级、ELF变形因子和片段轨道权重等描述符；(4) EMolAgent：大语言模型协处理器，将自然语言设计问题翻译为结构化任务并组织分析视图。

Result: 在自建测试集上，EMolES-i在密度矩阵MAE、前线轨道能级、偶极矩、ESP极值、Li⁺-ELF变形因子和Li⁺-供体键级等所有描述符上均优于或与LEM、SLEM、QHNet持平。在训练集外的Li₁(DFTFB)₁(FEC)₁(DEC)₂簇上，EMolES-i正确预测了HOMO 99.1%定域于DFTFB⁻、LUMO 96.7%定域于FEC的分配。在1000帧Li⁺配体交换路径上，结合能MAE为0.084 eV（r=0.995），优于UMA（0.380 eV）。在163,655个分子上发现：CO₂Me引起最大单点位LUMO稳定化（-0.983 eV，π*受主特征）；CN同时降低HOMO/LUMO并增强局部正电场；F/CF₃展现分级氟化趋势；磺酰基导致最大的极性、ESP和Li⁺-供体接触综合变化；多位点官能化呈现亚线性累积。在22,500个Li⁺第一壳层簇上发现：LiPF₆以前线轨道溶剂定域为主；LiTDI的5,625个HOMO全部为阴离子定域；LiDFOB的LUMO定域强烈依赖官能团（CN结构97.9%溶剂定域 vs OMe结构0.4%）；总Li⁺-供体键级主要受盐种类和壳层拓扑支配（LiDFOB在富阴离子MX₂基序中介值升至0.948）。

Conclusion: 本研究建立了一个以密度矩阵为中心的层次化电子结构理解框架：官能团调节受体能级、局域电场和供体特性；盐阴离子影响第一壳层前线态定域；配位拓扑调节Li⁺-环境总体接触。EMolStudio将功能基团和盐的选择转化为与锂键形成、去溶剂化和界面反应相关的可检验电子结构假说，为锂金属电解液的理性设计和自动化发现提供了理论基础和计算工具。

Abstract: The reactivity of lithium-metal electrolytes arises from the interplay of molecular functional groups, Li$^+$ solvation, and salt-anion participation. This interplay operates through the redistribution of electron density across donor, anion, and cation centers, which is most directly read out from the electronic structure resolved in space. Quantum-chemical calculations deliver such readouts faithfully, yet become computationally demanding across this multidimensional design space, and machine-learning electronic-structure models seldom cover chemically diverse solvation shells or electrolyte-relevant readouts. Here, we present a density-matrix-centered AI platform (EMolStudio) for electronic-structure prediction and analysis. Its workflow integrates molecular functionalization, explicit Li$^+$ first-shell assembly, density-matrix prediction with idempotency projection, and readouts of frontier orbitals, electrostatic potential, Li$^+$-donor bond order, and electron localization. We apply EMolStudio to 163,655 functionalized molecules and 22,500 explicit Li$^+$ first-shell clusters across four lithium salts. We find that 1) at the molecular scale, functionalization distinguishes CO$_2$Me, CN, F/CF$_3$, and sulfonyl groups by chemically distinct changes in frontier levels, electrostatic potential, and Li$^+$-donor contact, consistent with $\pi^*$-acceptor, inductive, and polarization contributions, with sublinear accumulation at higher degrees of functionalization; 2) in explicit solvation shells, anion identity reshapes frontier-orbital localization: LiTDI anchors the HOMO on the anion across the entire library, whereas LiDFOB pairs an anion-hosted HOMO with strongly functional-group-dependent LUMO hosting. EMolStudio thereby translates functional-group and salt choices into electronic-structure hypotheses relevant to lithium-bond formation, desolvation, and interphase reactions.

</details>


### [297] [Computational Extraction of Legal Causes via al-Sabr wa al-Taqsim: A Set-Theoretic Formalization for Closed Fiqh Chapters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25605)
*Elnaser Abdelwahab*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对伊斯兰法学（Fiqh）中的经典方法 al-Ṣabr wa al-Taqsim（考察与分割），提出了一种集合论形式的计算化形式化方案。该方法在"封闭章节"（Closed Chapter）的设定下，将法学裁定表示为有限真值表，通过计算算法提取最小结构生成子（即候选法律原因 'ilal），并消除逻辑冗余属性。该框架属于条件性理论，仅在章节的法学概念词汇封闭且裁定表完整的条件下成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伊斯兰法学传统中的法律原因（'illah）提取是 Usul al-Fiqh 的核心任务之一，但传统方法依赖于不完全归纳与类比推理，缺乏严格的形式化。本文旨在借助 Avicennian/Aristotelian 逻辑的演绎框架，将法学裁定置于有限布尔真值表中进行可计算的结构分析，从而：(1) 实现从不完全归纳到完全归纳的转换；(2) 为跨法学学派（Madhhab）的结构性比较提供计算手段；(3) 自动化识别最小候选原因与阻止因素（Mani'）。

Method: 方法包含以下核心要素：

1. **封闭章节假设（Closed Chapter Assumption）**：基于封闭世界假设（CWA），将特定法学学派的 Matn/Mukhtasar 文本视为概念词汇固定的封闭领域，使概念集合 V 有限，进而状态空间为 2^n。

2. **本体概念树（OCT）**：通过映射 ϕ: Ω → {0,1}^n 将无限现实案例编码为有限概念表示。

3. **模块化分解**：复杂章节（如 Hajj）可分解为子章节（如 Tahara → Salah → Hajj），每个子章节的输出作为父章节的单一二元变量输入，避免组合爆炸。

4. **三阶段算法**：
   - **Algorithm 1（规则提取）**：自顶向下枚举所有变量子集 P ⊂ V 的估值 w，检查其投影 H_w 是否单值，从而提取有效规则 R: w ⇒ h。
   - **Algorithm 2（规则最小化）**：去除被更小子规则蕴含的非最小规则，得到最小规则集 M。
   - **Algorithm 3（Usuli 演绎）**：从正最小规则 M^+ 计算共享条件 S = ∩R（Shurut 候选），分支因子 I_i = R_i \ S（候选 'illah），并从负最小规则 M^- 中识别阻止因素（Mani'）。

5. **复杂度分析**：尽管子集投影的组合数为 3^n（指数级），但封闭章节中 n = k 为固定常数，故整个流水线具有 O(1) 上界。

Result: 本文证明了若干关键定理：
- **概念有限性定理（Theorem 2）**：有限概念集合诱导有限法律状态空间。
- **完全推论性（Corollary 10）**：封闭章节允许完全归纳。
- **Shurut 提取正确性（Theorem 15）**：S = ∩_{R∈M^+} R 恰好是所有必要条件。
- **分支因子提取正确性（Theorem 16）**：I_i = R_i \ S 正确提取分支特定成分。
- **冗余字面量消除（Theorem 21）**：最小规则不可能包含虚假标志（false flag）。
- **结构分解与同延性（Theorem 23）**：h ⇔ S ∧ I*，即裁定函数分解为共享条件与候选原因析取。
- **结构健全性（Theorem 24）**：算法精确计算裁定函数的子集最小蕴含部分估值。
- **封闭资源消耗（Theorem 25）**：固定封闭章节下算法为 O(1)。
- 通过 Tahara → Salah → Hajj 的分层示例验证了模块化分解的有效性（如 10 个原子变量扁平化需 1024 行，分层处理仅需 56 行）。
- 与 Quine-McCluskey 算法的对比表明，本文方法更适合法学任务，支持多值裁定（Ahkam）、对称提取 Mani'、以及保留因果路径结构。
- 同时指出了方法的语义边界：算法仅建立结构合法性，不涉及语义适当性（munasabah）。

Conclusion: 本文为伊斯兰法学中的 al-Ṣabr wa al-Taqsim 方法提供了严格、可计算的集合论形式化框架。在封闭章节假设下，该框架能够：(1) 计算裁定函数的最小结构生成子；(2) 消除逻辑冗余属性；(3) 提取形式上可接受的候选原因（'illah）与阻止因素（Mani'）。该框架是一条件性理论——其有效性依赖于具体章节是否满足概念封闭性，而非声称所有法学章节必然封闭。语义验证（如 munasabah）仍需由法学家（faqih）完成。该工作为跨法学学派（Madhhab）的结构性比较、章节约束下法律原因的自动提取、以及 Usul al-Fiqh 的计算化研究提供了新的形式基础与实用工具。

Abstract: This paper presents a set-theoretic formalization of the classical usuli method of al-Sabr wa al-Taqsim (Examination and Division) for extracting legal causes ('ilal) within closed chapters of jurisprudence. A computational algorithm is introduced that extracts minimal operational rules from a truth table of juristic verdicts. The principal result is that, given a complete truth table for a closed chapter, the algorithm computes the minimal structural generators of the ruling and eliminates all logically redundant attributes. The resulting structures constitute admissible candidate causes for subsequent juristic evaluation. The framework is conditional upon the availability of a finite school-relative concept vocabulary and a complete ruling table for the chapter under investigation.

</details>


### [298] [Multi-Sensor Alignment for Weather Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25612)
*Samsad Alam,Devyani Lambhate,Aditya Mohan,Vishal Kumar,Vaibhav Katewa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出两种多传感器天气仿真对齐方法：ReDAM（用于雾的强度对齐）和Unified-weather-edit（用于雨雪的粒子位置对齐），解决LiDAR与Camera仿真不一致问题，从而为自动驾驶3D目标检测提供更真实的恶劣天气数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶3D感知需在雾、雨、雪等恶劣天气下可靠工作，但真实恶劣天气数据集稀缺。现有仿真方法通常独立模拟各传感器，导致天气严重程度和粒子分布在跨模态间不一致，与真实场景存在偏差，可能使检测模型过于乐观。

Method: 1. **ReDAM**（针对均匀介质如雾）：以"Seeing Through Fog"（STF）真实数据集为参考，通过KS统计量最小化调整LiDAR仿真参数(α, β)，并匹配Camera风格图像，实现严重程度对齐。2. **Unified-weather-edit**（针对非均匀介质如雨雪）：在统一3D世界坐标系下采样粒子位置，通过世界→LiDAR和世界→Camera的变换矩阵，分别在各传感器坐标系中渲染同一粒子，实现空间和时间对齐。使用重投影误差、KS统计量、FID/KID、MMD距离进行验证。

Result: 1. 雾对齐：轻雾和浓雾的KS值分别为0.092和0.131，FID值约为3.28–4.30；2. 粒子对齐：LiDAR-Camera重投影误差<1像素，优于未对齐版本（MMD距离更低）；3. 未对齐版本在3D检测中比对齐版本虚高2-3%（雨）和1%（雪）mAP；4. 使用对齐的仿真数据微调BEVFusion等融合模型，在恶劣天气上mAP提升0.03-0.13，同时混合微调（30%仿真+70%真实）保持清洁天气性能。

Conclusion: ReDAM和Unified-weather-edit生成的跨传感器对齐天气仿真更贴近真实情况，可有效用于提升融合模型对恶劣天气和清洁天气的鲁棒性。未来工作将扩展到更大规模数据集（nuScenes trainval）、更多传感器（如雷达）及混合天气场景。

Abstract: Perception tasks for autonomous vehicles need to work satisfactorily in adverse weather conditions. Due to lack of real-world weather datasets, weather simulations are a promising alternative. To ensure simulations closely mirror real-world weather data, it's crucial that they represent the same weather characteristics, including severity and particle positioning, across different sensors. To achieve this, we propose the Reference Dataset Alignment Method (ReDAM) for weather intensity alignment in fog and Unified-weather-edit (inspired by Weather-edit[1]) for particle positioning alignment in rain and snow. We validate both alignment methods using statistical and geometrical tests, respectively. We find that 3D detection models for non-aligned versions tend to be overly optimistic as compared to aligned versions. We also show the aligned-multi-sensor simulation's effectiveness for achieving robustness for 3D object detection task by finetuning existing sensor fusion models on it.

</details>


### [299] [Beyond Epistemia: Epistemic Schizologia and Large Language Models as Techno-Semiotic Machines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25620)
*Federico Cabitza,Gianluca Colombo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文接受Quattrociocchi等人关于"认识论流感"(Epistemia)的诊断——即LLM的流畅输出使语言可信度替代了认识论评估——但批评其解释框架。该框架将人类认知者与孤立的生成模型进行"内部主义"对比，将认识合法性定位于自主主体内部能力。作者借用Carlo Sini的实践哲学、皮尔士符号学，提出将LLM视为"技术-符号机器"(techno-semiotic machine)，主张核心问题不在于模型本身是否具备人类式判断能力，而在于"认识论分裂"(epistemic schizologia)：语言表达与社会嵌入式阐释回路之间的社会技术裂隙，并据此提出五项设计承诺。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Quattrociocchi等人的Epistemia概念虽有效识别了LLM带来的危险（流畅性伪装知识），但其解释框架存在内部主义预设：将已具身的、处于社会情境中的人类认知者与从训练、检索、界面、使用者、组织语境中剥离出来的孤立生成模型进行阶段式对比（如"七条断层线"），由此预先确立了不对称性而非真正发现不对称性。这种比较在本体论层面上将处于不同描述层级的实体并置，导致实践维度被化约为对模型内部缺陷的补偿。要回应生成式AI的认识论挑战，需要一个将实践本身视为认识地位之构成性场所而非补偿性资源的框架。

Method: 本文采用哲学概念分析与框架重构的方法，主要步骤包括：(1) 检视Quattrociocchi等人的七阶段"断层线"对比，揭示其内部主义预设；(2) 引入Carlo Sini关于实践、书写、符号与技术的哲学，以及皮尔士的符号学和"四项无能"，论证人类认知本身从不是孤立的内在活动，而是历史性地通过技术-符号外化构成；(3) 将LLM重新概念化为"技术-符号机器"——处于人类书写积淀档案下游与阐释-验证-制度化上游之间的环节，自动化书面符号过程的一个阶段；(4) 通过与达达主义先锋派实验的对照（Dada试图打破惯例，LLM则统计放大惯例），阐明符号意义始终由历史构成的实践产生；(5) 引入"认识论分裂"(epistemic schizologia)、"似真闭合"(eikotic closure)、"算法权威"与"认识自我误认"等新概念，描述裂隙的双向维系机制；(6) 以临床场景中裸模型与带检索/验证/会签工作流的模型对比作为示例。

Result: 主要理论成果：(1) 提出"认识论分裂"(epistemic schizologia)概念，命名符号作为语言完成表达与符号作为社会嵌入式阐释回路时刻之间的社会技术裂隙，并将其刻画为皮尔士意义上的"保证的去索引化"(de-indexicalization of warrant)——符号性惯例与图像性特征仍运作，但将特定主张追溯至文献、观察、来源、实验、探究行为的索引性关系被削弱、隐藏或不可获取；(2) 提出"似真闭合"(eikotic closure)概念，命名从系统设计端朝向用户的运动——将看似合理的语言延续以认识论结果的交互终态呈现；(3) 提出五项设计承诺取代内部能力补偿思路——可审查的谱系(inspectable genealogy)、异议与否定性的保留、分布式作者身份与责任、用户认识能动性的保留、混合实践的评价，并将提示词与对齐本身重新概念化为具有认识论意义的设计对象。

Conclusion: 本文主张：认识论合法性应在实践层面而非主体内部能力层面加以理解。LLM并不需要被改造为人类式认识主体方可参与认识生活；关键问题是整个生成-阐释-验证-使用-后果的回路是否得以保留，从而确保生成的铭写能够被重新嵌入保证其权威性的符号过程中。Quattrociocchi等人提出的可追溯性、不确定性传达、人工审查、弃权、不告知所"未做"之事等具体措施在Sinian重构下仍属必要，但其理论语法应从"补偿模型内部缺陷"转为"构成认识地位"。当社会引入生成系统时，关键不在于机器是否"知道"，而在于当知识的符号可以被空前速度与流畅度生成时，探究、判断、验证与认识保证的实践应如何重组。

Abstract: Quattrociocchi and colleagues warn that the fluent outputs of large language models may allow linguistic plausibility to substitute for epistemic evaluation, producing the condition they call *Epistemia*: the experience of possessing knowledge without undertaking the practices through which judgment would ordinarily be warranted. This article accepts that diagnosis but challenges its explanatory framework, which compares an embodied, socially situated human knower with an isolated generative model thereby locating epistemic legitimacy in capacities internal to autonomous agents. Drawing on Carlo Sini's philosophy of practices, writing, signs, and technics, we propose instead to understand a large language model (LLM) as a *techno-semiotic machine* that automates a phase of written semiosis by producing plausible linguistic configurations from the sedimented archive of human writing. From this perspective, *Epistemia* is one consequence of a broader phenomenon that we call *epistemic schizologia*: the socio-technical cleavage between signs as linguistically accomplished expressions and signs as moments within socially embedded circuits of interpretation, evidence, criticism, verification, and responsibility. This cleavage is reinforced by *eikotic closure*, through which a plausible continuation is presented with the finality of an epistemic result, and by algorithmic authority and epistemic self-misrecognition. The relevant unit is therefore not the model alone but the complete practice in which generated inscriptions are prompted, interpreted, verified, contested, used, and made consequential. This reframing preserves the distinction between linguistic production and responsible understanding while grounding a design programme centred on inspectable genealogy, contestability, distributed responsibility, epistemic agency, and the evaluation of hybrid human--AIpractices.

</details>


### [300] [Quotient Dynamics, Effective Curvature, and Implicit Bias in Positive Quadratic Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25624)
*Pengcheng Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究正二次网络（positive quadratic networks） $f_U(x)=x^\top UU^\top x$ 的训练动力学、有效曲率与隐式偏置。核心贡献是证明在满秩层上 $\mathbb{R}^{d\times r}_*/O(r)$ 与秩 $r$ 半正定矩阵流形 $\mathcal{M}_r^+$ 微分同胚，并由此推出：欧氏因子梯度流精确投影到商 Riemann 梯度流；有限步梯度下降产生精确的合同递推；在 Gauss 秩一测量下构造谱初始化并给出局部指数/线性收敛的显式但保守的恢复保证；在未定 commuting 测量下，因子流恰好是带权熵 mirror flow，其极限为 Bregman 投影，各向同性小初始化趋向最小迹解（再由熵打破非唯一性），离散步与连续极限的偏差为 $O(\eta)$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过参数化模型在参数空间中优化，但所表示的预测器空间更小；正二次网络 $Q=UU^\top$ 的因子分解 $U\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times r}$ 在右乘正交群 $O(r)$ 下不唯一，产生冗余"规范"方向。这一商结构如何影响（i）因子训练动力学的投影行为；（ii）去除规范后的内蕴曲率与局部收敛速率；（iii）Gauss 秩一测量下的恢复保证；（iv）欠定 commuting 体制下从初始化出发的内插偏置——是本文核心问题。已有工作或聚焦商几何本身、或依赖低秩景观的全局分析，本文目标是从"商结构 → 实际因子动力学 → 内蕴曲率 → 局部速率与恢复 → 显式内插偏置"形成一条完整推理链。

Method: 1. **精确商几何**（§2）：证明满秩层上 $UU^\top=VV^\top \Leftrightarrow V=UR,\ R\in O(r)$，给出垂直/水平空间分解及由 Frobenius 内积诱导的商度量；建立 Procrustes 距离。
2. **精确投影动力学**（§2）：证明 $\nabla L(U)=2G(UU^\top)U$ 为水平向量场，从而欧氏因子梯度流精确投影到 $\dot Q=-2(G(Q)Q+QG(Q))$，即 $(\mathcal{M}_r^+,g)$ 上的 Riemann 梯度流；有限步下降产生合同递推 $Q_{k+1}=(I-2\eta G_k)Q_k(I-2\eta G_k)$。
3. **有效曲率与高斯恢复**（§3）：利用 Isserlis 恒等式计算总体法算子 $\mathcal T(H)=2H+\mathrm{tr}(H)I_d$；通过 Hilbert–Schmidt 二阶矩控制证明全空间 $\|\mathcal T_n-\mathcal T\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le\varepsilon$ 的概率界；构造矩估计谱初始化 $\mathcal P_{r,+}(M_n)$；建立 secant 正则性不等式与局域 $\rho_n$ 邻域内 $\alpha_\star=\tfrac12\lambda_r(Q_\star)$ 的指数/线性收敛；端到端给出 $n=O(r^2d^8\delta^{-1}(\|Q_\star\|_F/\lambda_r(Q_\star))^2)$ 的充分样本量。
4. **未定 commuting 体制的隐式偏置**（§4）：在联合谱投影 $P_a$ 下，因子流约化为 $q_a$ 的 mirror flow $\dot q_a=-\tfrac{4q_a}{d_a}\big[\tfrac1n B^\top(Bq-y)\big]_a$，对应生成函数 $h(q)=\tfrac14\sum d_a(q_a\log q_a-q_a)$；证明严格正初始化下收敛至 Bregman 投影 $\Pi_h(q^0)$；各向同性 $q^0=\varepsilon^2\mathbf 1$ 时证明 $\varepsilon\downarrow 0$ 趋向最小迹面并在 commuting 代数内由加权熵进一步选取唯一点；有限步下降的极限 $q_\eta$ 与连续 Bregman 投影之差为 $O(\eta)$。
5. **数值实验**（§5）：验证正交等价的因子初始化产生相同预测器（误差 $10^{-15}$）；最小有效特征值精确预测局部流速（误差 $<2.4\times10^{-4}$）；谱初始化在远小于理论充分样本量下实现恢复；commuting 体制下 mirror flow 与 Bregman 投影一致（误差 $10^{-10}$）；最小迹、熵选择及 $O(\eta)$ 离散偏差。

Result: 1. 商结构精确刻画：$\mathbb{R}^{d\times r}_*/O(r)\cong\mathcal{M}_r^+$（定理 2.1）。
2. 欧氏因子梯度流精确等价于商 Riemann 梯度流；有限步诱导合同递推（定理 2.3，命题 2.6）。
3. 二次回归下商 Hessian 为 $\frac{1}{n}\|\mathcal A_n(H)\|_2^2$，核空间 $T_{Q_\star}\mathcal{M}_r^+\cap\ker\mathcal A_n$（定理 3.1）；总体/经验法算子上下界及全空间集中界 $\|\mathcal T_n-\mathcal T\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le\varepsilon$（引理 3.1，推论 3.1，定理 3.2）。
4. 谱初始化 $\mathcal P_{r,+}(M_n)$ 以 $1-\delta$ 概率落入半径 $\rho_n/2$ 的 Procrustes 球（定理 3.4，推论 3.2）。
5. 局部收敛：梯度流 $\exp(-\lambda_r(Q_\star)t/2)$ 指数收敛；梯度下降在 $0<\eta\le\alpha_\star/L_\star^2$ 下线性收敛 $(1-\eta\lambda_r/4)^k$（推论 3.3, 3.4, 定理 3.6–3.9）。
6. 端到端恢复保证（显式但保守）：$n\ge N_\star(\delta)$ 下初始化、流、下降同步成立（定理 3.9）。
7. commuting 体制下 mirror-flow 全局收敛至 Bregman 投影，残差指数衰减（定理 4.3）。
8. 各向同性初始化 $\varepsilon^2\mathbf 1$：$\mathrm{dist}(q_\varepsilon,\mathcal S_{\mathrm{tr}})\to 0$ 且 $\tau(q_\varepsilon)-\tau_\star\le\frac{\psi(q^\star)+d}{\log(1/\varepsilon^2)}$；最小迹面在 commuting 代数内由加权熵唯一选取 $q_{\mathrm{ent}}$（定理 4.4–4.5，命题 4.2）。
9. 有限步选择误差 $\|q_\eta-\Pi_h(q^0)\|_2=O(\eta)$（定理 4.8）；序贯极限 $\lim_{\varepsilon\downarrow 0}\lim_{\eta\downarrow 0}Q_{\varepsilon,\eta}=Q_{\mathrm{ent}}$（推论 4.2）。
10. 实验支持全部定性机制，但指出样本量、盆地半径、oracle 步长均为充分非必要。

Conclusion: 本文给出了从商几何到训练算法再到隐式偏置的完整链条：满秩正二次网络的精确商结构使欧氏因子梯度流精确等价于商 Riemann 流；由此推导出的有效 Hessian 决定局部收敛模态；Gauss 测量下显式但保守的恢复定理与谱初始化保证局部端到端成功；commuting 欠定体制下因子流即加权熵 mirror flow，其极限由初始化的 Bregman 投影刻画，小初始化趋向全局最小迹 PSD 内插，并由加权熵在 commuting 代数内打破非唯一性。有限步与连续极限之差为 $O(\eta)$，阶数顺序为"先 $\eta\downarrow 0$，后 $\varepsilon\downarrow 0$"。局限性包括：商分析仅适用于满秩层；Gauss 恢复样本量依赖全空间二阶矩而非本征维数；commuting 假设对熵选择至关重要；oracle 步长未给出数据驱动规则。开放方向：以切空间或低秩 secant 集上的集中替代全空间估计以恢复最优复杂度；将 mirror-flow 选择律推广到非 commuting PSD 内插集。

Abstract: Positive quadratic networks admit the low-rank representation f_U(x)=x^top UU^top x, where Uinmathbb{R}^{dtimes r} is identifiable only up to right orthogonal multiplication, representing a rank-r PSD matrix Q=UU^top. We study how this quotient structure governs training dynamics, curvature, recovery, and interpolation bias. On the full-column-rank stratum, we identify mathbb{R}^{dtimes r}_*/O(r) with the rank-r PSD manifold. For smooth objectives L(U)=ell(UU^top), the Euclidean factor gradient is horizontal. Thus, factor gradient flow projects exactly to quotient Riemannian gradient flow, while finite-step gradient descent induces an exact congruence recursion for the predictor. For quadratic regression, we derive the effective Hessian at interpolators as the empirical measurement Gram form restricted to the tangent space relative to the quotient metric. Under Gaussian rank-one measurements, we compute population curvature, prove uniform deviation bounds for the empirical normal operator, construct a spectral initializer, and establish local exponential convergence for gradient flow and linear convergence for small-step descent. Recovery guarantees are explicit but conservative due to reliance on full-space second-moment control. In underdetermined commuting regimes, factor gradient flow becomes an exact entropy mirror flow in joint spectral coordinates. Strictly positive initializations converge to Bregman projections onto the interpolation set. With isotropic initialization q(0)=varepsilon^2mathbf{1}, predictors approach the minimum-trace solution set as varepsilondownarrow0, resolving nonuniqueness via weighted entropy within the invariant joint spectral algebra. Finite-step descent selects interpolants differing from continuous-time Bregman projections by O(eta). Numerical experiments verify these quotient identities, curvature predictions, recovery behaviors, and selection laws.

</details>


### [301] [Joint Text-Audio Alignment for EEG-to-Text Decoding in Chinese Speech Production and Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25626)
*Tian Zheng,Xurong Xie,Xinxin Zhu,Xiaolan Peng,Feng Tian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EEGAlign框架，通过联合文本-音频对齐机制实现非侵入式EEG中文句子解码。在ChineseEEG-2数据集上，朗读（RA）任务Top-1准确率达82.37%，被动聆听（PL）任务达41.43%（101候选集），均为该任务的当前最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中文EEG-to-text解码面临三大核心挑战：（1）EEG信号噪声大、信噪比低；（2）严重的受试者间变异性；（3）输出空间庞大（数千汉字）。现有方法仅采用单一监督轴——文本语义对齐缺乏细粒度时间分辨率，而音频声学对齐缺乏句子级区分能力——两者无法同时满足大词表中文解码对句子级判别性和细粒度时间分辨率的双重要求。此外，已有研究多局限于英语或孤立音节/词水平，缺乏对中文连续语句（特别是朗读产生范式）的探索。

Method: EEGAlign是一种参数高效框架，将EEG编码器与三条监督路径联合优化：（1）CTC字符序列解码路径，直接进行字符级时序对齐；（2）文本语义对齐路径，通过InfoNCE对比学习将EEG表征与冻结的BGE-M3文本嵌入对齐（τ=0.05）；（3）音频声学对齐路径，通过双向chunk级InfoNCE将EEG表征与wav2vec 2.0语音特征对齐（τ_a=0.07，chunk_size=20帧/400ms）。编码器采用转置卷积上采样至50Hz以匹配wav2vec 2.0的帧率。框架支持两种编码器：轻量级Conformer（9.91M参数，从头训练）和预训练LaBraM-base。受试者间适应性通过瓶颈残差适配器实现（约16K参数/受试者，d_b=32，零初始化上投影）。训练采用三阶段课程：语义预热→CTC引导+对齐辅助→联合优化（逐步降低对齐权重）。推理时融合语义分数（余弦相似度）和CTC对数似然（z-归一化后加权，α=0.4）。

Result: 在ChineseEEG-2数据集的101候选集闭集句子识别任务中：EEGAlign-LaBraM在RA上达到82.37% Top-1（CRA@1=83.20×），PL上达到41.43% Top-1（CRA@1=41.84×），显著超越所有基线（LaBraM-MSE、DeWave、SMM-Challenge）。Conformer版本在RA和PL上分别达到69.62%和27.26%。消融实验证实：（1）文本与音频对齐轴高度互补——单独任一轴均低于CTC-only基线（56.92%/62.63% vs 66.28%），但联合使用达69.62%；（2）受试者适配器、课程学习均贡献正向增益；（3）融合评分在所有配置上均优于单独CTC评分，PL上LaBraM融合增益最大（+11.54%）。表征层面，Full EEGAlign将线性CKA从0.294提升至0.354，RBF CKA从0.332提升至0.402。五折交叉验证RA Top-1为82.20±1.68%，受试者间标准差≤2.3点。不同候选集规模下性能优雅下降（K=500时RA仍达67.50%，PL达16.38%）。

Conclusion: EEGAlign验证了文本与音频对齐为中文EEG-to-text解码提供互补监督的假说。两种对齐信号不可互换：音频对齐是训练期主导辅助目标（λ_audio=0.1略优于0.5），而文本对齐头主要作为推理期互补评分通道（PL上贡献最大+11.5%）。框架在两种编码器实例化（Conformer和LaBraM）上均稳定提升，证实增益源于对齐机制本身而非具体骨干网络。该研究是首个在非侵入式EEG上实现大词表中文连续朗读产生解码并取得强闭集分类性能的工作。局限性包括：评估仍为受限的候选集打分而非开放式波束搜索解码；受试者特异性适配器不支持未见用户的零样本解码；受试者数量与数据量有限，制约了与更大生成式语言解码器的集成。

Abstract: Decoding speech information directly from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) into text provides a potential non-invasive neural communication pathway for individuals with severe speech and motor impairments. Compared with invasive approaches such as electrocorticography, EEG is safer and more widely deployable, yet substantially more challenging to this http URL challenge is exacerbated for Chinese sentence decoding, which must handle a high-dimensional output space with thousands of characters, severe inter-subject variability, and low signal-to-noise ratios for text this http URL methods commit to a single supervisory axis---either text semantics or audio acoustic features---yet neither can simultaneously satisfy the demands of sentence-level discriminability and fine-grained temporal resolution required for large-vocabulary Chinese decoding. We introduce EEGAlign, a novel parameter-efficient framework that jointly aligns EEG with two axes---text alignment with BGE-M3 text embeddings and audio alignment with wav2vec~2.0 speech features via contrastive learning followed by CTC character-sequence decoding. On ChineseEEG-2 data, EEGAlign yields state-of-the-art closed-set sentence classification performance, reaching up to 82.37% Top-1 accuracy on Reading Aloud EEG and 41.43% on Passive Listening EEG out of 101 candidates. Ablation studies show that the two alignment axes are highly complementary: combining them yields consistently better performance than either alone. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study on decoding large-vocabulary Chinese sentences from non-invasive EEG during overt speech production, and achieving strong classification performance with relatively large closed-set candidate-sentence setting.

</details>


### [302] [AIriskEval-edu Demo: Auditing of Pedagogical Risks in Educational Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25634)
*Javier Irigoyen,Roberto Daza,Francisco Jurado,Julian Fierrez,Ruben Tolosana,Alvaro Ortigosa,Miguel Lopez-Duran,Aythami Morales*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了 AIriskEval-edu Demo 平台，用于审计 K-12 教学解释中的教学风险。该平台基于五维教学风险评分标准（事实准确性、深度与完整性、聚焦与相关性、学生水平适宜性、意识形态偏见），集成 GPT-5.5 和本地微调的 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 评估器，提供可解释的审计结果（包含二值判定、置信度分数、定位证据片段和自然语言推理）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在生成教学内容时可能产生不准确或误导性信息，但现有教育资源多关注答案正确性或辅导互动效果，缺乏从多准则风险角度对教学解释本身进行教学质量的评估，也缺少风险定位和自然语言推理等可解释性标注。机构还需考虑敏感教育数据的隐私问题。

Method: 1) 数据集：AIriskEval-edu 包含 1,639 个基于 ScienceQA 的 K-12 教学解释，关联 170 个精选问题，每题包含教师参考和六种模拟教师画像（Exemplary、Rambling、Concise、Inaccurate、Overly Advanced、Sarcastic）下生成的合成解释，含 8,195 个二值标签及可解释性标注；2) 评估器：集成 GPT-5.5（外部 API）和 LoRA 微调的 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct（本地部署，消费级 GPU 即可运行），使用按问题分组的五折交叉验证防止数据泄漏；3) 平台架构：支持 AI 模式（审计存储的 LLM 生成解释）和人工模式（实时审计用户自由文本解释），提供双评估器并排对比功能。

Result: 本地微调的 Llama 3.1 8B 评估器在五个维度中的四个（聚焦与相关性、深度与完整性、学生水平适宜性、意识形态偏见）上检测 MAE 最低，GPT-5.5 仅在事实准确性维度领先（依赖世界通识）。在可解释性方面，微调后的 Llama 在定位 IoU 上除事实准确性外在所有维度均超过 0.95，理由 BERTScore 在所有报告维度上均超过 0.90，整体在多数指标上优于 GPT-5.5，同时保持审计内容在机构内部基础设施内。

Conclusion: AIriskEval-edu Demo 平台通过结合二值判定、置信度、证据片段定位和自然语言推理，提供可操作的教学风险审计能力。本地部署特性使教育机构能够将敏感内容保留在自身基础设施内。未来工作将扩展至多轮师生对话、多模态教育平台（如 edBB、SMARTe-VR），并结合行为线索、偏见分析和隐私保护。

Abstract: We present AIriskEval-edu Demo, a platform that audits the pedagogical quality of instructional explanations and provides explainable audit results. The platform evaluates an explanation against a rubric covering five dimensions of pedagogical risk: factual accuracy, depth and completeness, focus and relevance, student-level appropriateness, and ideological bias. For each dimension, it returns a binary decision and a confidence score. Detected risks also include a natural-language rationale and, except for Depth and Completeness, a localized evidence span. The platform integrates GPT-5.5 through an external API and a self-hosted Llama 3.1 8B evaluator that runs on consumer-grade GPUs. The local evaluator is fine-tuned on AIriskEval-edu, a dataset of K-12 instructional explanations with risk and explainability annotations. The platform operates in two modes: in AI mode, both evaluators assess stored explanations generated under six simulated teacher profiles, each representing a distinct pedagogical behavior and potential risk; in human mode, the local evaluator audits user-written explanations in real time. The local evaluator outperforms GPT-5.5 on most reported metrics, offering educational institutions a practical way to keep audited content within their own infrastructure.

</details>


### [303] [Engine-Equal, Human-Unequal: A Reproducible Outcome Skew in Engine-Assessed Equal Chess Positions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25655)
*Jesung Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在 Stockfish 18 评估本质均等的国际象棋开局局面中（人类实际到达的 1,661 个局面、1,610 万次对局），人类结果并不平衡：某些局面系统性偏向白方或黑方，这种偏向是局面本身的稳定属性，并能在不同玩家账号集、时间段和等级段间复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验"引擎评估为均势的局面在人类对弈中是否真的产生均势结果"，即探索位置本身是否携带稳定的、可复现的、对一方有利的偏差，而这种偏差独立于玩家实力。

Method: 筛选 Stockfish 18 在 ±10 厘兵范围内判为均势且在 Lichess 2025 年 10 月有足够实际对局的局面；定义"偏度"为实际战绩与玩家评分预测战绩之间的差距；在三组独立划分上评估其稳定性——(1) 不相交玩家账号集（主划分）、(2) 时间、(3) 不相交等级段；并以八个月后的样本做样本外验证；以"复现斜率"（剥离评分与开局家族效应后，一组的偏度测量对另一组的预测力）为核心指标。

Result: 主划分上的复现斜率为 0.95（family-clustered 95% CI [0.65, 0.74]），在最流行、测量最精确的局面上升至 0.94；偏度虽小（中位绝对值 ≈ 0.018，约相当于白方胜率的两个百分点），但在独立账号间逐局面复现；在更窄的评估带、更深搜索深度、不同校准与流行度门槛下均稳健存在，并在快棋与超快棋中分别独立复现；劣势方在同一局面下思考时间也更长。

Conclusion: 即便在引擎最有信心的均势判断下，引擎评估也不是人类对弈结果的充分统计量：局面本身携带稳定、可复现的微弱偏向。因果性问题留待预先注册的随机化配对研究解答。

Abstract: Among chess opening positions that a strong engine judges essentially equal (Stockfish 18 evaluation within 10 centipawns of zero, depth-stable) and that humans actually reach on Lichess (October 2025; 1,661 positions, 16.1M occurrences), human results are not balanced. Positions carry outcome skews, each the gap between its games' actual results and what the players' ratings predict, whose directions are stable properties of the naturally-reached position: some positions favour White, others Black. These skews reproduce across three re-partitions -- disjoint player-account sets (primary), time, and disjoint rating bands -- and on an out-of-sample month eight months later. On the primary split, each position's skew is measured once in each account group, and the replication slope asks how well one measurement predicts the other after removing rating and opening-family effects: one means undiminished carry-over; zero, no linear relation. We find 0.69 (family-clustered 95% CI [0.65, 0.74]), rising to 0.94 on the most-popular, best-measured positions. The slope's value depends on the position mix. Existence is the invariant claim: it survives every tighter evaluation band, search depth, calibration, and popularity cutoff we test, and replicates within blitz and rapid separately. The typical skew is small (median $|\delta| \approx 0.018$, about two percentage points of White score), yet it reproduces, position by position, across disjoint accounts. At these positions the disfavoured side also thinks longer. Even where the evaluation is most confident, it is not a sufficient statistic for human outcomes. The result is observational, and the causal question is left to a pre-registered randomised companion study.

</details>


### [304] [OrchBench: Evaluating Multi-Agent Orchestration Plans in Isolation via Deterministic Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25656)
*Zhenzhen Ren,Jiyan He,Xinpeng Zhang,Zhenxing Qian,Ke Han,Shuxin Zheng,GuoBiao Li,Xiaoqing Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OrchBench是一个基于仿真（simulation-based）的多智能体编排（multi-agent orchestration）评估基准，通过确定性的DAG模拟器隔离编排计划质量与执行因素（如智能体能力、工具可靠性），仅需真实执行1.3%的token和10.3%的时间即可与Claude Code执行的真实质量评分达到Pearson r=0.816的高相关性。核心发现是：保留关键任务信息比单纯增加智能体数量更重要，且随着工作流规模扩大，并行收益因协调失败的累积而递减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体系统（MAS）评估通常采用端到端执行方式，将编排计划质量与执行者能力、工具可靠性、环境噪声等因素混为一谈，导致无法独立评估编排策略本身。同时，真实执行随工作流规模扩大而成本急剧上升，使系统性比较编排策略变得不切实际。本文旨在解决"如何独立评估编排（orchestration）本身"这一基础性问题。

Method: OrchBench包含三个阶段：(1) DAG构建——从真实任务（如Finance Agent、DS-1000、Qasper、BIRD-SQL）通过种子判断器和精炼器生成具有目标子任务数量n∈{10, 200, 500, 1000}和目标自然并行度k_99/n的有向无环图；(2) 编排规划——给定DAG、上下文限制L和最大智能体预算A_max，被评估的规划器生成分配函数α（将子任务分配给智能体）和跨智能体信息传输规则R（带有保留比率e∈(0,1]）；(3) 确定性仿真——六阶段生命周期模拟器（依赖解析、调度、上下文获取、上下文管理、子任务执行、状态更新）评估计划，输出最终质量Q、makespan M和总token成本T，无需调用任何worker智能体。子任务具有压缩敏感性等级（robust/balanced/fragile），缺失传输按因子λ=0.5进行质量惩罚。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 仿真器验证：OrchBench与Claude Code在MultiAgentBench上最终得分的Pearson r=0.816，Spearman ρ=0.771，且在Claude Code、SWE-mini、OpenHands、Crush四种框架上均保持正相关；(2) 效率优势：相比真实执行减少389× token和110×时间（WideSearch），74× token和9.7×时间（MultiAgentBench）；(3) 核心发现——传输覆盖率（Coverage）比智能体数量对质量更具预测力（n=100时Agents–Q相关性-0.021 vs Coverage–Q 0.614），在n=500→1000时传输覆盖率从0.981骤降至0.441（Claude），多智能体质量优势随上下文窗口从16k的+0.302缩小到128k的+0.007；(4) 模型在不同规模下无统一最优——GPT-5.5（n=10）、GLM-5.1（n=20）、Claude-Opus-4.8（n=50）、Gemini-3.1-Pro（n=100）各自领先；(5) 仿真引导的工作流优化使真实执行得分从3.754提升到4.150/5。

Conclusion: OrchBench确立了一种高效且可解释的方法，可在无需调用worker智能体的情况下评估多智能体编排计划，仿真评分与真实执行质量强相关且成本极低。研究表明：优秀编排的核心在于跨依赖任务保持信息完整性，而非单纯增加智能体数量；并行性的收益随着上下文窗口扩大和协调失败累积而递减；当单智能体上下文窗口足够容纳工作状态时，多智能体协调反而成为纯开销；仿真引导的诊断可有效识别缺失的信息传输并提升真实执行质量。

Abstract: Complex tasks often decompose into parallelizable yet interdependent subtasks, making orchestration critical to the performance of multi-agent systems (MAS). Existing evaluations typically rely on end-to-end execution, which conflates orchestration-plan quality with worker capabilities, tool reliability, and environmental noise. Moreover, the time and token costs of real execution grow rapidly with workflow scale, making systematic evaluation expensive. We present OrchBench, a simulation-based benchmark for evaluating multi-agent orchestration plans in isolation. Starting from real-world tasks, OrchBench constructs directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) that encode task dependencies, with controlled sizes and degrees of parallelism. Given a DAG, a per-agent context limit, and an agent budget, the evaluated planner assigns subtasks to agents and specifies cross-agent information transfers and their retention ratios. A deterministic simulator evaluates the resulting plan without invoking worker agents and returns interpretable measures of result quality, makespan, and token cost. The simulated scores produced by OrchBench correlate strongly with quality scores from Claude Code executions, achieving a Pearson correlation of \(r=0.816\), while requiring only \(1.3\%\) of the tokens and \(10.3\%\) of the wall-clock time. Across diverse planners and workflow scales, we find that preserving task-critical information is more important than simply increasing the number of agents, and the benefits of parallelism diminish as coordination failures accumulate. These results establish OrchBench as an efficient and interpretable benchmark for comparing and diagnosing multi-agent orchestration plans.

</details>


### [305] [CoRT: Counterfactual Replay for Token-Level Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25659)
*Bo-Wen Zhang,Junwei He,Wen Wang,Song-Lin Lv,Wentao Ma,Rongyi Lin,Shuhan Zhong,Lan-Zhe Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CoRT 提出了一种基于反事实重放（counterfactual replay）的 token 级信用分配方法，用于在基于评分标准的 GRPO 训练中，将响应级优势重新分配到响应内不同 token 上，无需训练额外的 token 级相关性判别器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 GRPO 风格的基于评分标准的强化学习中，结构化的评分反馈会被压缩成单一的响应级标量奖励和优势，并均匀地广播到生成的所有 token 上。这导致响应内部缺少显式的信用分配机制：即使不同的评分标准对应于不同的文本片段、格式要求或语义选择，所有 token 仍获得相同的更新信号，造成评分标准的细粒度监督信息在 token 级策略更新中被浪费。此外，训练辅助 token 级相关性打分模型（如 RTT）需要独立的数据生成和训练流程，成本较高。因此，核心问题在于：能否在不训练独立相关性估计器的情况下，直接从策略内部信号推导 token 级信用分配。

Method: CoRT 的核心方法是"反事实重放"：对同一个采样得到的响应，分别在包含评分标准的完整提示 $x^+=(x,c)$ 和不含评分标准的提示 $x^-$ 下，用冻结的评分策略计算逐 token 的对数似然，得到反事实对比 $\Delta_{i,t}=\ell^+_{i,t}-\ell^-_{i,t}$。该对比作为 token 对评分标准依赖程度的代理——正对比表明该 token 的似然依赖评分标准上下文。具体实现包括：(1) 通过 sigmoid 函数将对比映射为有界评分 $s_{i,t}=\text{sigmoid}(\tau(\Delta_{i,t}-b))-1/2$；(2) 构造临时权重 $\tilde{w}_{i,t}=1+\eta\lambda_k s_{i,t}$；(3) 使用 SmoothStep 调度 $\lambda_k=3u_k^2-2u_k^3$ 实现渐进激活；(4) 在响应内做归一化以保证平均权重为 1，从而保持响应级优势的总幅度不变。最终将 token 级优势 $\widehat{A}_{i,t}=\text{sg}(w_{i,t})\cdot A_i$ 代入标准 PPO 风格的截断替代目标。计算开销仅为一次额外的无标准提示前向评分，不改变奖励接口或组内归一化。

Result: 在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上的实验表明，CoRT 在绝大多数比较中优于匹配奖励设置下的响应级 GRPO，平均提升 4.4 个百分点；在 CSR 和 AON 两种奖励粒度下均表现稳定。与学习式 token 级信用基线 RTT 相比，CoRT 在多数指标上具有竞争力或更优，同时避免了训练独立的 token 级相关性判别器。在 Qwen3-14B 上的扩展实验以及与 DAPO、GSPO 的兼容性实验进一步验证了方法的可扩展性和通用性。消融实验显示，响应归一化和 SmoothStep 渐进激活两个组件对训练稳定性至关重要：去掉归一化会导致平均 token 权重漂移和长度截断激增；去掉渐进激活会导致梯度和熵突变。额外分析表明，token 权重对评分标准信号具有局部敏感性（逐标准移除实验验证），且不影响模型在 Math500/GPQA/MMLU-Pro 上的通用能力。

Conclusion: CoRT 证明，策略内部基于反事实似然对比的信号能够为评分标准条件下的 GRPO 提供有效的响应内信用分配，同时保留了 GRPO 的简洁性和稳定性。该方法通过有界重放边际变换、响应归一化和渐进调度的组合，使得信用重分布在实践中保持稳定。其与 DAPO、GSPO 的兼容性表明该 token 级信用机制可作为现有策略优化框架的补充组件。论文也指出了方法的局限性：当评分标准对 token 似然影响很小、与原提示冗余或响应级奖励噪声较大时，信号会变弱。未来工作可探索更细粒度的干预、按标准分配的信用，以及跨轮次、动作和工具调用的长程信用分配。

Abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning enriches language model training by evaluating model outputs against explicit criteria. Yet in GRPO-style pipelines, these structured judgments are reduced to a scalar response-level reward and converted into a response-level advantage, which is broadcast uniformly to all generated tokens. This leaves no explicit mechanism for allocating credit within a response, even when different criteria are grounded in different spans, formatting decisions, or semantic choices. We propose CoRT, a token-level credit weighting method for rubric-conditioned GRPO. Instead of training an auxiliary token scoring model, CoRT uses counterfactual replay to rescore the same sampled response under the original rubric-conditioned prompt and a matched criteria-free prompt. The resulting tokenwise log-likelihood contrasts serve as a proxy for dependence on the rubric context. CoRT maps these contrasts to bounded, response-normalized weights and uses them to redistribute the signed GRPO advantage across tokens, without introducing an auxiliary scorer or changing the response-level reward. Experiments across instruction-tuned models and reward granularities show that CoRT improves over matched response-level GRPO in the vast majority of comparisons, with an average gain of 4.4 percentage points. The method remains competitive with learned token-level credit baselines while avoiding a separate relevance-learning stage. These results suggest that policy-internal counterfactual likelihood contrasts provide an effective training signal for within-response credit allocation while retaining the simplicity and stability of GRPO.

</details>


### [306] [Localized Adaptation Reveals Distinct Learning Signatures in Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25663)
*Rebecca Ramnauth,Brian Scassellati*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer模型中适配位置（early/middle/late层LoRA）对不同学习目标（词汇绑定、事实关联、行为策略、因果映射、程序推理）的影响，提出"适配几何"（adaptation geometry）概念，发现不同学习任务具有不同的深度偏好模式，且这些模式在五个模型家族中部分复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Transformer适配通常将更新分散到整个网络深度，即使所需变更很窄。这可能导致预期之外的纠缠和干扰。研究者旨在探索适配位置是否应被视为一个功能性设计变量，以更精准地控制模型学习什么、如何泛化以及保留哪些不变能力。

Method: 构建受控基准测试，包含5种学习目标（词汇绑定、事实关联、行为策略学习、因果映射、程序推理），每种目标都有in-distribution、paraphrase、generalization和negative-control评估。使用本地化LoRA（full-stack、early、middle、late层）在Llama-3.1-8B上进行实验，并通过参数匹配控制（扩展局部秩/缩减全栈秩）和跨模型验证（Mistral-7B、Gemma-2-9B、OLMo-2-7B、Qwen2.5-14B）检验稳健性。采用种子级配对对比和bootstrap置信区间进行统计分析，并通过排列检验验证目标间几何形状的差异性。

Result: 研究发现不同学习目标具有不同的适配几何形状：词汇绑定偏好早期层适配（97.2%获取，68.0%有界性），事实关联在局部适配中偏好后期层（52.1%/63.1%），行为策略学习中动作获取与策略门控可分离（后期层支持获取+5.1pp，中期层支持有界性+21.6pp），因果映射和程序推理依赖中期或全栈适配实现迁移（中期层分别达到68.0%和62.4%的迁移率）。这些模式在参数匹配控制下基本保持，且多数方向性对比在5个模型家族中复现。跨模型分析显示目标身份解释25.0%的变化，模型身份解释34.2%。

Conclusion: 适配位置应被视为功能性设计变量而非实现细节。不同学习目标的最优适配位置不同，且错误位置会以不同方式导致学习失败（可能获取标签但不迁移、迁移但缺乏有界性、或因过度保守而呈现有界性）。这些发现支持将局部化LoRA作为行为诊断工具，并为自适应放置、多区域组合适配等未来方向奠定基础。但适配几何并非架构不变的，未来研究应在每个模型族中重新校准预算。

Abstract: Transformer adaptation is typically distributed across model depth, even when the intended change is narrow. We investigate how adaptation site shapes what a model learns, how well that learning generalizes, and how selectively it is applied. We introduce a controlled benchmark spanning five objectives (lexical binding, factual association, behavioral policy learning, causal mapping, and procedural reasoning) and define each objective's "adaptation geometry" as its profile of acquisition, transfer, and boundedness under full-stack and early-, middle-, or late-layer LoRA. The objectives exhibit distinct geometries. Lexical binding favors early-layer adaptation for acquisition and boundedness but requires broader updates for transfer; factual association favors later layers among localized adapters; behavioral learning separates late-layer action acquisition from middle-layer policy gating; and causal and procedural transfer benefit most from middle- or full-stack adaptation. These patterns largely persist under parameter-matched controls, and most corresponding directional contrasts replicate across five model families. These findings establish adaptation site as a key design variable for controlling what models learn, generalize, and leave unchanged.

</details>


### [307] [OmniDelta: Skill-Driven Budget Allocation for Token Compression in OmniLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25669)
*Haoyang Huang,Wenjie Huang,Tianqi Xu,Hongyaoxing Gu,Kang Tan,Yikai Fu,Yuhao Shen,Tianyu Liu,Baolin Zhang,Jun Zhang,Xinyi Hu,Jun Dai,Shuang Ge,Lei Chen,Yue Li,Mingchen Wang,Meng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出OmniDelta，一种无需训练的技能驱动分层预算分配框架，用于全模态大语言模型（OmniLLM）的音视频token压缩。该方法在固定保留token预算下，通过查询-技能相似性进行跨模态（音/视频）预算转移，并根据局部复杂度与时间冗余在音频段和视频帧间重分配预算，可与现有剪枝策略兼容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OmniLLM压缩方法主要关注在固定预算下选择重要token，忽视了预算分配问题。研究发现：(1) 直接的查询-音/视频相似性用于跨模态分配不可靠（查询编码任务意图，而模态token编码样本内容）；(2) 均匀的模态内预算分配会保留冗余内容而遗漏关键证据。因此，在token剪枝之前解决"预算应如何分配"这一前置问题至关重要。

Method: OmniDelta采用三层分层预算分配：(1) 意图感知的跨模态分配——构建离线音/视频技能池，通过查询与技能词在输入嵌入空间的Top-k余弦相似性计算模态偏好，并以tanh函数平滑转移预算；(2) 内容感知的模态内分配——基于单元内复杂度（token与均值的平均余弦距离）和跨单元时间冗余（相邻单元对齐token的余弦相似性）构建中心化评分，为每个音频段/视频帧设定保留区间并按优先级分配；(3) 预算约束下的token剪枝——与OmniZip等现有剪枝策略兼容，仅改变预算分配位置而不改变总保留比例。

Result: 在4个音视频基准（WorldSense、AVUT、VideoMME、DailyOmni）上对Qwen2.5-Omni-7B和3B模型的实验表明，OmniDelta在25%和20%保留率下均优于Random、DyCoke和OmniZip基线，建立新的精度-效率Pareto前沿。在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 25%保留率下，GPU显存降低22.0%，端到端延迟获得1.64×加速。消融实验验证了跨模态分配、音频内部分配、视频内部分配三者互补，组合使用时效果最佳。

Conclusion: OmniDelta证明了在token剪枝之前的预算分配是OmniLLM高效推理的有效方向。通过技能驱动的跨模态路由与基于局部复杂度/冗余的模态内重分配，该框架在保持兼容性的同时实现了更高的精度和更低的推理成本，为全模态模型的高效部署提供了新思路。

Abstract: Emerging Omni-modal Large Language Models (OmniLLMs) enable unified understanding of text, audio, and video, but their long audio-video token sequences introduce substantial memory and inference costs. Existing compression methods mainly focus on selecting important tokens under fixed budgets, leaving the preceding budget-allocation problem underexplored. We show that direct query-to-audio/video similarity is unreliable for inter-modal budget allocation, and that uniform intra-modal budgets can miss key evidence while retaining redundant content. To address these limitations, we propose OmniDelta, a training-free, skill-driven framework that couples intent-aware inter-modal allocation with content-aware intra-modal allocation. OmniDelta first constructs audio and video skill pools to shift the fixed retained-token budget according to query demand, then reallocates modality budgets over audio segments and video frames using local complexity and temporal redundancy. The resulting local budgets can be combined with existing pruning strategies, preserving the total retained-token ratio while changing where the budget is spent. Experiments on four audio-video benchmarks with two Qwen2.5-Omni models show that OmniDelta establishes a new accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier across pruning ratios. At 25% token retention on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, OmniDelta reduces GPU memory by 22.0% and achieves a 1.64x end-to-end speedup over full-token inference.

</details>


### [308] [DecoEvo: Score-Decoupled Co-Evolution of Solver and Rubric-Generator Skills in Text Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25675)
*Jiangwang Chen,Zixin Song,Junlin Liu,Shuaiyu Zhou,Haiyan Wu,Haihan Shi,Chenxi Zhou,Hanqing Li,Xiao Yang,Da Zhu,Guanjun Jiang,Hai Wan,Xibin Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DecoEvo提出了一种"评分解耦"的文本空间协同进化框架，通过分别优化求解器技能与评分标准生成器技能，避免了评分标准向"更容易满足"方向漂移的问题，在五个基准和三个LLM骨干上均取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本空间优化方法（如OPRO、DSPy、TextGrad、SkillOpt）通常保持评估标准（rubric）固定，这在开放性任务上构成瓶颈：求解器在被衡量的维度上提升后，未被覆盖的缺陷维度对优化信号不可见；若直接演化评分标准并以求解器得分作为接受准则，则会出现"评分耦合共适应"——评分标准可能向求解器已满足的方向漂移，造成代理分数上升而真实质量未改善。这一问题与奖励过优化和经典协同进化系统的不稳定性相关。

Method: DecoEvo维护两个可编辑的自然语言技能——求解器技能 s 和评分标准生成器技能 g（共享冻结骨干模型，通过角色分离的提示实现），无任何权重更新和金标准评分标准监督。内层循环：求解器基于生成评分标准的逐项反馈更新技能，并以配对验证集上的代理分数差进行接受判断。外层循环（每隔K步或求解器停滞M次触发）执行"审计-蒸馏-验证"流程：(1) 任务条件结构审计——基于任务公开描述发现评分标准遗漏的要求；(2) 近平局对比审计——对求解器L次随机采样中得分相近的响应进行"评分盲"的两两对比，发现评分标准无法区分的质量差异。生成器技能重写器将诊断信息提炼为可复用原则，候选生成器在保持集上以Pareto准则接受（至少一项审计目标改善且无目标退化超过容差η）。关键设计：聚合求解器分数绝不作为生成器接受目标，从而切断"让评分标准变容易"的直接激励。

Result: 在HealthBench、LLMEval-Med、WritingBench、Creative Writing v3和ResearchQA五个基准上，使用GPT-4o、Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B三个骨干，DecoEvo在所有15个骨干-基准组合上均超越基线，相对SkillOpt取得2.8–5.0%的平均增益（GPT-4o: 5.0%, Qwen3-4B: 2.9%, Qwen3-8B: 2.8%），跨基准迁移同样有效。作为对照，评分耦合变体SC-CoEvo在15例中13例低于SkillOpt，验证了评分解耦的必要性。消融实验表明验证机制贡献最大（2.4–2.9分），两个审计均不可或缺。评分标准对齐分析显示DecoEvo的生成评分标准与金标准的F1较SkillOpt提升约12分，而SC-CoEvo反而下降5–6分。计算成本约为SkillOpt的1.89倍，但仅发生在开发阶段，部署只保留最终求解器技能。

Conclusion: 评分解耦可作为黑盒LLM技能与评估工件协同进化的一项实用设计原则。DecoEvo通过结构审计与近平局对比审计，将局部诊断转化为可复用的生成器技能修订，同时避免了对求解器得分的目标耦合。局限性：实验局限于同一骨干承担所有优化角色且迁移限于医学和写作领域；未来工作包括跨角色使用不同骨干、跨领域任务以及更广泛的人工评估。

Abstract: Text-space optimization adapts large language models (LLMs) by editing external natural-language artifacts rather than model weights, so the optimized artifacts remain inspectable and the model can be treated as a black box. However, most existing text-space methods keep evaluation fixed. On open-ended tasks, this can become a bottleneck: once the solver improves on the criteria a rubric measures, omitted dimensions remain invisible to the optimization signal. Simply evolving the rubric is also unreliable when updates are selected by the current solver's score, because apparent progress can come from making the rubric easier to satisfy. We introduce DecoEvo (Decoupled Co-Evolution), which co-evolves a solver skill and a rubric-generator skill under decoupled objectives without using gold rubrics during optimization. The solver skill is updated using criterion-level feedback, while the rubric-generator skill is revised through complementary audits of requirement coverage and response discrimination that are independent of aggregate solver score. This separation focuses generator updates on newly exposed solver weaknesses, reducing repeated emphasis on criteria the solver already satisfies. Under each benchmark's official evaluation, DecoEvo outperforms all compared methods across five benchmarks and three LLM backbones, yielding 2.8--5.0\% relative gains over SkillOpt in the five-benchmark average.

</details>


### [309] [Cognivia: A Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Copilot for Evidence-Based Mental Healthcare](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25681)
*Qi Chen,Siria Xiyueyao Luo,Jian Wang,Yuan Shi,Haocong Rao,Xuejiao Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Cognivia 是一个基于循证 CBT（认知行为疗法）的人工智能治疗助手，通过专家种子数据集、多阶段提示增强 CBT 三元组数据集和 LoRA 微调技术，实现认知扭曲识别与理性回应生成；并提出首个层次化质量评估框架 CogEval，在词汇指标、LLM 评判与 10 位行为科学专家人工评估中均优于 9 个基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CBT 对缓解认知扭曲和心理健康障碍有效，但受限于专业治疗师短缺；现有 LLM 心理健康应用存在领域特异性不足、过度迎合用户、缺乏明确的认知扭曲标注等问题；通用 NLP 评估指标无法衡量 CBT 治疗的保真度（如是否能正确识别扭曲、提供结构化认知挑战）。

Method: 1) **专家种子数据集构建**：从 Burns 的经典 CBT 文献中提取 11 类认知扭曲的 296 个示例，编码为结构化提示模板 P_i。2) **CBT 认知三元组数据集增强**：基于 PsyQA 数据集，使用 DeepSeek 识别认知扭曲 d_i，再用 GPT-5 Mini 结合提示 P_2 生成 CBT 对齐的理性回应 r_i，构建 (q_i, d_i, r_i) 形式的 9,437 条增强三元组。3) **任务导向微调**：使用 LoRA 在 Silicon Flow 平台对 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 进行监督微调。4) **CogEval 评估框架**：包含 4 个一级维度（语义保真度、稳健性与容错、部署可行性与用户采纳、关系边界完整性）和 12 个子维度（如结构清晰度、情境安全性、共情验证、边界框架、依赖避免等），采用 1–5 分 Likert 量表。

Result: - **词汇指标**：ROUGE-1 达 0.592，BLEU 0.103，优于多数开源大模型，与 GPT-5 Mini 持平。- **LLM 评判（现有标准）**：相关性 9.869、CBT 结构 9.868、有用性 9.868（满分 10），排名第一。- **CogEval 评判**：12 项子维度中 9 项第一、2 项第二，关系边界完整性接近满分。- **人类专家评估**（10 位行为科学专家，p<0.05，ICC≈0.95）：Cognivia 在中位数与均值上均优于 GPT-5 Mini。- **种子集消融实验**：移除专家种子后所有指标下降，证明其关键作用。- **CBT 路径激活**：98.7% 的测试样本成功触发 CBT 推理路径。

Conclusion: 将循证心理学知识与 LLM 结合，可提升心理健康支持的临床一致性与可扩展性；Cognivia 框架为循证、可及、可规模化的 CBT 辅助提供了可行路径；未来工作将扩展至多轮对话、轻量记忆层、长期纵向干预研究，并联合华西医院开展临床验证。

Abstract: Cognitive distortion amplifies negative emotions and contributes to mental health disorders. Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) is an effective way to address cognitive distortions, but its large-scale application is limited by the shortage of professional therapists. Although large language models (LLMs) have recently been explored for mental health applications, existing methods still suffer from limited domain specificity, overly flattering responses, and the absence of well-defined annotations for cognitive distortions. This paper proposes Cognivia, an evidence-based artificial intelligence therapist that integrates automatic cognitive distortion identification and rational response generation. Our framework is built on authoritative CBT texts widely regarded as core paradigms and standard references. It is further augmented with mental health question-answer (Q and A) data, and employs multi-stage prompting and structured generation strategies under the supervision of behavioral science experts. Then we fine-tune a lightweight LLM on this augmented CBT dataset to obtain Cognivia. In addition, we propose the first hierarchical quality evaluation framework for assessing LLM-generated rational responses, developed through collaboration between AI researchers and behavioral science experts. Cognivia is evaluated using lexical metrics, LLM-based Judges with two complementary criteria, and human evaluation by 10 behavioral science experts. It consistently outperforms the baseline methods in cognitive distortion recognition and rational response generation, demonstrating its effectiveness. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [310] [Nudging Sustainable Choices through LLM-Generated Recommendation Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25726)
*Haya Halimeh,Dietmar Jannach,Oliver Müller*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究如何通过LLM生成的推荐解释来引导用户做出可持续消费选择。通过两项随机对照实验（N=529），发现仅仅在解释中披露可持续属性并不会改变用户选择，但通过框架效应（framing）或描述性社会规范（descriptive social norms）来呈现同样的可持续信息，则能将可持续选择率从约50%提升至67-69%。研究还发现用户感知与实际行为存在显著背离——机制无关的披露虽提升了用户对解释的评价，却未转化为可持续选择行为。该研究为可扩展的、基于理论的行为干预提供了实践路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推荐系统深刻影响着大规模消费决策，具备引导用户走向更可持续选择的潜力。现有可持续导向的推荐干预多以界面提示（如交通灯标签）形式呈现，未嵌入推荐解释本身；而已有的可持续解释研究存在静态模板化、缺乏个性化、非跨领域验证等局限。此外，LLM生成解释虽具规模化潜力，却存在幻觉与事实失真的风险。因此，亟需研究在个性化推荐场景中，LLM生成的理论驱动的可持续解释能否以及如何在不限制用户选择自由的前提下有效引导可持续行为，并厘清"披露信息本身"与"信息的呈现方式"二者作用的差异。

Method: 研究采用2（领域：高/低参与度）×4（条件）被试间实验设计。低参与度领域为速溶咖啡（基于Amazon Reviews数据集，92件商品），高参与度领域为维也纳酒店预订（194件酒店）。四个条件分别为：(1) 仅偏好型基线；(2) 机制无关型（mechanism-free），平实披露可持续属性；(3) 框架型（framing），以正面获益框架呈现；(4) 描述性社会规范型，援引情境参照群体的行为。基于用户明确陈述的偏好进行匹配推荐，确保四件商品在偏好契合度上无差异。通过约束式提示词模板引导Claude Sonnet 4.6为每个用户-商品对实时生成解释。通过LLM-as-a-judge（GPT-5.2）和人工标注双重审计解释的机制遵循度（κ=.99）与事实准确性（99.2%受支持）。最终样本N=529（速溶咖啡262，酒店267），通过Prolific招募。使用二元逻辑回归（RQ1）、嵌套对比（RQ2）和条件×领域交互检验（RQ3）进行分析。

Result: RQ1：三个可持续意识条件合并后使用户选择可持续商品的概率提升69%（OR=1.69, p=.011），效果独立于生物圈价值取向等因素。RQ2：机制无关披露对选择无显著影响（OR=1.08, p=.76）；而框架效应（OR=2.39, p=.001）和社会规范（OR=1.89, p=.014）显著提升了可持续选择。值得注意的是，感知与行为出现明显背离——所有三个可持续意识条件都显著提升了用户对解释的感知可持续影响力和可用性，但仅框架和规范条件提升了实际选择行为。框架与社会规范同时降低了选择难度，但不影响选择满意度和解释清晰度。RQ3：行为与感知效应在高低参与度两个领域间均无显著差异（所有交互项p>.11），表明干预效果可跨领域泛化。

Conclusion: 研究证实，推荐解释本身即可作为选择架构的一个被忽视却有效的行为干预渠道。核心启示是：仅仅提供可持续信息是不够的——信息的呈现方式（理论驱动的行为机制）才是影响决策的关键。LLM能够实时规模化地实现理论驱动的可持续解释，前提是：(1) 提示词工程需根植于既定行为理论；(2) 生成的文本须经机制遵循度和事实保真度的双重审计。该研究将"解释即助推"确立为推荐系统实现社会公益目标的可操作路径，为个性化、基于生成式AI的自适应解释设计奠定基础。局限包括：假设性选择、单一属性操作化、视觉徽章与文本并存、单一交互接触，未来需要在现场研究和纵向暴露下进一步验证。

Abstract: Recommender systems mediate everyday consumption, offering a promising channel for encouraging sustainable choices. Prior research shows that explanations influence users' perceptions of recommendations and can support more informed decisions. We argue that explanations can also serve as behavioral nudges by foregrounding sustainability information at the moment of choice. This study investigates how different behavioral framings of sustainability information in recommendation explanations affect user choices and perceptions. Using generative AI, we generate sustainability-aware explanations by drawing on nudge theory and validate them through human evaluation and LLM-as-a-judge audits. Building on this foundation, we conduct two randomized studies ($N = 529$) in a low involvement domain (instant coffee) and a high involvement domain (hotel bookings), in which participants choose among preference matched recommendations accompanied by these explanations. Our results show that, across both domains, merely disclosing sustainability information in explanations does not change choices, whereas framing that information or invoking a descriptive social norm significantly increases sustainable selections and eases decision-making. Notably, perception and behavior diverge, as plain disclosure improves explanation evaluations without translating into more sustainable selection behavior. Our work demonstrates how LLMs can generate theory-grounded explanations at scale, pointing toward practical explanation-based interventions for social good. We conclude by discussing implications for adaptive explanation design with generative AI.

</details>


### [311] [Loss Invariance Determines What Concept Layers Encode: Volume Grounding in Echocardiography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25748)
*Hyunkyung Han,Min Jung Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示概念瓶颈模型(CBM)中,当训练目标(射血分数)对概念层(左心室容积)具有尺度不变性时,概念层会丢失物理尺度信息而仅保留部分排序关系,需通过绝对单位监督才能恢复临床可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念瓶颈模型(CBM)的可解释性通常仅通过概念预测准确度来评估,但作者认为这种评估不足以验证概念层的物理有效性。以射血分数(EF)为例,EF是舒张末期容积(EDV)和收缩末期容积(ESV)的比值,具有尺度不变性,这意味着仅用EF目标训练时,概念层的绝对物理尺度无法被损失函数确定,可能导致临床误用。

Method: 使用EchoNet-Dynamic公开数据集(7460/1288/1276例),采用VideoMAE视频Transformer编码器,概念层由ESV和EDV两个标量组成,EF通过解析公式计算(无残差路径)。比较四种训练条件:仅EF目标、绝对单位容积监督(μ=3和μ=10)、归一化容积监督。评估指标包括MAE、Pearson相关系数和预测标准差,并通过命题1及其推论形式化尺度不变性理论。

Result: 1) EF准确度:概念瓶颈不增加EF误差(6.89 vs 直接回归7.13);2) 尺度坍缩:无容积监督时,预测容积标准差坍缩至0.1 mL(参考值为35.7和45.7 mL),但相关系数部分保留(ESV r=0.626);3) 监督恢复:绝对单位监督将容积误差从89.8降至25.8 mL,代价是EF误差增加0.4;4) 优化不稳定性:容积监督引入训练发散,需降低学习率;5) 增大监督权重(μ=10)不进一步改善概念有效性;6) 残余压缩(预测SD 22.5 vs 参考45.7)归因于预处理对像素间距的消除。

Conclusion: 概念准确度评估可掩盖概念层缺失物理尺度的事实。命题1证明:训练损失仅能确定概念层到G-轨道的不变性等价类。对于EF这类比值目标,尺度群G={c↦λc:λ>0}保持输出不变,因此EF目标无法确定概念层的绝对尺度,任何G-不变的正则化器也无法恢复尺度。临床可解释模型的中间变量应针对训练目标的不变结构进行验证,而非仅依赖预测准确度。该结论可推广至任何尺度不变的概念词汇(如形状、边缘描述符)。

Abstract: Objective: Concept bottleneck models route prediction through interpretable intermediate variables, and their validity is normally judged by how accurately those variables are predicted. We ask whether that judgement is sufficient, using left ventricular volumes as the concepts underlying ejection fraction estimation from echocardiographic video. Methods: A video transformer encoder was trained on a publicly available echocardiography dataset. End-systolic and end-diastolic volumes formed a concept layer from which ejection fraction was computed analytically, with no residual path to the output. We compared training under an ejection fraction objective alone against training with additional supervision of the volumes in millilitres, and evaluated both on 1276 held-out studies. Results: The concept bottleneck did not increase ejection fraction error relative to direct regression, at 6.89 against 7.13 mean absolute error. Without volume supervision, however, the spread of predicted volumes collapsed to 0.1 millilitres against reference spreads of 35.7 and 45.7 millilitres, while correlation was partly preserved. We show that this follows from an invariance property of the objective: ejection fraction is a ratio and is unchanged when both volumes are rescaled, so the loss determines the concept layer only up to scale. Supervision in absolute units reduced volume error from 89.8 to 25.8 millilitres at a cost of 0.4 in ejection fraction error. Conclusion: Concept accuracy alone can conceal a concept layer that carries no physical scale. Significance: Interpretable intermediate variables in clinical models should be validated against the invariance structure of the training objective, not only against prediction accuracy.

</details>


### [312] [Speculate While You Reason: Teaching Agents to Predict Their Next Tool Call via Joint Agent-Speculator RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25816)
*Jiabao Ji,Yujian Liu,Li An,Rohit Jain,Gungor Polatkan,Siyu Zhu,Shiyu Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出自推测智能体(Self-Speculating Agent)，将单一LLM同时用于任务解决(agent模式)和下一工具调用预测(speculator模式)，通过联合agent-speculator强化学习方法，让模型学会预测自己接下来的工具调用，同时不损失任务完成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具调用推测方法使用外部draft模型或缓存轨迹，与目标agent存在"speculator-agent gap"，命中率低且带来额外服务开销（额外权重、KV缓存）。研究发现：target agent本身就是它自己最强的推测器，这启发了将agent与speculator统一在同一个模型中。

Method: 1) 自推测智能体设计：单一模型支持agent模式和speculator模式（通过附加推测后缀触发），共享前缀KV缓存；2) 联合Agent-Speculator RL：从当前agent rollout中构建推测目标，使用DAPO风格分组策略优化，交替进行agent和speculator更新（4:8调度），并在模式切换时重置优化器状态；3) 奖励设计：推测奖励R_sp = R_name × R_args（工具名匹配后计算参数token-F1）。

Result: 在Agentic SearchQA（HotpotQA, MuSiQue, BCP）和τ-bench（Airline, Retail）上：Qwen3-4B平均下一工具调用Hit@1从44.1提升至61.2，Qwen3.5-4B从48.9提升至66.3，同时下游任务成功率保持稳定（26.6→27.7，49.2→50.6）。消融研究证实SFT预热、优化器重置和交替更新调度（4:8最优）的必要性。

Conclusion: 将工具调用推测统一到agent本身是可行的，自推测智能体通过联合RL训练在提升推测准确率的同时保持了任务性能，避免了外部draft模型的服务开销。但该方法假设推测调用不会改变外部环境，因此不适用于有副作用的写操作工具，且目前仅在4B规模模型上验证。

Abstract: Large language model agents often spend substantial wall-clock time waiting for tool call results. Tool-call speculation can hide this latency by predicting and pre-executing an agent's next tool call if the prediction matches the agent's eventual tool call, but existing speculators are typically separate draft models or cached traces that are poorly aligned with the deployed agent's own behavior. We identify this speculator-agent gap and show that the target agent itself is a strong next-call speculator. This points to a simpler design: unifying the agent and speculator within the same model. In this paper, we introduce the self-speculating agent, a single model that both solves tasks in agent mode and predicts its next tool call from partial trajectories in speculator mode, fully reusing prefix KV cache. To enable this dual-mode agent without degrading performance, we propose a joint agent-speculator reinforcement learning method, which derives speculation targets from the agent's own rollouts and alternates agent and speculator updates. Across agentic search QA and conversational tool-use agentic tasks, our method improves average next tool-call Hit@1 from 44.1 to 61.2 for Qwen3-4B and from 48.9 to 66.3 for Qwen3.5-4B, while preserving agent task success.

</details>


### [313] [Distributed Constraint Optimization via Online Learning and Iterative Pricing with Application to Large-Scale Satellite Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25835)
*Itai Zilberstein,Pranav Rajbhandari,Steve Chien,Tuomas Sandholm*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出两种互补方法解决大规模分布式约束优化问题(DCOP)：一是将现代在线学习算法(后悔匹配及其变体)适配为DCOP求解器；二是提出一种新的分解框架"迭代定价"，将高层分配DCOP与本地调度oracle通过价格反馈耦合。在60颗卫星的星座观测调度任务中实现了99.2%的请求完成率，显著优于87%的现有最优基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际DCOP应用(如大规模卫星调度)规模过大，难以整体求解。现有分解方法(如NSS)仅针对特定领域结构，缺乏通用机制将高层分配决策与复杂本地约束耦合。需要一种既可扩展、又能在高层分配与丰富本地规划问题之间灵活衔接的通用框架。

Method: 1) 在线学习DCOP求解器：利用DCOP与精确势博弈的联系，将后悔匹配(RM)及其变体(RM+、折扣RM、预测RM、IR-PRM、上下文RM)和FTRL/MWU算法适配到DCOP设置；2) 迭代定价分解框架：高层meta-DCOP负责请求分配，本地oracle(MILP)负责实际调度，通过价格λ更新惩罚无法本地执行的分配；3) 约束生成作为对比基线；4) 在图着色和60颗Walker星座COSP问题上进行实证验证。

Result: 1) 图着色基准上，在线学习算法与现有DCOP不完全算法性能相当，但消息开销更低；2) 卫星调度中，迭代定价+上下文IR-PRM达到99.2%请求完成率，最优约束生成基线仅86.7%，NSS基线87%；3) 阻尼和惯性启发式与在线学习结合反而降低性能(惯性被证明违反无后悔性质)；4) 在线学习算法在迭代定价框架内均超过90%完成率，远超其他不完全DCOP算法。

Conclusion: 现代在线学习算法是DCOP求解的有效范式，特别是与迭代定价相结合时。迭代定价作为通用接口，可应用于任何高层分配与本地优化自然可分的分布式规划领域(移动传感器、无人机协调、运输调度)。该方法计划部署于NASA FAME任务(2027年飞行测试)。

Abstract: Distributed constraint optimization problems (DCOPs) provide a popular framework for distributed decision making under limited communication, but many real-world instances are too large to solve monolithically. We address this challenge from two complementary directions. We revisit the connection between DCOPs and potential games, and adapt modern online learning algorithms for equilibrium finding to DCOPs. We show that these algorithms are competitive with representative incomplete DCOP algorithms. We then turn to decomposition frameworks for large-scale DCOPs, motivated by large-scale decentralized satellite scheduling. We propose a new framework that separates a DCOP into two interacting subproblems: a high-level meta-DCOP for task allocation, and independent local optimization problems for scheduling. To couple the two levels, we develop a novel iterative pricing method that updates the meta-level utilities using feedback from the local optimizers. Combining our online learning methods with our iterative pricing framework, we obtain near-optimal performance on real-world decentralized satellite scheduling problem instances, fulfilling over 99% of observation requests compared with 87% for state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [314] [HiSkill: Empowering LLM Agents with Hierarchical Skill Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25853)
*Yu Hao,Jinxuan Cai,Qi Zhang,Yawen Li,Zhiqiang Zhang,Chuan Shi,Cheng Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 HiSkill 框架，通过构建包含技能节点、原子操作节点和类型化边的有向层次化技能图，将高层技能抽象与可执行动作模板桥接起来，从而提升 LLM 智能体在长时程交互任务中的经验复用效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 trajectory-to-skill 方法主要存在两个局限：(1) 生成的技能多为粗粒度的策略或文本指导，在高层技能描述与具体可执行动作之间存在鸿沟，简单的文本注入无法让模型推断出具体的执行细节；(2) 技能通常以扁平方式独立存储和检索，技能间的组合、时序、依赖、恢复等关系未被充分利用。已有图结构方法（如 Graph of Skills、GraSP）虽然在技能层面引入了结构化组织，但仍然停留在高层文本指导层面，未探索技能与可执行动作之间的细粒度关联。

Method: HiSkill 框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 层次化技能图构建：将交互轨迹组织为有向图，包含 skill 节点（高层可复用程序，含结构化元数据）、AtomicOp 节点（可执行动作模板），以及五种类型化边（分解、时序转移、兼容性、支持、恢复关系），编码技能间的多种程序化关系；(2) 子图检索：通过语义-词汇匹配和图扩展，检索任务相关的紧凑子图；(3) 子图引导的任务执行：维护符号化任务状态和当前活跃技能，利用检索到的子图和 LLM 迭代地切换技能、选择 AtomicOp 并接地可执行动作，形成闭环执行。

Result: 在三个交互式环境上的实验表明，HiSkill 优于当前最优基线方法，平均相对提升成功率 17.33%，同时将推理阶段的 token 消耗降低 78.75%（相对于最强基线）。实验结果验证了通过层次化技能图桥接高层技能抽象与可执行动作接地的有效性。

Conclusion: HiSkill 通过将交互轨迹转化为层次化的有向技能图，统一了高层技能与可执行动作模板，并以类型化边编码丰富的程序化关系，在推理时通过任务相关子图引导 LLM 智能体执行。这一设计有效弥合了高层技能抽象与动作接地之间的鸿沟，显著提升了长时程任务的成功率并大幅降低了推理成本，证明了结构化技能组织对经验复用的重要价值。

Abstract: Skills have become an important abstraction for enabling large language model (LLM) agents to reuse past experience in long-horizon interactive tasks. However, existing trajectory-to-skill methods often produce flat collections of high-level textual skills that are stored and retrieved independently, leaving skill relations underutilized and maintaining a gap between high-level skills and executable actions. In this paper, we propose HiSkill, a hierarchical skill graph framework that organizes interaction trajectories into a directed graph with skill nodes, AtomicOp nodes, and typed edges. Specifically, the graph connects reusable high-level skills with executable action templates, while also capturing decomposition, temporal transition, compatibility, support, and recovery relations among them. At inference time, HiSkill retrieves a compact task-relevant subgraph and performs subgraph-guided task execution, where a symbolic task state, an active skill, and the retrieved subgraph guide the LLM agent to switch skills, select AtomicOps, and ground executable actions iteratively. Experiments on three interactive environments show that HiSkill outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while reducing inference token consumption, demonstrating the effectiveness of bridging high-level skills and executable action grounding through a hierarchical skill graph. Our data and code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [315] [Runtime Uncertainty Monitoring for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems Using Bayesian Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25877)
*Bart Custers,Koorosh Aslansefat*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯网络的LLM多智能体系统运行时不确定性监控框架，应用于精算风险建模场景，通过将token级对数概率校准后转化为任务级置信度估计，实现工作流级别的不确定性传播追踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM具有概率性输出和多智能体工作流存在级联误差传播的问题，在保险精算等高风险决策场景中，不可靠的输出可能导致错误的风险评估、不公平定价和监管不合规。现有方法不足以解决多步骤、基于智能体的工作流中误差和不确定性的产生与传播问题。

Method: 采用中心化星型拓扑结构，由中央枢纽协调四个专门化智能体（数据准备、建模、审查、解释），利用token级对数概率经长度归一化后通过校准函数转化为任务级置信度估计，作为贝叶斯网络的条件概率证据；贝叶斯网络节点代表工作流任务，通过有向边建模依赖关系，进行不确定性传播推理。

Result: 实验在Llama 2 7B、Llama 3.1 8B和Qwen2.5 7B三种本地后端上进行：MAS达到至少80%任务成功率，RMSE与基线精算模型相当；在扰动数据集测试中，Qwen后端错误检测率达90%，显著优于Llama 2 (45%)和Llama 3.1 (65%)；场景测试表明温度升高（如1.2）会使整体工作流成功率从安全场景的87.1%降至42.8%，验证了不确定性传播的有效性。

Conclusion: 该框架能复现基线精算建模性能，同时提供工作流级别置信度的额外洞察，但其有效性依赖于所选LLM后端，在错误检测、适应性和不确定性行为方面存在显著差异；贝叶斯网络应被解释为运行时不确定性传播监控器，而非输出正确性的证明；当前模型抽象为DAG，未来将扩展到动态贝叶斯网络以建模时序行为和迭代修复循环。

Abstract: This paper investigates how multi-agent systems (MAS)-based on large language models (LLMs) can support actuarial risk modelling, with a particular focus on uncertainty quantification. Actuarial workflows represent a high-stakes decision-support setting where unreliable outputs may lead to incorrect risk assessment, unfair pricing, and regulatory non-compliance. To address uncertainty introduced by the probabilistic nature of LLMs and dependencies between agents, a multi-agent framework is proposed in which specialised agents perform data preparation, modelling, review, and explanation tasks under a central hub. The main contribution is a novel approach to uncertainty propagation using token-level log-probabilities and a Bayesian Network. Importantly, log probabilities are not treated as direct probabilities of correctness or task success. Instead, length-normalised log-probability summaries are transformed into calibrated task-level confidence estimates before incorporation into the Bayesian Network. Results show that the framework reproduces baseline actuarial performance while providing additional insight into workflow stability and runtime uncertainty propagation.

</details>


### [316] [Distributing Security Controls Through Harness Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25890)
*William Robert Gore*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究如何在商业AI编程智能体（Claude Code、Codex）上实施现有的安全控制，并通过自定义智能体harness（SHarD，基于Pi）将其分发给分布式用户基础。基于OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications构建的23项测试套件的分阶段测试表明，OS沙箱、技能扫描和工具限制三类控制可通过单一安装命令嵌入并分发，且效果等同于直接安装在商业智能体上。SHarD获得100%的调整后分数，与最佳安全配置的商业智能体持平，无任何类别回归。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编程智能体正以前所未有的速度被采用，但安全与风险顾虑（62%的组织认为）是规模化部署智能体AI的主要障碍。现有的安全控制未系统性地分发给工程团队，而厂商原生方案（如Microsoft Agent 365）会引入生态系统依赖性，可能不适合所有部署环境。该研究旨在填补研究空白：即"现成"的（off-the-shelf）安全控制能否通过智能体harness进行规模化分发。

Method: 采用分阶段测试方法，覆盖四种智能体配置：(1) Phase 1 - Claude Code与Codex基线测试；(2) Phase 2 - 在商业智能体上测试现成控制；(3) Phase 3 - Pi Coding Agent基线测试；(4) Phase 4 - SHarD加固harness控制测试。测试套件包含23项基于OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications的功能探针测试，覆盖内容保护、技能扫描、工具选择和OS沙箱四类控制。使用金丝雀令牌和已知payload确保结果明确。实验环境采用Mac mini M4主机+本地网络Ubuntu虚拟机托管恶意MCP服务器。评分机制：Pass=1，Mixed=0.5，Fail=0，排除不明确结果。

Result: Phase 2中商业智能体获得显著提升：Claude Code复合分从60.9%升至87.0%（+26.1%），Codex从45.7%升至69.6%（+23.9%）。技能扫描和OS沙箱在两智能体上均显著改善，但内容保护因基线较高且控制间冲突而被剔除。SHarD最终获得100%调整后分数（与最佳配置的商业Claude Code持平），在所有类别中无回归，且未引入不可接受的延迟（技能扫描需1m49s-8m13s，被视为可接受的权衡）。观察到两个重要现象：(1)模型非确定性可导致不一致的安全结果；(2)自主智能体行为可跨越系统边界（如默认配置的Pi智能体递归搜索文件系统并安装恶意MCP服务器到Claude Code配置中），OS沙箱可有效缓解此类风险。

Conclusion: 研究明确回答了两个研究问题：(RQ1) 现成安全控制可在商业AI编程智能体上实施并发挥基本功能；(RQ2) 安全控制可通过智能体harness进行规模化分发，同时保持等效效力。SHarD作为一个可分发的安全加固harness，证明了OS沙箱、技能扫描和工具限制三类控制可通过单一安装命令分发并保持效能。该研究提出"控制harness适配性框架"的初步特征——声明式策略（Declarative Policy）和控制局部性（Control Locality），加上待进一步研究的执行面广度和控制互操作性维度。此外，提出了第三个研究问题（RQ3）：哪些安全控制特征表明其适合通过可分发的智能体harness进行扩展。核心启示是：随着智能体harness成为工程投资的主要着力点，它也是规模化分发的可行安全机制；安全性需要确定性、由harness强制执行的钩子控制，而非仅依赖模型推理；同时应建立多层防御纵深。

Abstract: AI coding agents are being adopted at historic speed, yet security and risk concerns remain the primary barrier to scaling agentic AI across organizations. Existing security controls for coding agents are not systematically distributed to engineering teams, and vendor-native solutions introduce ecosystem dependencies that may not suit every deployment context. This paper investigates whether off-the-shelf security controls can be implemented on commercial AI coding agents and scaled to a distributed user base via a custom agent harness. A phased testing methodology was applied across four agent configurations --- two commercial agents with and without controls, a baseline harness, and a security-hardened harness --- using a 23-test suite derived from the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications. SHarD (Secure Harness Distribution), a distributable harness built on the Pi agent harness, demonstrated that three categories of security controls --- OS sandboxing, skill scanning, and tool restriction --- can be embedded and distributed via a single install command while retaining equivalent efficacy to direct installation on commercial agents. SHarD achieved an adjusted score of 100\%, matching the best securely configured commercial agent, with no regression across any test category. Notable observations include evidence that model non-determinism produces inconsistent security outcomes and that autonomous agent behavior can cross system boundaries in ways that OS sandboxing directly mitigates. Initial characteristics toward a control harness fitness framework are proposed, and a third research question is identified for future investigation.

</details>


### [317] [Interactive Reward Agent: GUI Task Evaluation via Environment-State Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.25904)
*Chenrui Shi,Yuwei Wu,Yang Liu,Ruining Feng,Zirui Shang,Zhi Gao,Lifeng Fan,Che Sun*

Main category: cs.AI
